review:
Ladri!  Thieves!  I entered for lunch.  Prices posted on every table.  Even though my visit was the Monday AFTER Easter, I presumed I would be asked to pay the (Giorno Festiva) Holiday Rate.  Instead, when I went to pay my bill these thieves added another €10 to the bill.  They told me that it doesn't matter the price posted on every table, that they had a TV monitor someplace in the foyer with the trumped up price.  I tried to explain to the manager that EVERY TABLE had a price list, and NONE gave the double-cost price they charged.  He did nothing to make it right!

The food was mediocre at best.  A young 'cook' went around to many tables offering special slices of meat from a skewer, but never came to my table.  I had eaten at this place many times before while traveling, and only stopped this time because it was convenient to the highway exit.

Do not waste your time or money to go here.  They were rude and made no effort to resolve the discrepancy between the price posted on every table what they actually charge!

Here you think to be in China. Very huge piace with many reserved rooms with typical round table even for 50 persons if you need. The food are very nice and here we've find some speciality that we havent find in others chinese restaurants. Must try!
Very good quality and nice looking place. Had to wait a little to much and after asking multiple times for more wasabi they still were not bringing it.... It was pretty annoying.
I think it looks good, just eat whatever you want and pay only €9.90. Well, I saw some people eating four times.
Best value for money buffet in Padova, chinese and japanese food
It's basically a smaller version of the other location in Padova. Students have a 10% discount. I wouldn't say it sells "Street Food Catanese", since it sells things that you won't find in Catania.

Very kind and helpful staff.
The sandwich was good, but noticeably smaller than the advert on Google.
Prices were normal.
It's a shame the brioches arrived a little stale.
Maybe I'll try again.
I tried the new Catanese pistachio mafaldina. It was amazing, I'll be back to try the others 🤤🤤🤤

Great restaurant with high-quality food and a clean, peaceful atmosphere. The staff were very friendly, respectful, and attentive. What made our visit truly memorable was that they kindly offered us complimentary tea and baklava at the end of our meal. Such a thoughtful gesture! We really enjoyed our experience and would definitely come back
AMAZING. We loved it. The owner is the most kind and helpful. The food is delicious and juicy. The place is clean, comfortable and most welcoming. Loved it.

I had a wonderful experience at this Persian restaurant in Padova. The food was authentic, flavorful, and clearly prepared with care. The kebabs were perfectly grilled, the rice was fragrant, and the appetizers were delicious. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff were very friendly and attentive. It’s a great place to discover Persian cuisine or enjoy a comforting meal with friends. I will definitely come back!🇮🇷
Delicious food and welcoming atmosphere. If you want to try a real Iranian kabab, you need to go there!
The food was very delicious and reminded me my beautiful country. If you want to try a great Persian food I definitely recommend this restaurant

I'm a Chinese and I dont think the food is up to par. Dishes came out to be very far from the menu presentation. Fish ball soup tastes sourish probably from the vinegar used, pork ribs are tasteless (frozen meat?) and the prawns weren't fresh at all

I have to be honest and say that this was a very disappointing meal - the food looked nothing like the picture on display on the menu - mine tasted very bland and had tiny, fatty pieces of beef; nothing like the black sauce beef I am more familiar with. The service was well below par. Totally disappointed and I wished I had stuck yo my guns and hone a little further down for a panini. Never again

Food is genuine. Chinese recipes and all but service was so bad. The indian man throw the plates for us like he was angry we were even there. Place is rather dirty. Not recommended for non chinese. That's it
Authentic Chinese food, better than many other so called European Chinese food.
Probably the best Chinese restaurant in Padua , if you like real Chinese food.

I’ve been to Brunch Republic in Padova twice, and both visits were excellent. The food was fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented, with plenty of options to choose from. The atmosphere is welcoming, modern, and perfect for a relaxed brunch.

A special thank you to Leila, who was my waiter on both occasions. She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional, making sure everything was perfect throughout my visits. Her warm attitude and great service made the experience even more enjoyable.

It’s always a pleasure to come here, and I will definitely be returning. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and outstanding service in Padova!

The food was good overall and the menu offered a nice variety of options. There were, however, two minor things I didn’t particularly like. Firstly, the coconut cloud matcha contained a few small lumps; nonetheless, it was still an enjoyable drink. Secondly, I found it a bit irritating that the granola bowl was described on the menu as being served with honey, when it was actually made with maple syrup 🫣 It still tasted good, but it would be better to present it accurately on the menu.

Brunch Republic was amazing. The service was excellent from the moment we walked in and everyone was so friendly and attentive. The food was absolutely delicious and everything tasted fresh and flavorful. The atmosphere was wonderful with great music, adorable decorations, and a fun welcoming vibe overall it was a fantastic experience and I would definitely recommend brunch Republic to anyone looking for a great brunch spot will definitely be back. Leila was our server!

Monday at 10A.
Understaffed is really the only criticism I have. If you’re not in a rush, you will be fine.
The salmon dish was great, eggs were cooked well.
If you’re craving an egg type breakfast or brunch, it’s one of the few that offer in Padova.
Food was delicious. My only criticism is the loud rap music, and how do you order a regular black coffee not an Americano?

The pizza is top tier, and we absolutely love it! The owner was warm and friendly; we will definitely come again.😊
Thank you!!

I lived across the street for a few months and got pizza here at least once a week. This was nearly a decade ago, but I still think about their pizza to this day. I hope to visit Padova again some day, and if I do, Stuzzico will be my first stop.
Absolutely loved everything we ordered.
Fast and delicious.

This was the worst pizza in padova, I ordered a diavola for 7€ and it was awful. It was burnt and dry and the toppings were not fresh:/
Italy should enforce pizza minimum laws :/
Celebrated a friends birthday, honestly great service, food was good and great quality, everything was clean and orderly
Really good food. Total ended up being €50 for two people, all you can eat lunch + 2 waters (Sunday). For the quality, it was a great price. Service was good and fast, all the pieces looked good.
Kind staff, fast service, but quite small portion and limited amount of sashimi.
The lunch selection isn’t very big unfortunately but the food is great, service is fast, and the all you can eat price is completely reasonable
Those sushi chefs didn't bring my sushi on time. I recommend the exotic roll tho was pretty amazing.

This is a bar, brewery and restaurant located in Padua, Italy. We were lucky enough to find it in our last night in town, located about 300 feet from the hotel we were staying at.
The bartender was very friendly and let us sample the beers before we chose one. My favorite was the ESB and my wife liked the Blanche named Nina.
They had a really good looking food menu, but we already ate dinner before finding the bar. Sound definitely recommend in you're in the area.

Great pub! It was recomended by the local 🙂
Lots of kinds of craft beer on tap, and they have tasty coctails like Beer negroni or Beer spritz.
A terrific smash burger abd great beers. Great place to go.
Nice industrial pub feeing , but not many collection of drinks except for beers . If you love beer you could head here to try some local beers
Nice pub, good beer, good food. Just as you expect from pub.
Amazing service and staff😍
Amazing staff and service
Tasty food, welcoming service!

The food was fresh and excellent, and the service was great as well. I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Padova, especially since it’s located right in the heart of the city. The atmosphere is also very nice, welcoming, and friendly. 🤗
Been in italy for 10 days, eaten puzza pretty much every day. This is the  best pizza we've had so far. I'd give it 10 if I could

We had an amazing experience at this sushi restaurant today! The plating was absolutely beautiful—each dish was arranged with such care and attention to detail. The atmosphere was super calming, with a casual vibe and really pleasant music in the background. The food was the real star—so diverse! As an all-you-can-eat place, the variety on the menu was incredible, and we tried several unique dishes we just haven't seen anywhere else. We’ll definitely be coming back!
With my husband we tried all sushi resturants  and evo took our heart. Sushi and other things super good and buono ❤️
all delicious.
Great food, especially the crunchy ones. SEHR gut
Sushi top

Superb Venitian restaurant. Domestic made food. Old fashion Italian Osteria. Great wines. Tried almost all the food and it was great all of it. Mostly locals eat here but the welcome all. Must try if you are nearby.

One Bigoli to rule them all...
It doesn't get better than this. The authentic Padovan pasta, cooked to a level of al dente perfection I thought was impossible for fresh pasta. And it's super affordable, at 15€. A local, no bullshit, authentic place in Padova - a MUST! Just remember to reserve a table because they're usually packed

The spaghetti alle vongole was the best I have had! Good size clams and the pasta was not soggy. Tried the liver too and it is good with polenta! Highly recommend to get reservations beforehand as they do get busy (I tried same day reservations twice and failed)

Delicious, traditional, home cooking. If you want to experience real Italian cuisine and eat with locals, this is your place. Hand written menu that I assume changes with varying specialties of prima and secondo options. We had the tortellini with butter, sage, and speck. It was so simple, yet so delicious. Reminded me of my Nonna's cooking. A perfect taste of Padova.

The pastas we ate here were all top quality. The people were so nice and the local vibe was real. Tucked away into a cute corner and lively atmosphere. We loved the linguine alle vongole,  the tortellini, and the orecchiette. If you are in Padova, go to this place!
Delicious food, one of the best pappardelle al ragu I have had in Italy. The octopus with pepper and grapefruit is very creative.

I had a wonderful dining experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious, with every dish prepared using fresh, high-quality ingredients and full of flavor. The staff were equally impressive. They were professional, friendly, and very knowledgeable about the menu, always ready to answer questions and offer excellent recommendations. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for outstanding food and exceptional service. I will definitely be coming back!

We greatly enjoyed our dinner here, sharing an appetizer of puff pastry with freshly grilled vegetables (zucchini, eggplant) and then a risotto cooked in a tomato sauce with diced eggplant. Excellent service. We sat indoors and the atmosphere was lovely. It was exactly what we needed after a long day of visiting the sites of Padua.

I had an extremely disappointing experience here. The staff were arrogant, rude, and treated customers with clear disrespect. Their behavior felt discriminatory, and I was made to feel unwelcome for no valid reason. The black haired guy was very agressive and arogant.

Terrible, do not go there, food is tasteless crap!!!!!

No Honestly, find another place to eat.....

Tried this place for the first time, and I was disappointed. It took a long time for them to take our order, and they even served people who arrived after us first. The food wasn’t great, I couldn’t even finish it because I didn’t like it. Overall, it’s just a very average place.

KIND STAFF, QUITE FAST SERVICE, GOOD IMPROVE since the OPENING.
RECOMMEND.
In my experience, one of the best mexican restaurants in northern Italy
Good food, but nothing special really. And it’s overpriced in my opinion
Nice place, but the food doesn’t really tastes Mexican, still good tho.
Reasonably priced, cheaper compared to other pizza places however nothing special. Good place for students.
lovely pizza 🍕 lovely people 😍 lovely prices 🤑
Fast food pizza that i would buy again and again !
Very fine pizza staff is alright
Best pizza to take away!

Small lovely sushi place, the owners are very kind.
The sushi were very delicious with unique flavors.✨
Highlight was the sushi pizza, as suggested by them.
Quality is top!
What I especially liked was that when they serve the food, they explain how the sushi is made. They are very kind and attentive with their customers.
It was a beautiful discovery and I am looking forward to go back there when I’ll be back in the area!

We have visited that place in the beginning of April and found it absolutely amazing, this couple are amazing, beautiful young family Andrew and Patt. He is preparing sushiin front of you, he is amazing, each plate is a peace of art and melting in your mouth, so we will definitely visit this place next time we will travel in that region

This is a spectacular place! The best sushi ever!!!! Our experience was 20/10. The sushi was delicious, super fresh, and the atmosphere was cozy and very pleasant, they prepare the sushi in front of you :). The owners were incredibly friendly, was really nice met them. We don’t live in Padova, but when we return, we’ll definitely be back. Thank you!!!

I've been to the new standing/take away location in the downtown Padua market. Very friendly hosts, and delicious new sushi taste combinations combining tropical flavors with fresh fresh fish. Highly recommend Crazy Tuna!

Small sushi place hidden in the outskirts of Padova. Super delicious freshly made sushi, there are traditional options (nigiri/sashimi) but also fun and yummy spins on the appetisers and rolls. 100% recommended if you are a sushi fan and don’t mind a little spice!

One of the best sushi dishes we've ever had.
Excelent blend of taste, quality ingredients and plenty of variety.
We were positively impressed.

Beautiful restaurant with very friendly and polite staff. The food was fantastic. We have ordered the eat as much as you like for 24 euros and everything we tried was very tasty. One of the best sushi we have had.
Good food, good staff, highly recommended
New great place on my culinary map of Europe
Very good sushi at a great price for all-you-can-eat lunch! Fast and kind staff
Friendly staff and great service 👍
We found this hidden gem with deep shade during hot summer day. Food and service were perfect, and we noticed that a lot of locals were having their lunch here. All in all, full recommendations

This place has such a great vibe—relaxed, vibrant, and friendly. It’s the kind of place where you can grab a drink, chat for hours, and just feel at home. The staff is super welcoming, the prices are fair, and there’s always a nice mix of people, from students to locals. They serve several different types of spritz, so there’s definitely something for everyone. Whether you’re there for an aperitivo with friends or just to unwind, it never disappoints. Definitely one of my favorite spots in Padova!

One of our favourite haunt these days. They have a humongous spritz offering, covering all sort of preference. Price for a spritz starts from €4. It is so popular, sometimes you have to be on the lookout for an empty table.

The worst experience ive ever had. The staff is very rude they were arguing with us over the orders and gave us 10 different instructions when we asked what’s the best way to order a drink if we want to pay separately. Definitely never visiting again
just perfect
Perfect✌🏻
Delicious

I've been here for lunch several times and really like the place and the food, and the staff is friendly.
There's a variety of vegetarian dishes.
And you can choose whether to order with your tablet or by scanning the QR code with your phone.
I've always found a seat without having to reserve.
The lunch menu costs €16 during the week, and a large bottle of water is €3, keeping it under €20 per person.

Oh, if not tomorrow, I'll be back at SushiAmo the day after tomorrow.
I've known the place since 2020; it was previously called Sanshi and under different management.
I'm happy to return and eat on the veranda every time; I find it charming and quieter than the main dining room. The staff is friendly and helpful. Even the all-you-can-eat lunch option is more interesting than other places I've tried. See you very soon at 🍣 Amo!!! 💜
Cool place with nice chill atmosphere. They have Czech beer - Krušovice. The french fries were not so good.
The place to go if you are a beer lover! Great choice of beverages and accompanying dishes. Helpful staff and a wonderful atmosphere.
Great place and excellent service, especially that of the waitress Clara who is a sweetheart

Berlino is the first pub I walked in when I move to Padova 5 an a half years ago.
It’s been one of my locals for years.

And they’re even supporting our basketball team!

Come here, enjoy a pint, be merry, go home and be happy. Easy choice.

It’s a decent place. It would be nice if they considered having music on the background while people is drinking in the back room by the pool table. Maybe when I went it was the exception, idk.
Drinks are too small. Asked for a margarita with double shot and I felt robbed. They gave me a really small margarita and it didn’t taste like it had two shots on it but less.

Found this place by Google. It was very good. Good service and good sushi 🍣.  Even listened to my request of no shrimp. Very clean.
I highly recommend this restaurant.
Absolutely the best sushi

Wonderful! Everything was delicious, and I believe the staff are Japanese rather than the usual Chinese folks making Japanese food. The service was a bit slow, but we came for lunch and it wasn't too busy. The quality of the food makes up for what the service lacks, in my opinion. Highly recommended!
After our meal, we were also offered complimentary shots of limoncello and meloncello.  How awesome is that?
Top
Kind staff, fast service. Good kebab. Lots of Indian dishes

I walked in. It smelled of rotten fish. I called my uncle, the owner of the building across the street, and he explained that the Russian Revolution had a negative impact on the shop. I recommend trying the typical Sardinian dish, "Cagliari in Serie B."
A small place near the station, mostly for takeout. Friendly staff, and the kebab sandwich wasn't as bad as I thought. Convenient for eating on the go.

Everything was very good and the staff were very kind. I'll definitely be back.
The only negative was the faucet was dirty with shit.
Super kind and young staff, clean place. Amazing prices. Pizza portafolio a bit a let down. Lots of dough, little tomatoes sauce and mozzarella. Need to try the other pizzas. High potential.

A small, unusual student pizzeria for quick service. But the pizza is exceptionally good. Very good, even. The guys try and bustle around to make sure everything is top-notch. Thank you so much for the unique opportunity to use the unofficial bathroom with a tiny baby.
The staff is friendly and the pizza is perfect.

Good margherita, good service, and clean. I will come again to try the other options! 🙂

Also, I recommend getting a salt shaker.
Amazing pizza very delicious

And the food? Ooohhhhh Divine. Every dish was a visual masterpiece that tasted even better than it looked.
​Talk about the textures; it was flawless balance of crisp, velvety, and tender elements.
​And the Flavors? Hmm mmm Bold yet remarkably nuanced. The chef possesses a rare mastery of contrast, allowing complex flavor profiles to unfold beautifully with every single bite.
​Now the Verdict, yes the verdict: This restaurant doesn't just serve food; it serves an experience. Between the royal treatment and the fascinating culinary introductions, it is worth every single penny. A flawless 10/10.

We had a lovely dinner at Tolo Rasa on a Friday evening. We felt sorry for Chef Luca as we were the only guests that evening. Despite that unusual circumstance, the Chef and his two kitchen staff and a lovely waitress presented a wonderful selection of dishes we chose from two tasing menus.
Everything we tried reflected great care in preparation and presentation and was described by Chef Luca.

Food is very good. Chef was meticulous preparing the dishes with his sou chef in the kitchen.  Step out to explain the dishes. We had such a wonderful meal there. Price is very reasonable for the quality of food.   Highly recommend it.

A Culinary Symphony Nestled in the Heart of Padova

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

From the moment we stepped into Tola Rasa, we knew we were about to embark on a culinary journey like no other. The warmth of the place enveloped us, setting the stage for an unforgettable dining experience.

As a vegetarian, I was absolutely thrilled with the dedicated 6-course vegetarian delight that was on offer. Each dish was a masterpiece, carefully crafted with a harmonious blend of fresh ingredients that tantalized the palate in a symphony of flavours and textures. It was evident that the chef has an innate talent to transform simple ingredients into gourmet delicacies that spoke to every sense.

The staff were the epitome of professionalism, balancing a friendly demeanor with impeccable service, making us feel both valued and comfortable throughout our dining experience. The personal touch in their service made our evening feel incredibly special.

But what truly set Tola Rasa apart was the atmosphere. Cosy yet refined, it provided the perfect backdrop for a culinary journey that felt both exclusive and welcoming, a place where gastronomy meets artistry in a ballet of flavours and emotions.

As we left, we couldn't help but feel a certain longing, a desire to return to this haven of culinary excellence nestled in the heart of Padova. Tola Rasa, you have our hearts and our utmost appreciation for a dining experience par excellence. We cannot wait to return and relive this delightful escapade. Until then, Tola Rasa remains a gem in Padova's crown, a place where every meal turns into a cherished memory.

- Joakim
Booked an Xmas tasting menu and was extremely impressed with the invention, quality and flavor of the food served and the attention to detail. Highly recommend the place 👌

The food was mixed but overall very tasty.
The staff was pleasant.
Great atmosphere.

We had a very lovely meal at Pe Pen! We especially loved the wine selections, the tuna tartare, the delicious pasta, and the kind, attentive service. I also recommend the very fresh, generous salad. Ristorante Pe Pen is fairly priced and a very nice atmosphere.
Kind staff, good food, nice atmosphere

I have booked a table for some of my clients a table and they told me the food was absolutely amazing, except the service as it was lackable, they had to wait for ordering food and drinks and the waiters weren't friendly at all.
In the center of Padova you find a trendy restaurant PePen where you enjoy a good Italian food in a nice atmosphere!

The best: meat menu. They have a small menu for antipasto and side dishes BUT the while thing is the meat. They will ask you to stand up and go to the grill with the cooker in order to choose the type of meat and the cooking intensity. They will offer a little antipasto with bread, a special spread and meat balls. Service was gentile but a bit slow because of the way they do the meat. Food was delicious and good portions. They also have house wine at a good price. I would consider this place for a date. At the end they offer us a small shot of liquirizia. They have a small parking area outside the osteria. I would recommend to book before if you are in a big group.

Meat coma!  After you order your side dishes they send you out you to the grill side meat station to pick out your cuts and actually pieces of meat.  They recommend groups pick several different cuts and they are served family style.  We had 3 cuts, filet, strip and flank steak.  The steak is weighed and you pay based on the weight.  The steaks are seasoned and cooked perfectly.  The restaurant is tucked away in the back corner of a residential area not far from the city wall near SR47 and has free parking if you have a car.  The restaurant filled up quickly so I suggest making reservations.  We were stuffed and couldn't fit dessert but they said that they were made in house and they looked good.

Today me and my familly wisit this perfect restaurant. Personal was amaizing friendlly. Food actualy its really bomba. Vine its excelent for meet. Really best choise in paduja. Recomending for everybody.
Delicious and great service.
Excellent grilled meat, ludicrous variety of cuts. House wine recommended.
tried it for the first time and we totally love it!! the spring rolls and mo are amazing, also the staff are super welcoming, definitely coming back again! 🥰🥰

Just amazing.
Food is great and the personal is really really kind
I had the Mo’ and loved it! The meat melts in your mouth. What a treat 🤩
The food is amazing and the owners are super friendly and nice!
Very nice service. The portions are big and delicious

Really nice meal - unexpectedly good value. It is in a Padua Scenic hotspot. And incredibly careful hospitality from Agi our waiter.
It was a special meal and we had great fun. Great potatoes as well as a wonderful piece of beef and a terrific mixed fish plate. Thankyou !

Nothing really special except the really friendly staff.
The food was not really good. The tuna was raw.
The prices are high, but are same are also in the nearby restaurant.

The worst amatriciana I've ever tried! Just pasta poured in tomato sauce .. waiting 20 minutes for the rest of money after paying dinner. Even though the waitresses tried to be nice, I will never come back and never recommend anyone to come..
Amazing place to eat very near the Duomo , all the food was amazing, ug portions and very friendly staff
Good food and service, great white, local wine,we spent a nice evening there, beautiful location. Limoncello after the meal was a bonus and a nice surprise.

A charming little place that served a delicious meal to three hungry visiters to Padova.  Each of our three diners got something different and each was delighted by our choices.  The service was friendly, although a bit of Italian helped smooth the process.  The dining room decor is simple but charming.  The restaurant is easy to find on a side street.

the food was not good and I think it’s overpriced based on the quality and amount of servings. The pasta with pistachio was very bitter, I don’t taste the pecorino, and the pancetta was put instead of guanciale as mentioned in the menu (see photo). They also don’t have other options of non-alcoholic beverage, just coca-cola. We paid 130€ for two persons without even a wine. I think it’s too much for Padova.

Me and my daughter had an amazing meal at this lovely little restaurant run by 2 sisters.
The food was to die for. Fried courgette flowers. 2 types of pasta . Rabbit and potato and a delicious chocolate and orange dessert.
Would thoroughly recommend if you want something homely and yummy 😋

Great food and service. Awesome wine, Malbec was amazing. Prices are average. My bill was on the higher side due to the amount of wine I ordered.

Note that the location on Google Maps is off by ~50m. The osteria is directly at the street, not in a backyard. Once you found the caffe you are in the right area.  There are no tables in the street.

Majority of patrons were locals, I think I was the only tourist. Happy to return when I visit Padua again.

With an atmosphere of relaxed refinement, a classic menu and the high level of excellence il pozzetto is a causal place to enjoy the traditional Venetian dishes .. we really enjoyed the baccalà alla vicentina and the caprese cake!!! Hope to go back there soon !! Highly recommended

this was our first night in the city and close to our hotel so we thought we try the restaurant out when we walked in no one was there they already had an attitude we sat down. I couldn’t decide  so I ask waiter about cod which I never had they suggested   I excepted that suggestion. (Sorry I did that )I really didn’t like it. I thought it was too salty did not eat it they could’ve cared less. I also had potatoes which were like cook earlier and reheated not good at all. We also had risotto dish it was just ok The waiter came over and said you didn’t like it. Nothings was wrong with it !!you !!have to pay for it. (no problem ) I was planning to do that but I just didn’t like his attitude then he said would you like a dessert? I said OK we had the cheesecake I assumed he meant because I didn’t like the fish ( big mistake) but no he didn’t. He added that to the bill the cheesecake was good  !!it was a not a good experience here I’ve eaten at other restaurants since that one and they’ve all been good experiences sorry that  I was-treated-that  way on my first night  that is definitely not good customer relations skills  !guess  just didn’t care   so just be cautious if you go, you never know , it was a not a good experience for us !!!!!

First time in Padova and I just had the most amazing explosion of flavours in my mouth from the starter I chose, which was the Seared Scallops with aromatics and crispy guanciale. Wow! The flavours were just incredible. The scallop mousse was a nice touch too. The team here is friendly and warm. I arrived alone after checking a few places on a cold Friday night and settled wit taking advantage of the serene ambiance of this authentically rustic interior after a hectic and very exhausting flight/day..well, I made the right choice! they made me feel at home with true local hospitality.

Next, Entrecote steak with forest mushrooms and very soft finely grated truffle, mildly peppered. Another winner! Cooked perfectly as I had requested, medium without any runny blood. The quality of the meat was top and exquisitetely prepared.

Tiramisu was a cute little serving which was a perfect portion after I stuffed myself and it had just the right sweetness to it that I needed.

My pictures honestly don't do justice to the taste and presentation of the food.
Overall, a very beautiful discovery on my first and last night in Padova. Grazie mille! Tornerò!
I was here twice during my Padova stay for a dinner. Completely happy about everything. There was a friendly waitress speaking English. Nice!

A superb restaurant tucked away behind the main square. If you are looking for a
‘Non Tourist’ taste of Padova, this is it. Super efficient and friendly team delivering high quality well cooked dishes promptly with a wine list to cover every conceivable taste. We eat there on consequtive evenings it was so good. Highly recommend.

We ordered the steak and the lasagna asparagus
Side dish was the coleslaw salad and potato
The steak was very good the lasagna was ok and lacked of taste
Potatoes were not my taste
Service was non friendly
Best Pizza in Italy! Very affordable prices and they have the nicest staff!
If you are in Padua, you have to visit this place, definitely one of the best pizza in Italy.
Ok
Super

Grano Pizzeria in Padua is a great place for pizza lovers!

- Price: The pizzas are incredibly affordable and high-quality, making them excellent value for money.

- Home Delivery: The home delivery service is fast and reliable, perfect for those who want to enjoy a good pizza in the comfort of their own home.

- Friendly Owner: The owner is very friendly and welcoming; you can immediately see his passion for his work.

Plus, if you don't want to order takeout, you can also eat there at the counter, enjoying your freshly baked pizza.

In short, Grano Pizzeria in Padua is a place I recommend to all pizza lovers. The price is fair, delivery is fast, and the owner is truly friendly.

Try the calzone; it's phenomenal; you can see it in my photos.

If you liked the review, leave a like 👍🏼 so more people can discover this pizzeria!

I initially thought that a large restaurant would at least have good customer service; now it seems it's just a large place with an even bigger temper.

After finishing my drink, I politely asked for another, but the person on the other end was incredibly impatient, blurting out, "Aren't eight bottles per table enough?" Their tone was so aggressive, as if customers weren't there to spend money, but to beg.

Even more ridiculous, a woman next to me simply asked for a takeout container and was also publicly berated. The woman, who wasn't young, stood there obediently taking the scolding, not daring to utter a word. To run a business and treat customers like punching bags is truly astonishing.

Whether the food was good or not is forgotten, but this arrogant and condescending attitude is more conspicuous than the signboard. A word of advice to the restaurant owner: a large business is fine, but don't be a bad person. Otherwise, sooner or later you'll only have empty tables and no repeat customers.

Poor food: rice from days ago, cold, and arrived a quarter of an hour after all the other dishes arrived. We thought it was being prepared, but it looks like it came from another restaurant. The broccoli was cold (by cold, I mean, not even lukewarm). We didn't get a valid explanation for the issues we reported.
Poor service: terrible welcome, they handed us the menu in the middle of the corridor without even assigning us a table.
Receipt available upon request.
It's incredibly popular!

I visited Furin Sushi and had a very good experience. The restaurant is clean and well organized. The staff are polite, helpful, and fast. The sushi is very fresh and delicious, and the menu has many good options. The presentation of the food is beautiful and the portions are satisfying. The atmosphere is calm and comfortable, which makes the meal more enjoyable. The prices are reasonable for the quality of the food. I would definitely recommend this place and would love to visit again.
Quite big variety  of food. Delisios and well served. The staff is quick and very polite
They were so kind and smiling all the time !! Sushi was so good, beautiful place ! We loved it and definitely will come more 🩷

Incredibile food of amazing quality at a price that's more than fair. The service was quick, incredibly friendly and also accommodating to our non-italian speaking group. I would 100% recommend taking the "All you can eat" offer as you will definitely be covering the cost, the food is that good.
A very warm and welcoming atmosphere the moment you walk in. Most fresh fish I've had from a restaurant in Padova. Definitely the best place for sushi in Padova.

Outstanding meal, possible the best we have had in Italy. Great staff and plenty of gluten free options for those with Celiac. Happened upon it on a walk and was seated immediately with no reservation.

I was concerned about this place, because of some reviews, but why not, don't judge in advance, right?
Dishes were really tasty, fresh, i like it. Service aaaaa.... little bit questionable, not bad, but not excellent. Desserts, like for me, far too sweet, but a lot of people can like it.

If, but only if you want to eat secondi in size of antipasti but priced as expensive secondi that's the place for you. Additionally, you will be seated among shop's shelves and empty boxes.
The food itself is overdone. Nothing special. The ladies toilet was broken and the dirty men toilet was the only one. Three waitresses kept talking behind the bar instead of taking care of the only toilet.
We were looked down upon by the waitress when we asked about the wine. Well, never forget the Italian waitresses know everything about the wine.
Avoid!

Walked past it a few times whilst sightseeing in Padova. It looks more like a shop than a restaurant but it is both.
Great meal with some exceptional and different Italian food. The waitress was lovely and kind. It was quiet when we got in (about 7.30pm) but got busier a little later. It is a bit more expensive but worth it.

The menu has various options. The food is good. The pasticcio and arancini were delicious. However, I have to say that the service was disappointing. Worst service I have ever experienced in Padova. 15min for a glass of wine. 20min wait for two espressos.

affable and friendly service! also gluten-free products.
we will definitely be back, your pizza has won us over. thank you, grazie

absolutely beautiful experience, went in there didn't have to wait, got us a table. the quality of the foods were really good. You do have some limits on the order placement every 10 minutes. But otherwise very nice service and atmosphere. 10/10 absolutely recommend.

The dinner menu has a very wide range of plates for all tastes. The service was fast and friendly. The atmosphere is pleasant and quiet. The bathrooms are clean.
We enjoyed our all you can eat menu. The quality-price ratio is better compared to other restaurants of this type in Padova. It is among our top choices of all you can eat restaurants in Padova, and we love asian food.
Most reliable and good value all-you-can-eat sushi joint in the province of Padova.

Be warned, queues for the restrooms can be a problem during peak hours, as there's only one in the establishment.

Disappointing lunch at TreQuarti Bistro’ in Padua. Service was good, but the polpette and cicchetti tasted like they weren’t fresh despite a pleasant presentation. We ordered polpette, cicchetti, and a salad. Appearance good, flavour not fresh.

Lovely restaurant that I went to four times because the food was great and the staff was lovely, very friendly and attentive to the patrons. I would definitely go here again of I'm in Padova. The food is a mix of traditional and more modern options. And the location is great. Much love to the waiters for greeting me every time with a smile and a cleared out table
I celebrated my graduation here everything was perfect. Everyone was so kind, the food was very delicious and the price was reasonable. I definitely recommend it!!

Da Fathi in Padua offers a unique blend of halal

Kebap/Pizza place of unusual standards. Whatever they make it’s good quality, in a good price and made by specialists. Honestly recommended.

My friend brought me there: the shrimp toast was the best I had in many countries, I had Umami menu: there was wakame salad, 4 dim sum, 2 shrimp toasts and two pieces of salmon and noodles with shirmps and veggies. I also had mochi ice cream.

I really appreciated the use of their own products, such as the sweet and sour vegetables, the raspberry jam in the tiramisu and especially the liqueurs: meloncello, sage, walnuts... Delicious food and a very kind service team :) will be back for sure.

Great atmosphere. Problems with food. Terrible service.

1. Atmosphere: It's adorable. It's close to where I live. It looks like they have great menu options - very American-inspired with the Airstream trailer, cacti decor, and Mexican dishes, and they even sell Pendleton goods. Fun! I've been in Italy for years now, and this isn't common, so I was excited to try it.

Atmosphere: 5 stars.

2. Food: Both my friend and I ordered avocado toast. Everything about the avocado toast would have been great - the avocado, the thinly sliced radishes, lightly wilted spinach, the fennel, the pumpkin seeds, a big slice of multigrain bread - all wonderful, and the first few bites were delicious. Then I got to the egg. It was raw. Both of our eggs were raw. The whites were not cooked, and the egg was cold, so the raw white part spilled all over the yummy veggies and made it really gross. We did our best to eat around it, but that was tough, considering it went everywhere.

Food: 3 stars because it WOULD have been awesome had it not been for the egg issue.

3. Service: We were the first people to arrive at noon for brunch. The hostess/waitress sat us and then got on her phone and quickly forgot about us. 10 minutes passed. I had to flag her down just to get some water. Again, we were the only people there. After the meal, when she came to take our plates, she didn't ask how it was (even though nearly half of the dish was left and both of us had an egg puddle on our plates), but I politely mentioned the problem anyway. It was merited. She rudely mansplained to me, as though I was a child, that the eggs were "POACH-ED," gesticulating and over-enunciating that "POACH-ED" eggs have to be raw. I tried to tell her that was not correct, that there are different levels of poached, but none of them are RAW. Yes, the yolk should be runny, but the whites should be cooked. Or rather cook-ED. And excuse me, but have you ever heard of customer service?! Don't try to make people feel like idiots because you served them salmonella on toast. Rude is rude. Do better.

Service: 1 star.

If you ever find yourself in or near Padua, Belle Parti is an absolute must for dinner. From start to finish, the experience is exceptional. Glasses of wine, as opposed to bottles, were not on the wine menu but the waitress when asked offered a very nice glass of wine for 9 euros. Cesar is doing a great job. He is very professional, helpful, and kind. I’m very satisfied with his service. Highly recommended!

Cafeteria located on the back of platform one with outside tables the inside is small at an L shape with food display one side and coffee bar in the corner. My coffee was good and sandwich also. Basic place where you get coffee, pastries, sandwiches and pizzas. The food and coffee are of good quality. The staff was very friendly. It is a busy place in the train station, therefore the athmosphere is accordingly  We had cafe americano, which was very strong - it will keep you awake for a while 😂

A regular place in the middle of the main station. It's okay for a quick breakfast, but the waiting time was a bit long and it wasn't the cleanest either. Good breakfast menu for okay prices, given the location.

Amazing Pizzeria on the outskirts of Padova.

Great neighbourhood pizza spot! Filled with locals so you know it’s good. Extensive pizza selection at very reasonable prices. Staff was also very helpful and friendly. 100% would return!

Staying at ac nearby and were very impressed by this local pizzeria. Delicious base and a huge variety of options. Fantastic food. 😋😋The most amazing pizza variety I've had. Amazing staff and even better service given we had specific dietary requirements. Suitable for Vegetarians. The pizzas are quite small, however the price is accordingly low ranging from 3.90€ to 6€. Great food-quality-price ratio.
We had a zingara and a white toscana and we got the two things you wish for when you want a good pizza - simplicity and taste. Also, they got Forst - the best italian lager.
We loved this place! I read all the good reviews and decided to give it a try. Really good pizza. And the service 🤌

SO GOOD. Drink menu is insane, food menu is even more insane. Lots of creative cocktails, great quality food, and good prices. The vibes were fun and the restaurant was busy, but very little wait. The staff were super nice and welcoming. It’s also in a great area, definitely would recommend!

The food is definitely delicious and thoughtfully prepared—you can really tell that care and attention go into each dish, and it feels worth the price. However, the portion sizes are indeed on the smaller side.

The restaurant is well located and has a pleasant atmosphere, but having only one restroom feels a bit unreasonable. Another point I wasn’t fully satisfied with was the seating situation: when the staff told us all standard tables were fully booked, we were seated at a higher table. I think it would be more reasonable for the restaurant to have additional chairs on hand, as it would make the dining experience more comfortable for guests.

That said, the staff were still very friendly. Even though we had brought bubble tea with us and placed it on the table, they didn’t stop us from drinking it.

I look forward to seeing the kitchen develop more dishes in the future.🧡

The food is what you’d expect from a chain such as the roadhouse. The chicken fillets and chicken wings were cooked perfectly .

Nero di Seppia is a fantastic little restaurant located in Padua right where Ponte Corvo is (2 minutes from Saint Anthony's Cathedral).
At the helm is one of the most talented lady chefs I have ever had the pleasure of dining from.

The menu is simple and concise, yet every dish is a poetic symphony of flavors. The description, both in Italian and English truly showcase the creativity of the chef while constructing the plates.

We had four apetizers:

- Baccalà Mantecato -
A dish made of cod blebded with milk and spices untill it acquires a buttery texture (Mantecatura). Very traditional in the Veneto region.

- Braised Octopus with white Beans -
Simple yet elegant. The octopus was tender and flavoful which combined with the white beans and a drizzle of fresh Olive Oil created a smooth silky finish in your palate.

- Zucchini Flowers filled with Ricotta and crispy Kale -
This is another traditional dish from the north of Italy (Fiori di Zucca). Great flavor, crispy on the outside and soft and creamy on the inside. All of it with accompanied by a smooth and velvety sauce with saffron.

- Porcini Mushrooms with White Polenta and Gorgonzola -
Fresh Porcini Mushrooms are a seasonal find, nornally in the fall when you have rains. I am lost in words on how to describe the flavors of this excellent combination. White Polenta is a staple of Veneto's cuisine and to see this great simple dish stand out so beutifully was a truebsensory pleasure.

We concluded our meal by trying two desserts:

- Mille Foglie on the spot with fresh forest Berries -
Delicious ! (Look at the photos)

- "Sugoi" of grapes
A grape pudding (although with more texture) it was marvelous! (Chek the photos)

I HIGHLY recomend you ask the waiter to select a dessert wine to pair with your meal, we did and it was perfect.

All in all we spent 100 euros and as you can tell both of us left extremely happy.

Thank you again to the establishment for such a serene and flavorful experience.

Prices are low, the pizza is tasty, and the whole place has that comforting, slightly chaotic charm of a place that’s been doing its thing since forever.
