Stuff speaks English, it is also a huge advantage.

We had a dinner here. Or at least we thought it will be a small dinner. We finished by having antipasti, pizza, deserts and drinks. Atmosphere was topical Italian. Everyone happy and talking loudly but not disturbing. Outside 36 * Celsius but inside..air conditioning 👍. We took a tabel at the second floor. Starting hour:19.00 on Sunday. 1 Aperitivo Casa, 2 lemonade, 1 cocktail of shrimps with a special sauce, 1 melanzane alla parmigiana (aubergine with tomato sauce and parmigiana), 1 pizza Massaria and 1 tiramisu + coperta= 56 €. Everything was delicious. The tomato sauce had no taste of canned one. So, nice place. If I ever come again in Padova for sure I'll not gone miss this place. 👍

During our travels through the historical cities of Italy, we also try to find authentic cuisine. Visiting Capovolta two nights in a row turned out to be more than a good choice. Pleasant environment, tasty food and great service with which we could experience very intense cheering during this year's football Euro match. A big surprise that the Italian restaurant serves our hearty and national Pilsner Urquell, although this time we preferred good wine. We tried pizza, gnocchi and pasta from the meals and everything was perfectly fine.
Greetings to everyone from the service and we hope that they are still rooting for the right team today.

Our favourite pizza restaurant in Padova. The first bite packs a nice and subtle crunch, followed by the tasty sauce and ample toppings! Overall an excellent pizza with quality ingredients. Shout out to the very friendly service ad well!
Affordable price, tastes great
Everything is prepared in advance, you can just order it yourself, the price is reasonable, it's a large cafeteria.
Affordable price and delicious taste
A fantastic restaurant
Food was simple and nice. Exactly home food.

The best: the cheap menu. Spicy as it should be. The menu is just 10€ and is a full meal, it will fill u up for sure. Also the other menu items are good enough to fill u. The bread is really good, warm and fresh. The space inside is a bit small but there is not a lot of people here so it's not even necessary to book a table.
The food itself is good but not anything amazing. But where it out shines every other indian restaurant in the town is the price. Amazing price and quantity.

This is one of my favorite spots in Padova!! I’ve both dined in and taken out several times and have had great experiences with both. They always deliver that complex burst of flavor that I expect from Indian food. There’s also such a wide selection. I’ve tried a lot of different things (naan, chapati, vegetable pakoda, butter chicken, chicken afghani, chicken biryani, chicken saag, gulab jamun, mango lassi…) and every single one has been really tasty. The portion sizes aren’t huge but the prices are really really good. Highly recommend.

No no no. Giant hair in my food! I puked! Had to throw it all away too. Something about the place screams it is not hygienic. This is absolutely unacceptable 🤮😔. Also they serve everything in extremely bad quality plastic containers. I swear to god if you eat out of those you will definitely get cancer. Ugh. Can't believe they allow this kind of behaviour in Italy.

Ohhhhh... friends... prepare your bellies... it was delicious!!! No, not that!! It was legendary!!! Please, also leave room for dessert. I want to come back to this city to come to this restaurant again. Thank you so much ❤️
The restaurant was closed, but we could eat in the afternoon. Only pasta was not available, because they make it fresh - in the afternoon - for the night. The seafood was fantastic, we loved it!

Amazing seafood restaurant in Padova.  Serve also Japanese sushi, sashimi.  Delicious deep fry mixed seafood platter.  Next to the restaurant it offers an exclusive delicatessen store with restaurant: Premium seafood distributor

Nice restaurant. Good quality food, prices are fine, there is an average selection.
The environment is new and in good condition, very  well organised and nice furniture.
Staff were totally respecting the covid safety measures. I will come back for sure!
very delicious seafoods and friendly staff

Our favorite pizza in Padova! The staff is friendly and professional, the food is great and the whole atmosphere is just great. High quality, fresh ingredients, great topping combinations. Our must try pizzas: Regina with fried eggplants (the absolutely best pizza ever), PPT, Sulimo, Giraffona, Novara and Melkor. But really don’t miss out the Regina, it’s a must.

They offer a wide variety of pizzas, not just the classics, which is a great bonus for those looking to try something new. I absolutely loved the friendly and attentive service. The pizza sizes are impressively large, and the dough is perfectly soft, striking a balance between chewy and light. The toppings were fresh, and each bite was bursting with flavor. On top of that, the ambiance is warm and inviting, making it a comfortable spot to dine with friends or family. Overall, it’s a fantastic place for pizza lovers, and I will definitely be returning soon!

Visited the pizzeria twice, the service and food were incredible both times. The waiters are very friendly and kind. Personally I would suggest the fried zucchini flower pizza (Margo), as whenever I have a pizza craving, its always for this specific pizza. Will definitely be visiting again!
Very delicious pizza, nice staff. Friendly place.

Very nice pizzeria, and other typical veneto plates. Reccomended if you have an hotel nearby ( we have a little child and we went back twice in one week, as we wanted to avoid to walk in Padua centre, the food was delicious, and price fair).

20251113 - always a favourite restaurant to come whenever i am in italy. Ambience was nice in this restaurant that used to be a villa. Ordered raw seafood platter that is always fresh, and amazing lobster pasta. Highly recommended to dine here.

I went for dinner on September 20 with a friend and his girlfriend.  The restaurant is excellent.  We ordered the raw menu and one was better than the other.  The service is very good and the wine list is good too. Also the menu options of pasta and cooked fish looked very good

At first glance, the restaurant looks beautiful and well-designed, so we genuinely walked in with high expectations. Unfortunately, things went downhill quite fast.

We waited quite a while at the entrance because no one was there to seat us. When we finally sat down, we chose the menu degustazione as it was recommended as “the best way to eat here.” Sadly, every course was a disappointment: overly salted dishes, rushed plate removal, and visibly agitated staff.

For a restaurant of this calibre, the service was surprisingly poor. Our wine wasn’t poured unless we specifically asked several times, and even then we were mostly ignored.

The worst moment was when a waiter dropped a mug from a plate. It shattered on the table, the liquid splashed everywhere including one of our coats and pieces of the mug remained all over. The waiter acted as if nothing had happened. No tablecloth change, no proper clean-up… we literally spent the rest of the evening with broken pieces under the table.

And to finish the night, there was an inexplicable queue to pay. Instead of bringing the bill at the table like in any proper restaurant, everyone had to stand and wait at the counter more like a market than a dining experience.

Overall, the entire evening from service to food was a big let-down. Definitely not what we expected, and unfortunately not somewhere we would return.

We have organized dinner for bigger group (up to 28 people) and specified that we want to be in main room next to the pool and they have sent us a picture of place that we will be, so we confirmed that. Unfortunately they have placed us in some room that was not on the picture and that ruined our dinner…
Excellent diner. Well done
Great halal fried chicken spot. There wasn't one in the center but this one was great!!
good fried chicken and halal. open till night.

just expensive for nothing the only one who charges 6€ for kebabb in tutta padova, the man doesn't even know how to wrap a tortilla, he literally wraps it with the aluminum insinde, and if you wanna eat it make sure you have a bucket beneath your mouth, because it will leak with sauces. the attitude of this guy is like if your begging him for it, maybe he doesn't know you are paying him 😏
Not recommended expensive and no quality
Came from England and was struggling to find halal food. Had a fillet burger and wings and chips. Food was very good and fillet burger was a very decent size. Really pleased.
Beautiful restaurant with great seafood, I would recommend it. Even fish fry is super, you can also enjoy fried frogs and eels.

A truly delicious lunch, from appetizer to dessert, with quality food in a truly welcoming and clean setting. Massimiliano and his team are truly special, always smiling and attentive to every need! Highly recommended!

The restaurant has ample parking, a well-kept and bright interior, and good acoustics (no need to shout to talk). The staff is all super friendly and courteous. Seafood is their specialty, everything tasty and portioned appropriately. Reasonably priced considering the seafood they serve, and prices have been high lately.
Recommended.

I dined at this restaurant a few days ago and ordered their classic fried fish. It was good, light but not as hot as you'd expect, and the portion of polenta accompanying the dish was minimal, which is why I gave it four stars. Otherwise, the service was excellent, the waiters very kind and attentive, and the restaurant was elegant and clean.

The restaurant's quality has dropped dramatically since last year. On Sunday evening, there were about 18 people in total. The two young men who appear to be the owners, since they're the only ones you see, are very good and kind in handling all the requests and tasks.
The menu has been halved and the prices have gone up. 2 starters, 1 fried dish with a side dish, and 2 glasses of prosecco and water are over €70.
The quality of the fish has completely dropped. I don't know if there's been a change in management or a generational change. However, it's a real shame for the reputation of this restaurant, which is well-known in Padua.
Unassuming spot with great food. Staff were very  friendly and helpful. I was looking for something smallish and had a simple Tagliatelle dish which was really good.
😍amazing!
Excellent appetizers and fish-based first courses. The Taranto-style mussels are fantastic. The pizza is also very good. Helpful staff. Prices are average.

For 8 years, the Sapori staff has welcomed me like family every day! Recommended for those who love feeling at home and, above all, want to eat well!
Passion and quality come first!
Thanks guys!
Quick lunches, friendly service, and excellent value. The always polite and warm staff ensure a relaxing lunch break, something we all deserve.

Best Mexican food I’ve had outside of the U.S. This place is fire!! The owner and workers are so nice and the food is exceptional. I’m a vegetarian and even for me the menu is inclusive and tastyyyyy! If you like a little kick get each of the salsas on the side to try on whatever you order! I love the spiciest one, the habanero one. It’s so good.

Anyways, I went back three times in the 2 days I was in Padova because it’s that good. I got the veggie tacos with grilled onions, peppers, mushrooms, cheese! So good. My girlfriend got the shrimp burrito with black beans, cheese, pico, guac, which I tried and was fire also!

The last time we went before leaving from our short trip, we got the churros which did not disappoint! They come with this hot caramel sauce, so good. We will get them every time from now on.

So happy we found this place while in Padova this time, we will be back when in Padova.

I think anyone would love the food.

Cheers!

My husband and I visited Mexicano Taqueria in February but I forgot to leave a review. Since we visited in February we have not stopped talking about their amazing tacos. We don’t live in Padua but have been trying to find time to make a trip back just for this restaurant (yes, it is that good). Very authentic tacos and salsa that is actually spicy. We were blown away by this little gem. We cannot wait to visit again!

A nice little street food place with big selection of mexican classics. It’s a bit pricey for this type of place, but the quality of food was very high and service great (they speak great english), so it was more than worth it. You have a big variety including vegetarian and seafood options. All in all a great place to stop for a quick meal. I would definitely recommend it!

Amazing authentic street tacos, recently updated their menu so you can now choose between taco/quesadilla/burrito for each meat, seafood or veggie filling. Authentic Mexican food is something I miss a lot here in Padova, but especially seafood tacos which are impossible to find anywhere else, and theirs are amazing 😍 the only unfortunate thing is that they have no place to sit, but 100% worth it to find somewhere to sit nearby. 10/10 - must try.

I’m Mexican in Italy for vacation and I really missed the Mexican food and flavor. I’ve been traveling around Europe and honestly I have tried other Mexican restaurants but it was okay.
But THIS place OMG, just one bite and I felt I was back in Mexico😭💗 the flavor is really really near to Mexican flavor. I had the burrito with carne asada and it was delicious!
A little pricey but is okay for what you pay and for the quality. I would loved to have chairs or tables were to sit but this is how we eat in Mexico sometimes😹 straight and with your Taco in the other hand.
The team is super friendly ✨ definitely worth it!

This is a very cool and fancy restaurant in Padova that serves incredible Tuscan cuisine. The quality of the food is truly unique and worth the visit. The meat was super tender and cooked to perfection, the pasta sauce was rich and flavorful and the dessert was the perfect ending to the meal. The price-to-quality ratio is absolute perfection here. The atmosphere is elegant and stylish, making it a great spot for a special occasion or a fancy night out. We loved it!

I went here with a local friend from Padova who recommended it as one of the best places for a Fiorentina steak 🥩🍷. The steak was exactly how it should be — soft, juicy, bloody, fresh, and full of flavor. The portion was generous too, enough to leave you completely satisfied with just one plate.

The wine list was huge (almost overwhelming for me 😅), but the staff were really helpful and guided us to pick a perfect pairing for the steak. That made the whole experience even better.

Everything from the food to the service was amazing and delightful. If you’re in Padova and want to try an authentic Fiorentina-style steak, this place is definitely worth it.

I don’t even know what to say.. I had some of the best meat I have ever tried here at this restaurant. The pasta was the best pasta I have ever tried, and the dessert was super delicious and well balanced. The restaurant was decorated in a very subtle yet classy way, and they played very nice, calm music. The service was amazing, they advised us in great detail about what to order and they were able to tell us about the dishes in great detail. I would definitely recommend the place to anyone who visits the area!
Great restaurant, food was delicious and service was great, the waiter Martin was very helpful, nice and explained everything in English. Definitely to recommend!
The ribs were delicious. Friendly staff. Fast service
We had some wine and dinner.  The service was outstanding.  We had the Paccheri which was absolutely outstanding.   Even though we spoke no Italian, we felt right at home

The best: outside tables. I Tried the aperitivo here, they gave you bread and nachos with the drinks. Also, dinner is good. Tried the grilled chicken with veggies, large enough that can be for 2 people. Unfortunately, they don't serve salads for dinner.

Perfect for an aperitif with friends. Ended up to stay for dinner and found that they were serving great and tasty dishes. The patio is a great addition. Friendly and prompt service. Can’t ask for more!

I recently visited Caffè Tinto in Padova, and it was a fantastic experience! The café has a charming and cozy atmosphere, perfect for relaxing with a cup of coffee or catching up with friends. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making me feel welcome from the moment I walked in.

Their espresso is rich and aromatic, and I highly recommend trying their homemade pastries — they are delicious! The café also offers a variety of options, from breakfast to light lunches, all prepared with fresh ingredients.

If you’re in Padova and looking for a great spot to enjoy a coffee break, Caffè Tinto is definitely worth a visit!

It is a nice place, bit snobish, with posh people and cars, ok service, good coffee, nice food, not expensive, neither cheap.  in the evening there is loud music, if you like!  I wish they would give me a teapot full of hot water for my tea, like, do you have a water problem or something? Anyway, if they did, i'd give them 5 stars :)

I went to this restaurant for dinner during the week. The starter and wine recommendation were very good. The fish for the main course and the dessert was also excellent. The dishes were creatively prepared and everything was of very good quality.

Just an amazing dinner tonight - purely by happenstance, we wandered this way - and the experience was “perfetto”.

Great food, great service - dining al fresco - could not have been happier. Not cheap, but worth the price!

One of the Best Fine Dining Experiences in Northern Italy

Tucked away on a quiet and charming street corner, this restaurant offers an exceptional fine dining experience. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with a unique charm that makes every visit special.

Helena, the owner, is a perfect host, ensuring that every guest feels welcome and well cared for. The dishes are crafted to perfection—on an entirely different level of quality and execution.

I keep returning to this place with unwavering enthusiasm. Absolutely deserving of 5 stars!
Lovely meal: very friendly and professional service, creative dishes in a refined setting. This place is worth going a bit outside of the typical tourist path in Padova
All aspects of our experience were up to par. Helpful and knowledgeable service, great ambiance, great food. Not a cheap meal but we felt we got value.
It is a nice place near to basilica but was sent away as they didn't have space for us even though most tables were empty. Not a very nice experience

A very nice authentic restaurant. Perfectly placed close to hotels. Great pasta and great service. I had ordered seafood by accident, and when told about my allergy, they were very accommodating. They understood the mistake and prepared a new course for me. Service alone is deserving of 5 stars. Food is perfect with full portions.
Hidden Gem nearby the St. Anthony Basilica. Simple but delicious food, felt like eating at gramma house. Great service and very attentive.

Very friendly helpful staff. Not extremely fluent in English but made it work easily with patience and smiles. We felt welcome and highly recommend it to others
Note: We dine earlier than most locals when traveling and find that helps with our enjoyment.

Terrible experience. A plate of spinach which were obviously frozen, still in shape of cubes. Reheated pasta (with dry swordfish), so salty I could not finish the plate, I had to leave most of it despite the fact that I don't like wasting food and I normally always finish my plate. Waiter with a bit of an attitude. No discount or compensation were offered.

The menu is quite varied, but we came here to try the cutlet. It comes in two sizes: regular and XL, with various toppings. The regular one is already huge, crispy, and cooked well—really good, worth a try. The place is small but very welcoming. The staff is very friendly. I recommend it.
Truly delicious fried gnocchi and excellent cutlet, large and well-prepared. The place is intimate and welcoming, perfect for a quiet dinner. The staff is extremely kind and attentive. Recommended.

I went during a work lunch break.
It's located at exit 10 of the ring road.
A beautiful, modern, and well-kept atmosphere.
Friendly and attentive service.
Full menu for €15 (first course, second course, side dish, water, and coffee).
The food was very good.
Ample parking.

I often go for the cutlet, which is the house specialty. It's very good and plentiful. The XXL portion is meant for two people, as it's hard to finish alone. The burgers and beers are also good. The staff are friendly and helpful. I recommend it.

I had dinner here and had a great time. The service was fast, the food was good, and the prices were fair. The decor was a bit unusual, but that's fine. The only downside was the bathroom—you can't see the toilets without the backsplash.

We had an amazing evening at Piave, the view from terrace is amazing, the old church and small bridge. The couple who runs the restaurant was very attentive to our needs, the service was amazing, the food was fantastic! We highly recommend herbs gnocchi and breated beef with merlot and soft polenta. The meat was super soft and delicious! Thank you so much!

I can’t recommend this place enough. We probably tried almost all of their starters and they were all delicious. The pappardelle was super tasty and so was the Panna cotta. The service is excellent and The atmosphere is perfect for a date night or a chilled dinner with friends. Prices are reasonable and the quality of the food is great!

We came here following all the positive reviews and weren't disappointed. Very good restaurant with reasonable prices and delicious local cuisine. They had menu in English and the waitress had enough English to communicate with us. Overall we had a great experience in this cosy and friendly hostaria.

Cute restaurant with a vibrantly decorated interior full of color, friendly service and competitive prices.

Whilst small, their menu offers a good variety of choices. Each dish we tried was delicious and made with high quality ingredients. The baby cuttlefish cooked in squid ink served with creamy polenta were tender and tasty. Their tiramisu was to die for, so creamy, smooth and decadent, whilst their lemon sorbet with licorice liquor was refreshing and zingy.

A perfect night, and some of the best octopus, tartare, and eggplant I've ever had. Gorgeous plating. Creative use of beautiful ingredients, and excellent service. Seems like poor reviews are people complaining of "small portions", which is ridiculous to me, as we were fit to burst by the end of the meal. Worst case, the prices are so reasonable, just get an extra dish. ;)

I’m pretty positive that their pizzas are top, but today I decided to try a kebab and I really think they shouldn’t sell kebabs at all. Their specialty is pizza, not kebab. It didn’t really taste like kebab unfortunately.
Other than that, they are very friendly and provide good service
Perfect pizza, perfect service, we enjoy every second of visit and every piece of pizza. Grazie!

I recently discovered this takeout pizzeria and I think it's the best in the Forcellini-Terranegra area. Crispy, not-too-thin dough, well-balanced, good-quality ingredients, and most importantly, it's still crispy when it gets to your door!
It's now a regular Sunday spot! Well done 👏

I've ordered delivery several times, and the pizzas are generally very good. The delivery guys are friendly, knowledgeable, and very fast. Unfortunately, the last time I went, I had a mishap with the pizzas (I've attached a photo), which were very burnt. It was a strange mistake that I hope won't happen again. Highly recommended if you want a medium-good pizza at a good price! (P.S.: The loyalty card and scratch-off ticket service with pizza delivery is brilliant!)

A positive and excellent review, and I rightfully give it 5 stars.
The dough is thin and crispy to perfection, and the pizza chefs are always very kind and friendly, always available to make pizza even after closing time.
The ingredients are fresh and beautifully combined.
Highly recommended and the best in the area.
Great location, good food.. too bad for the staff. Not polite and making weird faces. Smirking to each other about us customers.
Very slow service for a small order have to wait for hours
One hour and a half to eat. Got our food 40 minutes after sitting, cold, and drank coffee with all our plates still on the table. Terrible service by an arrogant young girl. Definitely terrible.
Kind staff, good and delicious  food.
It's the best stake house, it offers you variety of meat to choose from the menu, and also drinks.

Loved Simons Bistrot. We were staying in the area and were recommended the restaurant by a local. It is a relaxed, beautiful space and the food was amazing. We had 3 courses and wine, and enjoyed everything we ate. In particular the sun dried tomato pesto, stuffed courgette flowers,  the beautifully cooked steaks and I loved the tiramisu. Plenty of choice, seafood looked amazing and the service was relaxed. Would definitely visit again

We had a great meal at Simon’s Bistrot when we were visiting Padua. A nice walk from the busy tourist centre we found this delightful restaurant in a calm, traffic-free setting.  The staff were welcoming, friendly and helpful to a pair of predominantly English speakers. The menu was well designed and a couple of kilometres down the road from the standard Italian restaurant fare. Drink choices were great and advice on local and Italian wines was appreciated. We thoroughly enjoyed our evening meal and experience at Simon’s Bistrot.
Amazing food, great location, lovely staff
This restaurant was great! Excellent staff, excellent food, amazing atmosphere. We would definitely eat here again.
Beautiful food, which had great flavour and presentation, served in a lovely setting.

Lovely place, beautiful service, nice atmosphere and kind stuff. Aperol 5 euro is this a joke? I mean compare to other places in italy, i find this is quite cheap especially for this location. Love been there.
Nice food. Good price. Polite staff.
The staff was very nice. Good food. Nice atmosphere!!
The drinks are fine however a bit overpriced. The service is zero. The stuff was more than unpleasant. Not very nice experience. By the way a waiter is cute guy.
Came here for a quick drink before dinner. The ambience and small plates are satisfying.

An excellent pizza experience—light, flavorful, and made with top-quality ingredients. I visited with my partner, and we thoroughly enjoyed both the classic options and one of the house specials. I loved the pizza topped with fresh rocket!

The cooking is spot on, with no burnt areas, which is rare and much appreciated—especially considering this is one of the few traditional wood-fired ovens still permitted in the city center. The dough is perfectly leavened, making the pizza incredibly easy
Great pizzas for fair prices. Many options to choose from. Recommend!

Very good pizza, light, tasty and high quality! I came here with my family and we enjoyed both the classic types (but I ordered the famous "soppressa" salami on top, typical of this region) as well as the Specials (the one with "Puntarelle spadellate", delicious!). My regret is that I did not taste the pizza with trufle on top (I could only envy the scent of it from the table next to ours).
The cooking is perfect (no burnt areas that could be unhealthy, and this one of the very few ancient wood oven still authorized in the city centre) and so is the leavening (very easy to digest).
The staff was very kind and helpful for all our requests.
In summary, do not miss this ancient Pizzeria if you travel to Padua!
quiet atmosphere, smaller place but nice looking. the pizza was excellent, and the girls who work were nice! Mortadella with pistachios is the best!

I really enjoyed the thin-crust pizza I ordered here. It was light, crispy, and topped with fresh ingredients that made every bite flavorful. The quality is clear, and it feels like care goes into the food. My only complaint is that the prices are a bit on the high side compared to other spots. That said, if you’re looking for a well-made thin pizza, this place is definitely worth a visit.
we always eat here food was is ok but today we try to beef biryani🤮i never ever try this kind of bullshit beef biryani, i take 2/3 spin then i send back🤮🤮
I love samosa and tea here. It's cheap and very good taste
Good 👍
It's a nice restaurant..... You can find every kind of food , they display . Also have drinks..
If you want to grab something quick in the night, the place is perfect
I had steak  here 2 years ago and last night that i thought of having steak, it was the first and only place which came to mind. They make the best steak ! Also the owner is very sweet and lovely.

The worst restaurant in Abano Terme, that's probably why it was empty, three tables were occupied all night. Anyone who writes a positive review about this restaurant is LIING. The dish looks nice in the pictures but it's inedible. We ordered Picanha, we got meat that was inedible, tough, full of veins, and most importantly, totally tasteless, they put some spices in it, trying to give it at least a little flavor, but without success. The food was disastrous, but the restaurant staff was even worse. No one speaks a word of any other language except Italian, I understand that, but to have them start shouting at you because you don't understand them, that's terrible. And finally, the biggest surprise. Since you don't know Italian (google translate doesn't help, I tried) you order a specialty and when you pay they charge you 30-40% more meat because you're buying a piece of meat that you haven't seen and that no one told you how heavy it is, but since no one speaks a foreign language, they can calculate it for you as they please.  Zero stars is a lot for this restaurant

I still have to write a response to the owner.
You can lie on me as much as you want, whoever ordered a dish that is sold by the kilo, most of the reviews of your restaurant are the same as mine. You are obliged to tell people when ordering such dishes or show them if it is packaged and already weighed, how much it weighs. No normal person would order for two people! 1.5 kg of meat, but it is not worth it for you, you rather violate EU law and cheat people when it comes to payment.

Absolutely the best steak in Italy. Better than the steak I had in Florence. We do not speak Italian but we understand everything the waitress was saying to us. Get the house red wine! Amazing!! Great hospitality, wonderful people cooking and serving. I felt like I was at my Aunt's house for dinner!! Please go and support this restaurant!
Absolutely amazing place to eat a nice steak. The dessert was Absolutely amazing as well.

The food here was incredibly delicious! The staff doesn’t speak English, I think it is a family owned restaurant but the food and service were exceptional. With google translate communication was doable.

I don’t think many tourists come here, since it’s quite far away from the centre and the food was extremely affordable!! 10/10 experience, I highly recommend.

A small Roman takeout deli located on Padua's most popular university student street. Very small, seating a maximum of 4-5 people, it offers a good variety of options: pizza by the slice, meatballs in tomato sauce, sausages, Ariccia porchetta, chicory, broccoli rabe, and other options that I believe change weekly (if not daily). Everything is cooked on-site, including the bread, which deserves special mention. The owner is courteous, helpful, and full of information. Highly recommended.

10 stars! A slice of Rome in the historic center of Padua. The Roman pizza I ordered for takeout was delicious, and the supplì were crispy and definitely made to order. The owner was very kind, calling me after I placed my order to let me know that some of the supplì I'd ordered weren't available and replacing them with others, which were equally delicious (I recommend the burrata and anchovy one). I'll definitely be back in person!

I've never actually been to the pizzeria, but I've had pizza there because a friend got it for takeout. The pizza wasn't great, burned on the bottom and a little sticky.
I also believe it's more dignified to take criticism and improve rather than accuse.

I had two small pizzas at Campo de' Fiori. The place is intimate, great for takeout, and the very kind owner prepares Roman-style pizzas, meatball sandwiches with pecorino sauce and broccoli rabe, porchetta sandwiches, and first courses of the day. Super fair prices, perfect for the university street of Padua.

Spectacular place... They just opened, so I wasn't familiar with them, but if you get a chance, definitely stop by. The staff is friendly and helpful; the owner patiently explained and showed me the products and how they make them by hand. Needless to say, the Roman-style pizza by the slice is truly delicious. Plus, the prices are reasonable; a slice of Margherita costs €2.50, and it's well worth it. I'll definitely be back; I invite you to check it out!

We really enjoyed an informal meal here on a Monday night when the town was quiet and most restaurants were closed. The food was local, authentic and tasty. There are plenty of drinks to choose from and the place felt friendly and welcoming.
A small bar with a pleasant atmosphere. It is further away from the noisy main street, so it is not always full of tourists either. There is a daily menu, the coffee and aperol are delicious.

Bar with vintage decoration, all wood and alcohol bottles everywhere. The thing that got me the most was the fact that it is written the type of coffee you are taken. When I was there there were 2 types (both arabica): one from Nicaragua and the other was a mixture of different origins. The owner is nice. Also the little pastry seemed good but I didn't try them.
Small but very kind snack bar. Large variety of choices, perfect and tasty meals. The bartender is a tipical and very friendly Italian.

Owner is really professional, drinks were great as the food.

In the end I asked for shot of grappa and my God!
It was the best grappa I ever drank in my life.

Then we had polite talk about our cats (owner's cat pictured below, also the great grappa that I ordered.)

Overall - very nice.
Very good gluten free pizza and normal pizzas were good too. Service excellent and everyone enjoyed
Cosy and nice place with good quality pizzas.
Delicious food and super friendly staff.

Good Pizza and a lot of options. Very kind staff! There is also one vegan pizza on the menu "vegana", a simple vegetable pizza with no cheese, but it's nice that it's on the menu and has been thought about.

Went here for dinner, the pizza was very good, it really hit the spot. The staff was friendly. Everything on the menu seemed decently priced. If you are looking for a good pizza this Is the place to come. Also I dont think I have ever seen so many different kinds of pizzas on a single menu before so try something you never had before, you'll be pleased you did.

Really nice aperitivo served with snacks for local price (3€ for a spritz).
Good service.

A very nice place to have a cup of coffe, or a spritz.
I pass it before lectures for a coffe, and after - for a spritz.
Prices are surprizingly low.

Really nice place good environment and Wi-Fi free with really fast speed today I was there waiting for my bus it's just front of the Flixbus stop... really good and friendly service.. Thank you Guys 🇵🇰❤🇮🇹❤🇵🇰❤🇮🇹❤🇵🇰❤🇮🇹❤🇵🇰
Rather tastless food.

This small restaurant faces Piazzale Boschetti, almost on the corner of Via Trieste, under the portico.
Reservations are recommended for lunch. A good selection of both first and second courses. They don't charge a cover charge.
Fast service.
It's just a few minutes' walk from the Arena gardens and the historic center.

Lovely Italian trattoria with solid down-home cooking! They have a beautiful, green and very spacious shaded indoor courtyard. There are 5-6 tortoise roaming around freely, a great pleasure for the kids.

The service was polite, efficient and the dishes were served in a timely fashion. The food was tasty and honest. The spinach tarts with Parmesan cream were light, airy and just melted in the mouth. The handmade bigoli with aubergines were perfectly al dente, and the tomato sauce was flavorful. The Guinea fowl was fall of the bone tender, and the sweet and sour raisin and pine-nut sauce was a delicious combination.

All in all, a great place in the center if Padova to enjoy generous, honest home cooking.

Amazing Padova hidden local food place, food is very tasty, cook with heart, the restaurant decoration is traditional & beautiful.
Run by a family with half century, everyone of family member doing their role in the restaurant, they all smile with professional manner.
Since 1956 family run restaurant. Beautiful garden with tortillas. The lamb was that soft that u don’t even need to use a knife. Totally recommended
We had a lovely meal here abd the service was faultless.

Amazing location. You are sitting beneath vine, (can also be closed, if rainy) and theres a real big grill, with a huge fire in the back, visible for all. Food is tasty and more than enough - also very recommendable  is the Grappa

The food was delicious. They have a great selection and everything was done the way you would expect it. If you want Italian food, this is a great choice. Prices were excellent too. I can highly recommend this place. Why only 3 stars? Service was rushed. Yes, we were slow to order due to a late arriving member of our party. Still, I don't appreciate plates being collected the moment you put down your fork. Maybe you would call it efficient or prompt. I thought it was unnecessarily rushed. Either way, people were very friendly and this is an excellent choice for your dinner in Padova. Lunch is supposed to be a buffet, but I didn't try that.

We had heard very high praise from friends about this place, specially for its Pizza. We ordered a Carbonara and a Verdure. They were very good! Just that I requested the veggies to be cut small in size for my pizza which was totally denied by the waitress, other than that, it is a very nice place for a dinner! The ambience is classic! 👌🏻

I had to wait 40 minutes for two pastas dishes that had no taste at all. I'm not sure if it was because there was a party at the restaurant, but still this was a very unpleasant experience and there is no excuse for such a long waiting, maybe because there were only three waiters working and they seemed to be really busy.
Traditional cusine from veneto, good quality and reasonable price

Great place to come for a self service lunch. Everything is very fresh.
You come in and grab a tray and you'll have all the food in front of you to pick from.
Plenty of seating space.
Seems to be popular with locals and could get quite busy during peak hours.
Highly recommend

Super place! I arrived well before the dinner rush and was the only guest in the restaurant. I had the full attention of the team: they offered a wine tasting, helped me choose from the menu, kept an eye on every detail, and even changed my napkin during the meal. The service was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming without ever feeling intrusive.
The food was absolutely delicious. Thank you for such a wonderful evening—I’ll be happy to come back!

I wanted to like it. I liked my costata very good done ,the vegetables  and the potatoes.I give 4 for the Costata was very nicely done.  But when we order filet noone asked how to be prepared and that's a bit worrying. Was medium, not medium rare. And we ordered syrah by glass. That was no Syrah. The bottle said so but the wine we got was some Cabernet. What we got was not dry no barique... well not the Syrah we ordered. So yeah we will not return. Sadly, ... I think it has potential, maybe we need some years to forget, we wanted to learn some good steak house in Abano. I didn't want white truffle, as lately is on everything and don't need it always specially that not everyone likes the smell. I love it. But was a nice question and offer.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Absolutely phenomenal experience at Da Vinci Bistrot!

Every dish was a perfect balance of tradition and flavor, starting with the trio of crostini—each one offering a unique and delicious bite, from the creamy liver pâté to the delicate lardo and savory pink tartare.

The grilled beef was tender, juicy, and perfectly seasoned—served simply with fresh greens and a drizzle of olive oil to let the quality shine through.

But the standout? The pappardelle al ragù. Handmade, silky pasta paired with a rustic, rich meat sauce and a touch of rosemary—comforting and refined all at once.

Service was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. This place is a gem—can’t wait to come back. Highly recommend for anyone looking to enjoy beautifully prepared local cuisine in a relaxed, elegant setting.

Grazie mille!

Visiting from the US we found this hidden gem. From the presentation to the taste this place hits five starts with ease. Appetizers, mains and desserts will blow you out of your seat. A twist on traditional dishes with portion sizes perfectly planned. The owner Victor has the perfect suggestions as well. Definitely make this a must go to on your stay in Abano Terme.

Lee W.

This is honestly one of the best restaurants I have been to in my entire life - I mean it and I am very picky and have high expectations. In this area it was not easy to find a place, that would be satisfying, so If you struggle like me - visit Da Vinci Bistrot! The food is exquisite! Everything is fresh, well balanced when it comes to spices and super high quality. They will also welcome you with the best foccacia in Italy - fresh and warm 🤤. Meat is always perfectly made and the taste is just heaven. They also have a great wine and drink selection. You will find a lot of locals here and you will not feel like a tourist at all. But what is most amazing about this place is an atmosphere. People are so warm and friendly, they are kind and very passionate about what they do. They made my lonely trip very bright and made me feel like home. I will never forget the time I spent here, the great food, attention, fantastic atmosphere and lovely conversations we had. If I go back to this area in Italy, one of the reasons will be to dine here again. Grazie Mille!

The best: the aperitivo with cicchetti. Here the aperitivo comes not only with patatine but also with cichetti made on the instant. The prices are good and the attention is gentile. I tried a tramezzino with rucola, speck and grana cheese 🧀  that was good. They have tables in and outside. Outside can be a bit noisy because of the cars.
Super

I frequent this place often, and from the first time, the experience has always been fantastic. The owner is a wonderful person with a rare kindness: he does his job, does it divinely, and offers incredibly fair prices. If you want to drink or eat well, I recommend it wholeheartedly.

Don't pay attention to the one negative review: in all likelihood, the phenomenon who wrote it has never even set foot in this place.

An exceptional discovery! We stumbled upon this bar somewhat by chance, but it struck us like very few other bars in Padua.

A generous €3 spritz includes fries and delicious platters, ranging from bruschetta with tomatoes and oregano, to salami and vegetables, and raw mayonnaise and parmesan.

Highly recommended!

This bar was once called "the refugee bar." Hundreds of friends, both men and women, passed through here in the '70s and '80s. Then the tide turned and Tole chose it as his breakfast bar, with the manager advising him on which slots to play. Now, I don't see any particular features, other than the large number of desperate people who ate everything on the slots.

I've been attending Tsukiyo Dojo for almost two years and couldn't be more satisfied. The instructor, Louis, is extremely knowledgeable, the group is close-knit, and the atmosphere is welcoming, even for someone like me who started as a complete beginner. The school is excellent for both adults and kids who want to learn Ninjutsu in a serious and accessible way. Come visit us, we look forward to seeing you ♥️

I'm thrilled to share my experience with the Tsukiyo Dojo. From day one, I felt welcomed into a true family of ninjutsu enthusiasts. Master Louis is extremely knowledgeable and knows how to convey his passion in an engaging way. The classes are always stimulating and varied, ranging from combat techniques to the philosophy behind this ancient martial art. The other students are fantastic, always willing to collaborate and support one another. If you're looking for an authentic experience and a friendly environment to practice ninjutsu, this is the gym for you!

I first visited this dojo a year ago and immediately felt at ease with the group, which is made up of very friendly and welcoming people.
The instructor is highly knowledgeable and always available, demonstrating his passion and dedication to teaching this ancient art at every opportunity.
I recommend the experience to anyone interested in martial arts and Japanese culture.

A complete and authentic martial art passed down through the centuries to this day. The Dojo is a serene and peaceful environment in which to practice. The master, along with the techniques, manages to convey his passion for the art. Recommended for anyone seeking an authentic discipline.
An excellent training experience. The instructors are helpful and knowledgeable, and put everyone at ease. Highly recommended for anyone looking to learn self-defense and Japanese martial arts.
This store is non existend. Very disappointing

I asked for a long machiatto they first gave me a machiatto only i asked for more milk they said no , so i asked for a milk with more coffee  they said no that's cappuccino i told them cappuccino is usually with more milk they said no i took the cappuccino, its plain all just milk they didn't put cocoa powder for me, the croissant was nice bc obviously its not made there anything they make tastes horrible after i went to pay the barista told the manager make me pay for the machiatto that I didn't drink, honestly horrible experience i spoke to them with my basic italian they said they can't understand me, NEVER COMING BACK TO THEM.
Lovely little bar, near the hospital, great selection of breakfast pastries and savoury snacks, very welcoming
Cutest little bar, super friendly staff, great coffee and delicious food! ❤

What a delightful discovery! Bar Delights Bistrot is a small café on Via Facciolati where you can spend some quiet time chatting over a snack or breakfast.

We visited this café around 6:00 PM and ordered two hot chocolates, which came to just €3.00, with an additional €0.50 for the cream—an unbeatable price these days, in my opinion. Furthermore, the hot chocolates were creamy and plentiful, without being cloying. We also decided to order a rice cake, which also turned out to be delicious.

The atmosphere is minimal, but it truly gives off a sense of familiarity and comfort. The staff is also friendly and helpful! I highly recommend it for a sweet break!

The only complaint is that perhaps, given the new management, it would be helpful to remove the "Puglia Bistrot" sign.
Great experience! Really good toast and fresh, flavorful juice. Friendly staff, cozy, and very clean atmosphere. I'll be back!
Been here more than twice and the food is sooo good. Big portions and affordable prices especially for us students. The staff is friendly, place is clean and seats are very comfortable. I love it!!!!

This is my go to Chinese restaurant here in Padova. Good food at affordable prices! Especially love their pork ribs with minced garlic, vegetable rice noodles and chicken and corn soup 😋 They have vegetarian options too.
I had a lunch in this restaurant. The food was very good. The place is just very close to the train station. So it’s very easy to get if you have short time before you take your train.
Massive tasty portions for a really great price. You order with your phone. Probably best suited for family style eating

If you’re after something seriously good, you gotta try the onion, eggplant, and meat with soy sauce it’s next level delicious
I also had the beef with peppers and onions. it was good too, but honestly, the first dish was on another level.
I grabbed a veggie soup too, but… not a big fan. It was way too spicy and the portion was massive no way you can finish it solo
I asked for some ice and lemon, and they hooked me up big time
Only downside? Waiting for the waiter took forever
Oh, and one more thing ٫ whatever you do, don’t skip the rice! It’s crazy good

Amazing ramen with an amazing manga atmosphere. It seems to not be in Padova. Ramen was perfect, a lot of different types with great choice. Also the sides are very nice. Price very affordable in comparison to other places. Personnel very friendly and warm, and very precise and fast to every request. Indice the restaurant you can try and wear like a real cosplay.

Great ramen restaurant in Padova. The food is delicious and super tasty. We had appetizers and three different vegan ramen. There are a lot of choices and there are six different vegan ramen on the menu. The prices are good and the staff is very friendly and smiley.
The atmosphere is nice and fun, a lot of manga and anime references and action figures around the restaurant.
Super recommended.

This is my first time at Chakramen and it was amazing! The ramen is super good and d the place is full of Japanese mangas ☺️
Highly recommend!

Huge deception with the riso sakura... Both the rice and the pork were excessively dry, very probably leftover heated from yesterday. Also it was tasteless, hopefully they added fresh green onion (the only ingredient that actually tasted like something). Quantities are large though. It is not expensive, but not cheap either (think you add 2€ coberto fee). The place was nice and the service good.

The best: costume to put on. You can dress up because they have some shirts and masks for the clients. Tech ordering because you use a tablet. Super fast ramen, less than 5min waiting. The flavour was ok, not so special. The best was the bao sandwich with duck for only 5.5€. The worst: the pistacchio cake, dry and seemed that it was for 2 days ago.

American here - my partner is from Padova, so I come here often to see his family. The first time I heard about this place, I was so intrigued because of the name. I decided to try out their burgers, and my goodness, they are so good.

All of their sandwiches, both burgers and chicken, are amazing. The last time I was there, I had the special which had beef tartare and curried pumpkin on it, and it was so delicious. I highly recommend everything on the menu. Oh, and their namesake beer (TFB IPA). It’s perfect.

I’ve ordered both in person, and through Glovo, and it’s been fantastic either way. And as an American, I can say that the burgers at TFB are better than most burgers in the US. No lie. I go here everytime I’m in Padova, and I can’t wait until the next time!
Staff were very friendly, but we were missing items on our custom burgers. Really cool atmosphere and awesome designs.
The BEST burger ever! Everything is so sophisticated yet simple at the same time—just delicious. The bread is incredibly soft, and the meat looks like it's melting just by looking at it.
The best burgers in padova and best burgers i have had. Their cocktails were also very good! Very good prices.

Best burger ever!
I have been traveling and yes, I have tried many... Yet this one is the best place to taste a delicious burger!
Tasty, different, original, respectfully served with great crispy fries.
Obviously there are many other options to choose from, but the combination of having a brilliant Polish guy managing the venue, a detailed oriented Chinese maître, and a Venezuelan chef make this comfy decorated place the ideal location for dinner with friends, family, or events.

Good job! 💪🏻
Tasty pizza, good staff, option to sit outside and inside. Outside is right near the roundabout so there is a lot of noise.

This is the right place if you are looking for good food, not formal, easy place. People are friendly. Service is fast enough. Food is amazing: pizza are very nice. Paella is excellent and spaghetti allo scoglio are very rich and portions are generous. Desserts are very nice ranging from tiramisu, north italy, to pastiera napolitan. Interesting cakes too, nice the one chocolate and pistachios. Price is right!

I usually don’t write comments but I am very allergic and I saw that all the pizza has tomato options. I asked to make pizza with items that I can eat: zucchini and chicken, even without cheese, and they made it! Even tho I don’t speak Italian and we were trying to explain ourselves in English. Recommend!
Prompt professional service, excellently prices set meals, tasty, varied food
The pizza was very good. We needed a reservation because people are waiting in line for a table. I really recommend this restaurant which was recommended to us by a local

Delicious aromatic food made with quality ingredients. Kind and attentive hosts. Upon entering, the fantastic smell and decoration teleports you straight to India.
Highly recommended!
Good food, service, and atmosphere of the restaurant. Extremely welcoming and friendly

This restaurant's decorations, music and smell fits perfectly the country that it represents. It was the second time I try indian food so I was familiar with all the spices and and strong flavours. The dishes were delicious, appealing and, something I appreciated were the traditional plates and cutlery. The personal was always available, they came in to check every now and then if the food is good and everything is going well.
I would give 4 stars for the lack of parking lot but it is a general problem in that zone, and what they lack in parking they make up in spices ;)
Real Indian food, very delish and good portions! The menu is diverse and they even have real chai tea.
Great Indian restaurant. All the dishes are flavorful, well-balanced in spices, and fresh. The portion sizes are generous — enough to feel fully satisfied.

Last night's world class dinner at Boccadoro in Padova. Family owned since 50 years, it serves up an amazing combination of modern Italian cuisine and old school 5-star gastronomical service. Highly recommended 😊

Consistently outstanding - since many years

Revisited Boccadoro after ten years, and extremely happy to see that its owner/chef Paolo and his team are not only maintaining standards, but have added another level of excellence altogether We had several starters, pasta dishes, several main courses - and desserts. Every single dish that arrived became a conversation piece. It's kind of rare to see such consistency, creativity and service over such a long period of time - and all at sane prices. Highly recommended !

Fantastic restaurant out of the city center (probably need a car to get there). The food is remarkable (Michelin award), the restaurant is very nicely decorated and the service is fast with a smile. Our waiter answered all our questions. The food is typical Padova food. Don't miss the papardelle with duck and the Galina. Or the pasta fagiolis and the liver (both restaurant traditional dish).
The dessert elwas excellent and so was the wine (pinot Nero).
Highly recommended. Too bad they are closed Tuesday and Wednesday or we would have returned.
Impeccable service by our attendant waiter (who is from Bangladesh).. excellent food

5 Stelle – A Heartwarming, Delicious Lunch!
Our lunch at Ristorante Boccadoro in Oltre Brenta, Padova, was pure joy. With friends and business partners, we savored the incredible tagliatelle al ragù d’anatra—rich, tender, and a huge hit, even with our toddler daughter, who ate every bite with a grin.The pasta al pomodoro was vibrant and classic, and the tiramisù was heavenly. Warm, rustic ambiance and kind, attentive service made us feel like family. Affordable (mains ~€15–€25) and unforgettable—Boccadoro is a gem we’ll return to soon. Grazie!

The atmosphere is cozy, it feels like home. The food was fantastic!! We tried Black pizza with coke inside the dough and it surprise us how the bitter taste works with the other recipes.
I don’t know why this restaurant is so cheap, based on the kitchen and the service they could double their prices!
Recommended to everyone!
Below average quality and high prices. I did not enjoy their pizzas. I would not recommend it.

Very impressed with the quality of the food and the service, i asked what a paella is and they gave me a little bowl of it to try. When you get there ypu get some bread and tomato sauce which are very fresh
The only negative is service price, porsions are huge. Hard to finish the pizza. Also taste is perfect.

Extraordinary HUGE pizzas 🍕 here!

Very delicious and for a good price!

For me the BEST pizzas 🍕 I have ever eaten!
Very delicious gourmet food. Highly recommended. Great ambience
Absolutely exceptional, a real insider tipp! The various, very creative pasta dishes are delicious.
The best restaurant, food ( especially Tiramisu 🥰), service which one I had in Padova ♥️
Linguine al pomodoro was really delicious. The host didn't speak English unfortunately but that was not a problem
Beautiful dishes, well composed. Friendly and helpful staff. Definitely worth a return visit when the budget allows. (Penny is a delight also!)

The food taste is decent but it wasn’t great one for me.

Good quality, tasty food, standard price, nice staff and quick service. The location is pleasant, a few kilometers far from town centre. If you don't own a car, it can be reached by bus until 8,30 pm.
Very friendly and helpful staff. Great food and quick service

To me one of the best sushi restaurants in the area.
Mainly for the quality of food

Bruno's was amazing. My brother and I visited for lunch, ordered 2 separate dishes and they offered to put half of each massive meal on both of our plates so we could sample each other's food choice. Bruno and staff didn't speak much English but they made sure we had an excellent time.

As well as the meal we were given complimentary desserts and, when it was time for coffee Bruno came out with a walking stick, adorned with a bicycle bell and attached rum bottle to 'top up' our coffees!

10/10 experience, fully recommend.

Great Italian spirit and atmosphere. We love this place. Great for breakfast. Bruno and the woman at the bar gave us a warm welcome. We enjoyed it so much that we came back the next day! Cristina (from Spain), Max (from Boston, US), Daniel (from Germany) and Robin (from France) 🤩
The best food we have eaten, accompanied by the best hospitality received. Bruno and his staff were excellent. Everyone should visit them at least once.
Great Italian food. Bruno was super receptive with us, felt really special. Everything served was fresh and tasty.

Fantastic! Bruno - the owner of the bar - is a wonderful host and it was such a great experience to be a guest.
The food (roastbeef salad) was really delicious!

Super friendly place, delicious coffee and lots of options of freshly homemade food, also a large choice of vegetarian and vegan options (bistro style, prepared veggies, salads etc.). I was there one day for breakfast (croissant and coffee) and one day for lunch with a large group of English speaking people. Even though they have omelette and fruit salad on the menu it’s only served later in the day. But the coffee, fresh orange juice and cornetto were excellent. For lunch they accommodated our large group with the many dietary restrictions very well, were extremely kind and welcoming and food was very tasty.
Nice atmosphere, delicious coffee and breakfast options (do not miss the omelette).🥐☕ Recommended experience for Paduva!

Best marrocchino in town ☕️
Lunch option is also fresh, healthy with protein options with reasonable price.
The owner Marco is very welcoming for non-italian speakers 💙
Excellent breakfast for omelette lovers. And special thanks to the welcoming and smiling waitress 👍

I'm afraid I never caught the name of the person who served me, but she was lovely! My only regret is not trying a little of everything. The food was tasty, I had a large super filling meal and enjoyed everything on my plate. Had both coffee and tea and both were excellent. I'm just a tourist, but if I ever come back I'll try to return!

As a sidenote: really lovely to see a place with so many vegetarian options!

From the moment we walked in, we knew we had picked the right place. Stepping inside from the summer heat into a perfectly air-conditioned dining room was a pleasure in itself.

The interior is absolutely beautiful. Soft pastel tones, classical statues, elegant frescoes, tasteful furniture, and carefully selected tableware create an atmosphere that's both sophisticated and welcoming.

The service deserves special praise. The waiters are experienced, mature professionals who clearly know their craft. They are attentive, courteous, and genuinely welcoming, yet never overly familiar or intrusive. That's exactly how fine dining service should feel.

The menu is a masterpiece. Not only is the food outstanding, but the selection itself is incredibly creative and well thought out. Reading the menu was almost as enjoyable as eating the dishes. Hats off to the chef!

And finally, the wine list. With bottles ranging from €17.50 to €250, there's something for virtually every taste and budget.

To sum it up, dinner for two, including wine and dessert, came to just under €70. For this level of food, service, and atmosphere, that's exceptional value for money. We'll definitely be back.

The service was so good and friendly and fast, the place is super nice. The restrooms were clean but it could be better for a high rate restaurant (which is very imp).

The Only point that I gave 4 not 5
Was the size of the pizza with the price of 12.5 euro!  For this price I expected a bigger pizza! Also coperto is 2.5
And beer is a bit more expensive than others...

Dessert was also small slice of a cake for the price!!

Please make the portions bigger or lessen the price!

For sunday some places were full but fortunately it is a big res so we didn't reserve at all!

And also a very good point, they both serve pizza and other food if u are in a group with diff opinions 😁✌🏻

Great food served by cheerful and warm staff.   The Padova Ferrari Club gathers here for meals, which tells you it must be pretty good.  We were coming from Venice and this place reminded us why Italy is known for its food!  Classic Italian charm.  The pizza and pasta were excellent.

The inside is beautiful don’t eat outside or you will miss out.
There was mainly local people.
Located on the main plaza there are some parking in front.
The food was good and the atmosphere is great

We visited this restaurant yesterday as a group of four, and unfortunately, it was a very disappointing experience.

First of all, the tables were extremely dirty. Instead of cleaning them properly, the staff simply covered them with tablecloths.

We ordered two grilled chicken dishes, one pizza, one carbonara, and one drink each. The total came to over €80. That would have been acceptable if the food had actually been worth the price.

The grilled chicken was by far the biggest disappointment. For €16.50, we received a tiny, completely unseasoned piece of chicken that had simply been thrown on the grill. It wasn’t nearly enough to fill anyone up. On the side, there were literally three tiny potatoes and something they called a salad, but it was just tasteless vegetable stems with a bland flavor. It was one of the worst meals I’ve had in a restaurant.

The pizza and the carbonara were okay. They weren’t particularly delicious, and the portions weren’t large either, but they were definitely much better than the grilled chicken.

Now comes the most unbelievable part. Because the tables were dirty, we were given some cloth napkins and table covers. What we didn’t know was that these napkins cost €3 EACH. Yes, €3 per napkin – €12 in total for four cloth napkins that we didn’t even use. We simply placed them next to us. Charging customers for reusable cloth napkins is ridiculous. They are reused over and over again, yet every guest has to pay €3 for the same piece of cloth.

When we politely asked why we were being charged, the staff was incredibly rude. Their response was basically, “If you want to complain, talk to someone else. It’s written in Italian that you have to pay.” That may be true, but for tourists this is neither transparent nor reasonable. It honestly feels like a way to squeeze extra money out of visitors.

Overall, I would recommend saving your €80 and going to McDonald’s instead. You’ll get better value for your money, tastier food, and you’ll probably be much fuller after a cheeseburger than after the tiny piece of grilled chicken served here.

Definitely not a place I would visit again or recommend.

Warm piece of Tuscan home in Piazza dei Signori in Padua.
They have only some variety but the quality is high and everything is fresh and tasty.
Their own craft beers are average, wine is better.
An enjoyable experience overall.
Definitely recommended.

Beautifully served board with a smile and great service. Ideal for two, good for four but maybe not for large parties.

The meats and cheeses were wonderful presented and even better when tasted with good wine.

Eclectic design with hanging meats and quirky decor. A good place to stop off and relax

Getting in as a last resort to find a place to eat after a long walk. No better place to do this. To tired to enjoy the wine, but the eat was a delight. Not knowing what to expect is the best recipe to either a great disappointing or brilliant experience.
Very nice place for gourmets and wine lovers, very friendly staff. I recommend!

Incredible place with local well selected products from Italian. The wine selection is really nice. The furniture well thought and original. All the staff was nice and kind to us. It was delicious and we had a really great time there. Thanks! Ciao a tutti
We enjoyed our early lunch (sandwiches and chicken). The staff were very friendly, accommodating of our limited Italian, and lovely with our young kids.

Ristorante Pizzeria agli Eremitani delivers a satisfying, no-nonsense Italian dining experience that focuses on well-executed classics.

The fritto misto is a highlight—lightly battered and fried to a crisp without being greasy. The seafood stays tender and fresh, making it an easy dish to enjoy from start to finish.

The calzone arrives generously stuffed, with a nicely baked dough that’s crisp on the outside and soft inside. The filling is rich and comforting, perfect if you’re in the mood for something hearty.

The spaghetti alle vongole is simple and well balanced. The pasta is cooked al dente, the clams are fresh, and the garlic-olive oil base is clean and fragrant, letting the natural seafood flavor shine without being overpowering.

What a wonderful discovery! Ristorante Pizzeria Agli Eremitani is a true gem in the historic centre of Padova – and one of the finest pizzerias in the city! 😍🍕🇮🇹

As seen in the photos, the entrance is absolutely charming – a beautiful arched doorway with elegant wooden double doors, golden lettering and soft pink plaster walls adorned with purple flowers, all under the romantic glow of evening light. You know you're in for something special! ✨

The menu displayed at the entrance is impressively extensive – featuring authentic Neapolitan pizza baked in a traditional rotating wood-fired oven, fresh seafood, pasta, grilled meats and artisanal desserts! 🔥 Three pizza dough options are available: traditional, ancient grain Senatore Cappelli (lighter and more digestible) and wholemeal organic – something for everyone! 🌾

We ordered a Margherita (€6.50), Diavola (€7.50), Prosciutto e Funghi (€7.00) and Pappardelle al Ragù (€7.00) along with iced teas and a litre of blonde beer 🍺 – total bill just €55 for a group! Incredible value for such quality in a prime city centre location! 💰

The restaurant has been serving authentic pizza for over 30 years and is located just steps from the famous Cappella degli Scrovegni and Chiesa degli Eremitani! ⛪🎨

Practical info:
🕐 Tuesday – Sunday: 12:00–15:00 & 19:00–00:00 (closed Mondays)
🌿 Summer garden with children's playground!
🚗 Two large car parks nearby

Highly recommended for pizza lovers, families and anyone visiting Padova! 👍🏼😀🍕

One of the most memorable meals I've had - Chef Stefano made equally delicious and beautiful bites as part of the Venetian 9-course tasting menu.  He and his staff were so gracious and welcoming, and we loved to hear the description of each plate as it was presented to us.  The food was outstanding and creative. Highly recommend!

The only thing more impressive than the quality of the food is Stefano’s personality and the incredible service staff. The “grilled” pasta is a dish that I will never forget. Similarly with the BBQ oysters. So different and so delicious. A jewel of a restaurant.

The tasting menu at this restaurant is a truly unique experience - rewarding, and at times challenging. In the best way!! Chef Stefano is pushing boundaries and experimenting in the true spirit of innovation. We did the “extremis” tasting menu (8 courses plus extras)….

Highlights (look for these on the regular menu as well if you opt not to do tasting):

“BBQ” risotto - imagine a risotto infused with smokiness of the grill, finished with a bright lemon zest. If you’re having trouble I don’t blame you, it’s pretty unique. But you must taste it!

Grilled branzino with vegetables - PERFECTLY cooked and seasoned. One of the best bites ever.

Beef tartare with asparagus and eggs - the quality of meat in Italy is just stellar and makes dishes like this superb.

For those who want challenges:
tomato sorbetto - when you eat this you may get confused. Actually it might’ve have been a special creation for the “extremis” course. It’s like gazpacho ice cream. The texture is amazingly smooth, you can cut thin slices with a spoon and it holds its form.

BBQ pomodoro - the BBQ is a bit forward in this dish compared to the risotto, the addition of sun dried tomatoes is a nice garnish. We felt oddly compelled to keep eating it though :)

All in all, chef stefano and all the team at this restaurant deserve your support! You’re not going to find traditional classics here but if you are in the mood for pushing the boundaries give it a try.

We enjoyed our gastronomic experience of contemporary interpretation of traditional venetian cuisine last night by Chef Stefano Mocellin at Padovanino. You have the option of 2 types of dégustation menu as well as alla carte, and he uses a bit of Japanese techniques in his cooking. 😍 #HighlyRecommended

We had the Milan prix fixe menu, which featured a savory take on a crème brûlée using Parmegiano Reggiano among other unique and enticing dishes. We also got to talk to the chef/owner, Stefano, who was incredibly nice and so clearly exuded pure passion regarding his food.

An intriguing seafood-centric restaurant in Padua with a well-curated wine selection. The flavors struck a nice balance—creative yet comfortably familiar. There are contemporary variations of conventional foods such as mayonnaise made out of pythoplankton. Every dish was fresh and made to order, showcasing a clear attention to quality. I particularly enjoyed the red shrimps (presumably harvested from the Adriatic) and the scampi, both served unshelled and as part of a mixed seafood platter. Interestingly, the breads didn’t seem freshly baked, which stood out slightly against the otherwise high standards. The wine house spirit is evident in the details too—like the walls, thoughtfully lined with wine corks, adding character and charm to the space. While the restaurant is recommended in the Michelin Guide, it hasn’t been awarded a star. Prices are not cheap and on par with starred restaurants. Still, I’d happily return. Finally, make sure you have a reservation due to its popularity.

Cosy restaurant; very nice and charming staff. The food is simply delicious!! 10/10

This is the Padova branch of the famous Neapolitan pizzeria chain, Sorbillo. First, it's worth noting that in Naples, there are actually two pizzerias with the Sorbillo family name: Gino e Toto Sorbillo and Antonio e Gigi Sorbillo. The more widely known one with multiple branches is the former — Gino e Toto Sorbillo.

While some Gino Sorbillo locations hold AVPN certification, this particular branch does not. However, the ingredients used here — including the flour and tomatoes — are AVPN-certified, just like at the other branches.

Interestingly, this was my best experience at a Sorbillo so far. The dough, both in terms of texture and flavor was noticeably better than at other locations. I particularly enjoyed the cornicione (the puffed-up, thicker edges of the crust) and the Terre Francescane olive oil. Overall, a pretty good representation of a Neapolitan Pizza. My only criticism was the slightly overcooked cheese (you should never see any browning).

The restaurant itself is clean and impressively well-run, even during busy hours. Located in a popular neighborhood, it tends to be packed in the evenings, but turnover is fast — expect a wait of only about 5–10 minutes. It’s a three-story establishment, and quite uniquely, the baking oven is located on the middle floor — something I’ve never seen before.

As Lebanese customers, we were very disappointed with our experience at this restaurant.

We ordered three “Piatto Mille e Una Notte” dishes, which were described as including shawarma, traditional tabbouleh, hummus, falafel, and potatoes with harissa.

Unfortunately, we expected dishes that were reasonably close to authentic Lebanese cuisine. The shawarma was particularly disappointing and had a very poor taste. We could not finish it. In our opinion, it was even worse than the typical kebab sandwiches commonly found in many fast-food kebab shops.

The tabbouleh was not a traditional tabbouleh. The ingredients and flavor were very different from the authentic Lebanese dish. The hummus was also disappointing in both taste and quality.

We understand that restaurants may adapt recipes, but when dishes are advertised as traditional food, customers expect something closer to the authentic cuisine. This was not the case for us.
