Sorry, but no. Soy spaghetti with absolutely nothing in it, literally zero vegetables, zero eggs, zero anything, and no flavor.

I came here specifically to try the seafood tagliolini, and it was a huge disappointment. The seafood did not taste or smell fresh at all. The odor was so unpleasant that I brought it to the attention of the staff, but they insisted it was the normal smell of mixed seafood.

As someone who has eaten seafood pasta many times in Italy, I can confidently say this was the worst one I've ever had. Fresh seafood should never have such an off-putting smell. The quality of the dish was far below expectations, and the staff's response only made the experience more frustrating.

I would not recommend this dish.
Piovra  griliata and filletto di manzo so yummy 😋🤤
Delicious local dishes and wonderfully friendly staff - highly recommend!

Cozy restaurant in the center of Padova. We tried traditional pasta with duck ragu, which was fantastic. Also they have various interesting types of pizzas( some of them are creates by their imagination).
Desserts also were delicious.
Additionally, staff was extremely professional and kind👍

I sat outside, and the whole place had a bit off vibe since the beginning - starting with the not so nice tables and continuing with a little weird approach by the waitresses (but maybe that was just my feeling). The pizza was good, but the prices aren't the lowest, so maybe the whole level of the restaurant should be upped - this way, it had restaurant prices, but fast food vibe. Not bad, but I'd choose something different the next time.
I Love the atmosphere and service there. The wine staff recommended was super nice. Although the pasta and tuna I ordered was little bit salty for me, my colleague loves the dishes he had.
very friendly staff and absolutely top notch food quality, would definitely return a second time! totally recommend

This place is just amazing! The staff was very kind and efficient, the food was very fast and just delicious, my husband said it was the best carbonara he had, I had spaghetti with shrimps and the sea food was so fresh. Highly recommended!!

Service was excellent beside that they don't know English very well. All staff were polite.
They bring me at the beginning a bread (??) later I ordered a pizza and that bread is like a service fee 2.5eur, of course I didn't even try it. Later I read that cuver is 5.9eur if music plays. Any way, I ordered pizza Padovana or something, cheese and caramel onions were great but bacon was very very bad.

Delicious food and good service at reasonable prices.
Maybe you will have a problem communicating in English.
very good!
The best sushi of my life
Great variety and excellent, fresh sushi. Opening offer at a fantastic price! Great for a super quick lunch downtown.

Delicious food, friendly and helpful staff, the place makes you feel at home, a wide variety of food and flavors of all kinds, an absurdly fantastic experience that should be repeated, very good prices as is the food🤩
very good!! good sushi and kind and super fast guys

Absolutely worth it for the all-you-can eat price. Many selections of meat, even in lunchtime where the price is lower than dinner.
The waitress was also great, changing the grilling paper twice

Great place to go to if you need a break from Italian food. The staff were very attentive and delivered fast service. The food was great. The sushi rolls were made fresh and their Kim chi was tasty. Highly recommend!

This was the first time my husband trying Asian BBQ and he likes it! The service was really good. They explain everything to him and they also changed the grilled paper often. The price is also affordable!
Great all you can eat menu with jaoanese grill dishes that You can make on Your own.
food is amazing, we took all you can eat menu and felt so bad because we ate so much, the food is delicios and it feels like heaven
Good food and their service.
Great food quality for an All-You-Can-You-Eat. Nice place with good service.
Avocado Sushi is absolut must have!!!
Super!
Disgustatoso

After walking past this place a few times, I finally decided to stop and try it mainly because I noticed they offer gluten-free options.

I was pleasantly surprised. They have gluten-free soy sauce, and the menu clearly marks dishes that can be adapted. For someone with celiac disease, cross-contamination might still be a concern, but I’m quite sensitive to reactive to gluten and I didn’t have any reaction after eating here, which was a great sign.

The service was friendly and very fast, and the dishes arrived beautifully presented.

For me, the highlight was being able to eat yakisoba again, something that’s often hard to find in a gluten-free version.

A great spot if you’re looking for Japanese food with gluten-free options.
Kind staff, fast service. Good food. Only 1 portion of salmon sashimi per person though.

A fun experience and LOTS IF choices to choose from. The food is nice, pretty fresh and tasty. Fair prices highly for what you get. The service is great you order through your phone and the food shows up very quickly.

The atmosphere is fascinating. Although some things in the menu are not very same as the pictures, we enjoyed our time and meal pretty well with my girlfriend. Orders came fastly compared to other sushi restaurants in the town. Generally I can recommend but there are better sushi restaurants in Padova.

I loveeee this place so much! Everything was extremely delicious , most important thing- service was perfect! We even did not wait at all for anything. As you see from pics how nice our plates was. I highly recommend you would not regret:)

Everything extremely good! The bentos and maki are top quality! Even the miso soup was good.
Also the coffee isn’t burnt, so yuppie 🌷
Best sushi in Padova as far as I'm concerned, with lovely service. Will definitely be going again.
A very cozy yet elegant atmosphere that makes you feel at ease and special at the same time! The staff was very friendly and the fish was very fresh. Totally recommend it!

I can honestly say one of the worst dining experiences of my life. When I walked in the staff seemed put off, as if they were annoyed I was there even though I was the only one there. I was placed at a table and given no indication as to how to order. After scanning the QR code from another table I was presented with a menu with no order or intelligence. Halfway through navigating the hell of their online menu the waiter came up and asked if I was ready. I asked for the East and West sushi. He had no idea what I was talking about. I asked I Italian. Blank stares. He had an earphone in, so maybe that was interfering with communication. I gave him my phone and for some reason he condcluded I wanted the scallop sashimi. At this point my only desire was  to leave so I agreed, despite it being nowhere near what I wanted. I also ordered the Sake Cassa, which was only a shot on the menu and only four euro. What I was brought was a full cup of sake that i knew would cost way more than four euro. Then the dish came out and it's just an uninspired round of raw scallop with some avacado and way too much horseradish Wasabi. I mean, seriously, it was a mound taller than the actual dish. Like the chef had squeezed three packets onto the plate. I don't know how they would expect anyone to eat that much Wasabi without getting a ruptured anus. I scarfed down the uninspired round, managed to keep my manus intact, thankfully the sake was actually good, and then rushed to the counter so I could get out of there. Of course the bill ended up being much more than I had planned - I went in only wanting some sushi and a shot of sake and ended up with a full dish and a cup of sake - but I was happy to pay the premium just to get out of there. I think myself and the staff have the same mutual feeling, in that we both hope to never see each other ever again. Still tough, it was a beautiful place.
Very nice restaurant with perfect food!
Im not an amateur of beer, but all my friends are, so I chose this place for our evening. Everyone was impressed, and everyone said “complements to the chef”. Amazing food and very good beer!

The best: chill and relax environment. Outside or inside it is cool anyway to stay there. A bit overpriced with beer and food. Attention kind and fast. Parking in front of the restaurant. Aperitivo with nachos instead of patatine.
A very unique Place with a dubliner atmosphere and deliciuos food. One of the last irish pub in Padua!
Really delicious hamburger, but pricey, Two hamburgers and two beers 47€.

We arrived a family of 6. The service was great, the owners do not speak English but went out of their way to help us, the cook came out of the kitchen to translate and explain to us what the dishes were.  The food itself was excellent and the atmosphere in the place was very pleasant.  Highly recommended

An amazing view over Prato della Valle while taking our appetizer.
Also, very nice staff and service.

This restaurant was randomly chosen due to its location near our hotel.  It was highly rated, and it did not disappoint.  The food was great, homemade, and the service was impeccable.  A good night out with the family.  Go check it out if you are in the area.
Another Italian jewel.  The owner greeted us and helped with dining options. The pig and potato’s were amazing.  Specialty pasta and desserts are handmade.
One of the best cacio e pepe we ever had. The portion was big and we were full but we were almost ready to order one more!
We stopped here on the way to get a charger and picked it up based on the reviews. The food is really delicious and the service is nice. Although we asked for spaghetti and an afternoon cappuccino :)

We chose this restaurant only because of its proximity to the hotel, but in the end it turned out to be a great choice. A real homely and friendly atmosphere. We ate their homemade pasta and gnocchi, which were perfect. Recommendation for tagliatelle in white sauce (ragu bianco). The prices are ok.
Great food with reasonable prices and very big portions. Good coffee. You order via tablet on table, so very easy. Open early, so a great starting point for tourists.
The best focaccia sandwich i’ve ever eaten! Definitely recommend to everyone in padova . The roman style pizza is also really delicious

We were very happy to find it open in the eay afternoon.
The whole family was really kind
And the pizza 😋 it was pure italian ❤️

The food is 5-star, but the restroom is 😔. It’s broken and looks like it hasn’t been fixed in years. It’s really disappointing to see a great bakery in Padova have such a neglected and non-functional toilet.

What a delightful discovery on a rainy day in Padova :-) this bakery is great, not only because it was open during siesta. My sons ordered pizzas, lasagna and focaccia - and everything tasted sooooo good. The waiter: very helpful and friendly. Finish with espresso macchiato and chocolate cake: top taste, too.
Make sure to drop in here when in Padova historical center. Ciao!
Great fast food service with good choices next to the weekly market and the church

The slowest kebab I have ever bought.
I can buy a better kebab in Paris with the same price. 7.5 for only few pieces of meat.
The old father looks everyone like a enemy.
The son works slowly and  forgets the order sometimes.
The wife goes to take a rest sometimes and come out when there are full people in the restaurant who are waiting for in the line around 25min.
Delicious and well priced. Super sweet people at the restaurant. Kind and welcoming.

The fries are crispy, salty and cooked in fresh oil, there is a menu with numbers so foreigners can eqsily order, the service is alright, but if you are eating outside, it's loud because of cars and a street train, also there is a lot of pidgeons, the inside is pretty

I usually don’t eat outside. But since I am from Turkey and been looking for a nice, clean doner kebap place arouns Padova I went Turkish Risto Kebap after a friend’s suggestion. The staff was so nice compared to other kebap places around Padova. They happily answered my questions about the menu, the doner kebap and the ingredients. It was my second time eating kebap in Italy and I can say that the meat quality is super high and the mix of all the ingredients in your mouth is a reminder to the good old days in Turkey. Depending on my past experiences in Turkey I can say that their meat quality is good. ☺️

Great selection of fresh vegetables, meats and fish. Delicious authentic Sichuan MaLa Hotpot!

This was our fourth time in as many months, and the reliability and consistency is laudable! Not to mention our very friendly and attentive hosts. Highly recommended.

This is best restaurant in Padova to taste traditional Chinese food Hotpot with the best environment. I must mention their dessert items. Finger licking food.Best food with reasonable price. Additionally their service is so special with professional stuff.
Amazing food! My first hot pot. Went with a Chinese friend and enjoyed a very authentic experience in the middle of Italy!

Came here last minute about a week ago with my boyfriend and a friend, so they were very kind to squeeze us in.

We had a bit of hard time finding street parking. There’s very limited free parking on the street but there’s a paid parking garage behind the building!

We speak very little Italian and got lucky that one of their waitresses spoke very good English. She was able to help us order (2 different ways, through her or the website). She also recommended some great things like the plum juice! It’s to die for, super refreshing and not too sweet!

We did the two broths options and honestly..the bone broth didn’t have much flavor. It wasn’t bad, but just not much.

They have a great selection of meats and veggies. They also have seafood options as well!

Definitely will be coming back to try other broths!

Need a place to eat until you're disgusted with yourself because you ate SO MUCH, because it's that good? Then this is the spot! Been here twice, so far, but will absolutely be going back as often as possible. Highly recommend!
d=(^o^)=b

Everything was amazing!
We loved the food, the place and service.
WHAT A PANNA COTTA!
💛

Good experience overall. The staff is kind and professional, owner is keen to welcome customers and advise them on their choice. Some partially reinvented recipes were not appreciated, while the more traditional recipes (aji de gallina, ceviche, papas huancaina) met expectations. Quality/price ratio is a bit expensive, considering both that certain raw materials are expensive but also that some recipes are based on "simple" ingredients.
Restaurant is well-kept, not so easy find a parking spot.

Fantastic food! Every sauce was a delightful blend of bright and lively flavors. The dishes were plated in a manner you would see in a gourmet restaurant. The owner is so friendly and walks from table to table talking with guests

Very nice Peruvian restaurant. The place is really typical and the staff is professional and friendly.
The food is great with a lot of vegan and vegetarian options.
Recommended

Lucky enough to have found this gem! Even better is that it is just around the corner from home. Staff are extremely helpful and friendly, they definitely add to the experience.  Food is out of this world and the colours make not only a feast for the tummy but also your eyes! Fantastic I love it

I visited this place two times at “all you can eat” timeslot. In the first visit i enjoyed a lot with the quality of food and service that’s why i visited this place again today without any reservation and they accepted us so thank you for that. However it was totally a disappointment at this time. Portions were so small (even the portions of sushi and sauces) , service was too late. Quality of all the sushis we tried was overall not satisfying. Kindly adding the photos of the portions of some sushis and sauces. One sushi that my friend ordered also didnt come. PS: they didn’t give us any fortune cookies evn they gave in the first visit :(

This “all you can eat” Sushi restaurant is located in the center of Padova. It’s modern and intimate, I recommend booking in advance 🍱✨

Vegetarian and vegan dishes are marked by the same green leaf, it’s quite sad that there aren’t many options to be honest 🌿
Ingredients are written down.

I ordered two dishes which were supposed to be plant-based but one turned out to contain Philadelphia while the other had chicken in it. Completely unprofessional and disorganised: they were lucky I don’t have any allergies, imagine if someone who has them was in my situation 😨

Definitely not coming back since there are much better places in town.
This is my go to spot for sushi in Padova. The quality, Variety, and service are all good.

The first impression wasn’t the best as the restaurant is located underground. There’s poor lightning and when you go out of the place, you can be sure you smell like fried fish.

Despite this, Sushi Kai offers one of the best sushi’s in town. They have a great selection, wide enough to give the customers the power to choose but not too big as to confuse them. The fish has good quality as well as the meat. Sushi is tasty and visually appealing. They also offer a wide selection of Vegetarian dishes.

The price for the “All you can eat” formula is great value and you won’t be disappointed.

The waiting staff works well even if sometimes they struggle to be fully efficient, but that only happens in rush hours.

As it is a very popular restaurant, I’d say reservation is compulsory. It will be hard to find an available table without it.

Really suggested if you find yourself in Padua and crave some good sushi.
I always come back to this sushi place. I am a vegetarian and there are several new options.... the new tofu dish is AMAZING! Really recommend!!

Good food with reasonable price. With this price in Switzerland we can forget about it!

Worth to recommend!
Classy and simple, very fast and kind service, decent food, would go again
Chill environment, good music, great service and great food
Best sushi experience I have ever had.
Good service and food every thing is perfect

We tried two different pastas — both were delicious. The sauces were flavorful and well balanced, and the pasta had a nice, fresh texture. Service was pleasant and the atmosphere relaxed, making it a nice spot for a casual meal. The presentation was attractive and the ingredients tasted fresh, showing care in preparation. The wine list had a few good local options that complemented the dishes well.

The only downside was the portion size: this time the servings felt noticeably smaller than our previous visit, so bring an appetite or plan to order a side. Overall still a tasty place we’d recommend, just be prepared for slightly lighter portions.

The food was delicious! The best pasta I’ve ever had. The service was fast and the prices were reasonable. The portions were quite large, typically Italian. I ordered the carbonara, and it was amazing! I highly recommend this restaurant!
Great price-quality ratio. Carbonara and tiramisu were both very tasteful and filling. Food came out quickly and the staff was friendly!

Amazing local pasta place, great prices and portions. Foods and drinks came out in less than 5 minutes. The tiramisu was also lovely.
The only bad thing was the lack of heating, the place was quite cold.

took my family for the loveliest dinner, the food was delicious but above all we were so fortunate to meet and be cared for by the kindest soul in padova, a waiter who didn’t make us wait, a polyglot traveller who charmed us all in our own language - polish out of them all! if the pasta isn’t enough of a reason to visit, he for sure is!!

I paid 3€ in total for 2 meat buns and they were tasty and very filling! Great value for money. They could have been more fresh but it may be because I bought them near to closing time (around 2:30pm), I imagine that they’re even better earlier in the day
A quick takeaway place with Chinese breakfast. I got the xiaolongbao, which is not the soup dumpling but small steamed meat bun. A really nice breakfast! They also have zongzi and youtiao.

Smiling and kind people, the best breakfast I've ever had with my girlfriend, and the prices are unbeatable, despite how affordable they are. I can't help but recommend it to anyone looking for a breakfast that's different from the classic croissant and cappuccino; you won't regret it. Lunch was also delicious, and the price is equally good. I'll definitely be bringing more people with me.
Chinese breakfast is delicious 😋
The roujiamo (Chinese hamburger) is cheap and delicious, and it's the only one in PDK that comes with green peppers! Unbeatable!!!
The food was excellent for being pasta with seafood. The waiter was nice and his English was good. The restaurant is very small so it can't handle large groups of people.
Super nice place! Food was great, loved the atmosphere. Recommend you so strongly to visit.
Great place for quality seafood. Highly recommend the cuttlefish and baccala!
Seafood restaurant with great English speaking staff. Good selection of white wines and delicious meals.

Very good raw material and very well cooked and presented in a small fish restaurant not far from downtown. The atmosphere mostly depends on the occupancy level of the tables since tables are rather close one to another. Prices a bit above the average but well deserved if you consider the level of the food. Parking is relatively easy in the nearby Corso Milano or 10 minutes walk in piazza Insurrezione.

I can confidently say this is the Italy’s best kebab. The flavors were exceptional, and the quality was unmatched. To my surprise, the falafel was equally mind-blowing—perfectly crispy and delicious.

Beyond the food, the service was fantastic. The lady at the counter was incredibly sweet and cooperative, making the experience even better. I highly recommend everyone give this place a try; you won’t be disappointed.

I got the Ciaokebab 2.0 without the tomatoes and onions, which I can probably blame for making it a little dry, but the flavor was still very good and different from the typical kebab.

It’s a bit of a shame that the menu options aren’t more flexible to accommodate different preferences and dietary restrictions (e.g. vegans). For example, with the sandwiches they will let you exclude a sauce but won’t replace it with a different one. I’m personally not sure if it was worth the price but it’s worth trying at least once to decide for yourself!

The ownership has changed. This is not the Ciaokebab chain from Bologna anymore. They kept the same name, location and menu but the quality of ingredients are subpar. The pita was hard and dry and the meat inedible. This is extremely misleading to the customer and I’m not sure how legal that is.

Glovo service. Cold, little kebab, lots of salad and soggy French fries, overpriced for the quality.
Not recommended.
Amazing food. You should go here. I ate here several times a week for a whole month.

The restaurant is very good! One of the best in Padua, with beautiful and stylish interior, good atmosphere, very good service and tasty and original dishes.
I can add only one small comment, that ceviche that I ordered is more tar tar. ceviche is another thing. But it’s small thing, all the rest is really perfect, we have been surprised by the good quality for a honest price.
The meat was raw and the burger was good but not worth the price

More items on the menu than in most of restaurants in Padova.
Got my order ready even before kitchen was open. One of most delicious pasta I ate in Italy with different meat in one dish. Ordered meat, but pasta alone was 5 star

Very nice and expensive looking restaurant. We went there for breakfast. We were surprised how cheap it was when we got the tab, we assumed it would be 4-5x more expensive. The ambiance was amazing but the food was mediocre at best. The brioches were better looking than tasting.

Super service, delicious food all on a boring Monday evening working in Padua.
I’ll be back for sure.

Must visit restaurant, had an amazing experience.

We had opted for 4 courses menu, specifically handpicked wines, which were served on the basis of the food being served at just 35 euros per person including wine. More economical options starting from 15-25 euros available too.

All the meals served were mouth-watering, excellent wine pairing.  Owner, Chef and service staff, all are extremely friendly and serves you the best...!

Small events or family functions can be planned easily at this restaurant.

Service           🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟
Food                🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟
Menu               🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟
Economical   🌟 🌟 🌟
Family/Kids    🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟
Cleaning         🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟
Restroom        🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟

PS - The barbecue option is available, too.

We’ve came here by coincidence and it was a great choice. Superb traditional dishes with large choice of wines. There’s also something to choose if you’re with kids, just ask staff, because there’s no children dishes in the menu. Great service speaking english! I would recommend Era Ora if you ever find yourself in Campo san Martino.
Very good restaurant, amazing atmosphere, with an impeccable service. All very fresh, tasty combinations, great wine selection. Recommended!
Really nice restaurant, lovely service, good seafood, for me tartar was a little bland but really fresh!

Very nice place, with excellent food and wine.
Good English service for the tourists and
great B&B next door for the wine lovers :-)

American restaurant with burger, ribs , salads and fajitas choices. Burgers comes in 3 sizes: small, medium and big (it is only about the weight of the burger because the size of the bread is the same for any of them). The decoration inside is quite nice, and they have tables also outside. The attention from the staff could improve. I tried the Small Bacon burger, it tasted good and it was a complete meal so the portions are well served.

Almost an American dream — but with Italian subtitles
I walked in just before closing time, hoping for a small nightcap of experience to end a beautiful day. The place looks like an American diner — Elvis on the wall, US license plates, neon light… the whole cultural export package.
I asked for a burger.
Silence.
I repeated burger.
More silence.
Then the waiter lit up: “Ah, BURGER!”
Breakthrough.
I was asked to move 20 meters to a more appropriate table (apparently the first one offended someone’s geometry). I ordered a Blue Cheese Burger + Corona. The Corona arrived quickly. The No-Cheese burger a bit later. Close enough, I suppose — dairy intolerance by divine intervention.
I asked for salt. Non comprendere.
I wrote NaCl on paper. Still non comprendere.
Chemistry fails again.
To their credit, they listened politely when I explained the situation, and apologized kindly. Staff is friendly — once communication leaves Earth orbit and returns.
Food: fine.
Service: unforgettable.
Experience: pricelessly chaotic.
Burgers’re awesome. It’s the best I’ve ever eaten. Atmosphere was calm and inspiring. Thanks for the dinner and great atmosphere 😊

Besides the nice decoration and interior. This is my worst fried chicken experience. Quite over-priced, fries and chicken nuggets are very dry, the wings are a bit acceptable but not good , and the chicken popcorn is dried and burned.
Walked by here several times and thought we'd try it out. Wonderful food. Tastes sooooo good. And amazing service. So so kind. Will go back again soon.

I got the full plate of the day which included rice, lentils,  cashews, a piece of chicken, a fish croquette and some papadam for €6. The food was delicious and spicy, and the portion size was such great value for the price. I’ll definitely return!

Welcome to the arrogant chef's restaurant. We went for dosa and it was not available. Reason is we were late (I don't know how 20:00 hrs is considered late for dinner). The menu is just there for marketing, none of it will be available. Just few dishes given by the chef will be the option. Oh, also the menu doesn't have price, it's what they say. With no option, I had to have chicken kottu, but couldn't find any chicken in it. Forget chicken, there was no flavor at all. It was like a mix of normal paratha, spring onions, chillies, onions and some shredded carrots. The menu stated to have green peas, but there wasn't any. The conversation with the chef (there was no other person like a waiter to talk to) was very unpleasant as well. It felt like he didn't want us to be there. No wonder the place was empty. There are many good Indian restaurants in Padua, please prefer them.

For instance, restaurant Shiva is also near Prato Della Valle, very good customer service, quality food, good taste and more options, not just what the chef says.
Your service and food quality are the bad, make the customer the first priority in your business. Congratulations to you and hope you can improve your business and move forward. Thank you!

I wanted to inform you that restaurant is serving old foods... I went today with my Friends and order 2 fried rices and 2 mixed kottu... We got very bad smell like they have made by few days ago.... Highly we won't recommend this restaurant.... 🤮🤮🤮🤮🤮🤮🤮🤮
They served us the food which went bad and stank. Very bad

Traditional Indian Restaurant, food was OK, Premises was clean and service was good. The only downside is there were a group of Indians around 6 of them making a lot of noise and talking very loud ... not good to see ... I wish the restaurant was strict with their rules. Good Restaurant overall in Padova and 700 m from the Train Station. I made the reservation on The fork app with a 30% discount on food ...

The food was very good, but, after ordering a non-spicy dish, I had also explicitly asked to make sure to not make it spicy, and yet it arrived very spicy (I can't really eat spicy at all).
Other than that, the flavor was very good, and the portions were adequate.
When I told them, they said that I could have tell them and get a new one, and I appreciated that.
The taste was okay not too great, but no raita served with biryani as mentioned in the menu , also no accompaniments like achaar or onion, very disappointing !
We really liked the food!! And with The Fork we paid very very little. But also the "normal" prices are very fair.
Smooth indian dishes that taste wonderful.  You can be sure to not be disappointed. You are well taken care of during your meal!

Food and service was excellent. Prices are reasonable because the quality of fresh seafood can be tasted with every bite. If you are seafood lover I would definitely recommend you to visit this place!! We will definitely go back! Yummy 😋🥰
The food was very good and the service was great.

A little bit far out, but the incredible food is more than worth the visit! Somewhat upscale in terms of style and prices, yes, but much more so in service. Super knowledgeable and friendly waiters and very well selected ingredients make the time fly by without you knowing it.
Food not only taste good but also like a painting. So beautiful and elegant. Service also close to perfection. This could be fine food experience to become part of your  memory in life
Perfect! Just amazing, it’s worthy in anyway, fresh and perfectly cooked seafood. high quality service. Friendly to kids as well.

This casual bacaro just off Piazza Duomo is a versatile wine bar/osteria serving cicchetti alongside a more substantial menu – perfect whether you’re after a snack and glass of wine or a full meal. I love the cool, casual interior with soft lighting, warm wood, and exposed stone  – as well as the fact that it’s full of locals and travellers in the know. The short menu focuses on traditional Paduan cuisine and specialties from across the Veneto, including Venetian baccalà mantecato and baccalà poached in milk Vicenza-style. The wine list is impressive and the staff friendly and knowledgeable. There’s good local salumi (Sopressa Vicentina and Prosciutto Veneto Berico-Euganeo DOP) and formaggi (36-month-old Asiago, Caprino di Marano goat cheese from Valpolicella, and hay-smoked Monte Veronese), and distinctive Paduan dishes like Gallina in Saòr that you’re unlikely to find elsewhere. Great house-made desserts too.

A very beautiful restaurant with very polite staff.

I would recommend to book a table as the restaurant is quite popular in yhe area and you might find ot difficult to sit at a table without a reservation.

I put 4 stars because we had to wait  fot quite long for the dishes. It is excusable due to the people in the restaurant but i have to be objective.

The tiramisu was delicious.

I had a delicious 3 course meal of squid, pasta with anchovies and onion sauce and sea bass. Overall I paid around 50€ including wine. The price was appropriate for the quality. The restaurant is a bit easy to miss if you are not actively searching for it. If you're looking to treat yourself with a well made meal I can highly recommend this place :).

What a fantastic spot! From the welcoming decor to the well-oiled machine of the staff and the lovely regional dishes with the chef coming out to personally deliver them. They let you split dishes and checks - so thoughtful and fun. Andres rocks!

Delicious pasta, friendly staff :)
We were lucky enough to find table to have lunch. We tried fettuccine fungi and bigoli ragu. Highly recommended place for pasta and tiramisu. Make reservations to secure your table.

Super kind, welcoming, local bakery. Everything is homemade and tastes really fresh and high quality. The cornetto is flaky, soft, fresh, and even the crema (custard) one is not way too sweet. The coffee is excellent as well (they also have oat milk).

For lunch time they have a variety of homemade pasta salads, grilled veggies, fregola (I think) salad, quiches, square pizza slices,  etc. varying throughout the days. I had pesto pasta with a side of greens and eggplant. (See photo). Every part tasted delicious and super fresh, with very good olive oil.

The staff is also very kind, welcoming, serves you at your table, recognized me returning and were patient and helpful with me trying to speak my non-existent Italian.

A little hidden gem. I lived around the corner from them for almost a year before discovering them- an absolute shame because I could have been eating all their treats much sooner. I do think Bacio has the best jam filled croissants in all of Padua. The cafe is always stocked with something new, high quality wines and oils to take home, BEAUTIFUL pasta plates with vegetables, and super sweet staff. Better than any food I’ve tried in the city center proper.

In short, the best place for a high-quality, good-price quick lunch, breakfast or afternoon coffee.

Very few places on Earth can proudly bear a name that describes with extreme accuracy their effect on their visitors. This is one of them, and perhaps the finest examples I've ever found. Let me explain.

They offer a good variety of exquisite dishes for lunch (mostly primi piatti, with some secondi), with a constantly rotating selection of options (really, the offerings change every day) and great new additions regularly. Their sweets, either small or big, are amazing and ideal for the morning or afternoon. I highly recommend their Pazientina and the Caffé Mousse dolcetto (yes, that little chocolate mug). They can always be washed down with their good coffee. The staff is quick, efficient, gentle and always in good mood. The prices are low given the quality of the food and average before taking that into account.

Every visit will fill your stomach, excite every single sensitive cell in your tongue and nose and feel in your soul like the kiss of a fine lady, i.e. like a Bacio di Dama.
Great service, great product, reasonable prices.
Excellent selection of pastries, cozy atmosphere and friendly staff. What's not to like?
Very delicious sushi and the waffles are very special. Never had something like this before! Service is very kind and has an eye for details . Loved it!
Best sushi I glad in Italy, there’s no competition in Padua.
“Amazing sushi, super fresh and delicious. Definitely recommend.”
Every time I come to visit Padua, I have to stop by, because it’s one of the best sushi I’ve ever had, and the owners are just lovely with their daughters.
If you come here once, you will definitely come again. Very creative and wonderful sauces and ingredients. They are always so welcoming and kind

incredible stuff they are making in this place. the amount of meat is so generous, and the beef is cooked to absolute perfection in the mo burger. the pastry is flakey and crunchy, and joy to eat. the chicken mo is also amazing, such juicy flakey meat in both !!! chicken one also comes with an egg. the bao is so juicy and flavorful, and the shaobing is also flavored so well. the bread for that is so good, the meat juice soaks into the inside perfectly. the people who run the place are so sweet, always greet you with a smile :). price is also amazing, thank you so much.

中国人支持中国人！非常好吃！Chinese here visiting Padova for a daily trip - and this small Chinese dim sum restaurant wowed my eyes! I ordered mini beef shaobing, it tasted soooooo goood oh my gosh! Juicy fillings and the authentic Chinese flavor oh wow! The only thing was maybe I was not asked if I wanted to have a spicy or non spicy one…but still, 5 euros for 3 👍 and the mom and the son were very friendly! Please come and support! you will be over the moon for a nice bite of Chinese flavor ☺️

This place is a real find. The staff are really nice, and the food is really good. I ordered the mo with beef, which was clearly made fresh and absolutely stuffed with meat.
A quick tip: my friends tried some of their other dishes and asked for the Piccante version, it's genuinely hot!
Totally recommend to try this place.
Yum yum yum 😊 we found it randomly on google maps and we are glad we went there. The food was very tasty and freshly prepared. So sad we are in Padova only for few hours
Kind staff, great Chinese food and good portion. Highly recommended
Excellent customer service, great food. Great fresh juice.thank you so much.
Ordered a carrot and green juice. Made it fresh on the spot. Delicious!!

The most tastless thing I think I've ever had! Overpriced and lacking anything that resembled food. To be avoided! I should have bought a sandwich from the food dispenser at the station..I'm sure my taste buds would have been more satisfied.
It was probably the saddest worst vegan brioche I've had in my 4 years in Italy. Bland, stale and doughy. Do better!
The staff is kind and helpful, but the sandwiches are completely tasteless. Three stars just for the service.

We had an amazing experience! We tried three different burgers and every single one was perfect. The portions were great, the flavor was incredible, and the meat was cooked perfectly. Everything was absolutely top quality! The staff was also very friendly and welcoming. Definitely a place we would happily visit again!

A place we stumbled upon while exploring the city! After checking the reviews on Google, we decided to give it a try and... we didn't regret it at all!!! The food is 100% worth the price, with fresh, high-quality ingredients! The place is neat, clean, and decorated in a very original style, with friendly staff. We'll definitely be back when we're in the area!

Nice little restaurant with 80s flare and very good food.
Fries and burger were amazing and the best cheese cake I’ve ever had!
Overall awesome vibe and food and a very fast service. I loved their great variety of burgers. Pretty good price-quality ratio

Honestly the best burgers I’ve ever had! I’ve been living in Padova for the past 5 years and I took every single person I know to this place. Please never take Country, Caramel and Soul Crispy burgers out of the menu. We basically eat them every week 😂 Thank you to everyone who works there cause you’re doing an incredible job.

It was a fine experience,since we love sushi. The environment was beautiful, and the staff were fast and welcoming. The food was good, but quite average—while we enjoyed it, I think I would prefer to try other sushi places next time not here. Overall, it was a fine experience.
Kind staff, great sushi and more. Beautiful interiors. Recommended
Nice and quiet with a large selection of sushi and others, the nigiri were quite good and I especially liked the dumplings 👌🏻 I would go again! The price was also absolutely reasonable
Very good place to eat sushi in Padova 🍣 everything was tasty, good choice of food, fast service and nice atmosphere. To come back !
Clean, excellent food and service, unbelievable food choices! Loved all you can eat for €14.99 and the whole ambiance! Must go to tourist or not!

Great Iranian restaurant with delicious, high-quality food and generous portions. The taste truly reminded me of Iran and felt very authentic. Mr. Fariborz is extremely kind and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even better. Highly recommended

We were unfortunately very disappointed with our experience. During our trip in Northern Italy, after several days of travel and eating out, we were looking forward to trying this restaurant because we usually enjoy Persian and Middle Eastern cuisine and are often impressed by the friendliness and hospitality.

However, this time it was different. When we arrived, we were told that there were no free tables available, which we fully understand. What made us uncomfortable was the way we were spoken to. We had been waiting outside with our two children, and instead of a polite explanation, we felt unwelcome.

One comment in particular was very disrespectful. We were told that “this is not McDonald’s,” even though we never asked for anything inappropriate. We have nothing against McDonald’s, but such a remark towards a family with two small children felt unnecessary and unkind.

Because our children were hungry, we ordered the food to take away. We cannot rate the ambience or the restaurant itself, but the interaction was not kid‑friendly and the way we were treated made it impossible for us to enjoy the experience

We hope this was just an unfortunate moment, but we left feeling very disappointed by the lack of courtesy and respect.

A great Persian restaurant!
The food is 100% authentic and the quality is top notch! It’s EXACTLY what you get at the best restaurants in Iran.
The Dough and the Mast Musir are amazing.
The restaurant is a cozy place with comfortable couches and the design represents old Iranian restaurants, filled with elements of Iran history.
The owners are nice and friendly Iranian people and they actually gave us a lot of pointers on how to make Iranian dishes with what we can find in Italy, and where to get our ingredients.
All in all it was a great day, and I will definitely go back a lot!
Nice staff. Great ambient. Food was ok. Kabob was a bit dried and overcooked. But for such small town, finding a Persian restaurant is rare. So overall is was a great experience.
Delicious food and friendly staff in a very quiet and pretty location. Prices are a bit high but portion sizes are quite filling.

one of my top fav ramen spot in Padova, def highly recommended! ordered the soupless ramen “mazisoba with nikumiso” such refreshing taste and so delicious! we also get to try the “Bao” with the on going Bao nights event, personally really love the Tofu one!!

The kind staff named Alexandra was so friendly and helpful ; she explained to us carefully about the menu and took care of us really well throughout the night! Can’t wait to come back again to try out the other dishes on the menu ❤️

the ramen itself was quite tasty but in the end I found a big piece of plastic in it. I was pleased with the solution of the problem as I got a full refund. Also my friend ordered the vegan ramen but she got a meat one. It was also replaced so I would say the staff acted really nicely.
Delicious ramen! Many options, including vegan, for an affordable price. There was a great atmosphere and you can  add your own notes to the wall! Highly reccomend

Personally, the best ramen in town! I have tried the diverse options they have in the menu, and all the options are extremely tasty and original as they do in Japan!

They also have a nice drink menu offering kombucha and their own beer brand.

Everything about this place was perfect… except the ramen 😞 we were welcomed with small miso soup (10/10!) and ordered onigiri with tuna and mayo (10/10 as well!) but when it came to ramen… well we were kind of disappointed. It didn’t have any taste at all, very bland :( Lacked any savoury flavour.  I believe that with a little modifications it could still get better as the place itself has great potential!

They serve always delicious food. Pizzes are a bargain at this place!

Servers are super friendly. Unfortunately there is no English menu. Nothing what Google translate can't fix.

Excellent service and friendly people. We all enjoyed in this restaurant hospitality experience. We will definitely come back when we come again. Special thanks to Samoa and Donna who helped and served us properly and professionally.
Good luck guys….
Fantastic food in a pleasant and relaxing atmosphere. The delicious dinner we had was a wonderful end of an exciting trip! Thank you!
Amazing food and service
The workers were so nice and kind, the food was delicious, would love to come back again some day!

The 3 last time I went the bread of the pizza was burnt... the first time I told the manager ( the guy with glasses standing behind the cashier), he just said "ok". Not sorry! Just ok. Last night I went I asked the waiter, "I like the pizza here but last year it was very good we used to come, 3 times the bread was burnt and it makes it bitter." He said we have electric oven and it happens but i write bianca here. But again....

That's why they keep sending messages for discounts. Even on Saturday nights you can go and find a place without reservations... I will never go again!

Food was exceptiona, not only the flagship pizzas but everything else as well. Beautiful setting with inside and outside seating options. Staff were great, even when we arrived in the last hour of service. More pricey than other pizza places in Padova but there again, you are visiting an institution. Treat yourself.

Finally found the authentic Italian pizza I’ve been craving(& the friarelli e salsiccia : the real good one, you don't find it easy! )
This spot in the city center is amazing. Alessio and Gigi are so welcoming and professional—it clearly takes that level of expertise to craft a pizza this good. The ingredients and the dough are incredible. It’s definitely a must-visit in Padova
It's delicious. I recommend this place. The food is delicious. The atmosphere isn't great, and neither are the waiters. Maybe we just got unlucky with them; I don't know. But the food is delicious!!
Fast and really tasty pizza served. Authentic Italian ultra-thin base pizza with fresh vegetable toppings. Highly recommended. Vastly superior compared to the multinational franchises.

Everything was grate!
The service was very good, the food was amazing.
The antipasti was excellent!
The cooked vegetables was super tasty and the steak was amazing!
Very good food and service. Nice interior.

I found this restaurant randomly on the way through town and was amazed by it. It looked like a good sign when some customers greeted the chef with 'Ciao Maestro' when I walked in and it really was. The food was fantastic and the service extraordinary. I enjoyed the food so much that I ordered so much I couldn't even finish it, and I even brought more for dinner back home.

Some places try so hard to make themselves appear better than they are and you end up paying a lot of money for a good looking but mediocre plate. Here it is the opposite. Everything is genuine, they are not trying to be cool but serve good food instead and the result is a really great restaurant. I will definitely eat there again when I am in Padua.
The best place in padova. The food is absolutely amazing.  The staff are very friendly and can't help enough. It is definitely a must to come and have dinner here

Best restaurant in Padova to have a great dinner with the best meats there is !
Service was really good, very recommended.

Generous quantity and good pizza quality 😍 I definitely recommend it ❤️
The cheese calzone is soo big and such a generous quantity of cheese! 😍
Good dough, good pizza, quite pizza pala feel. Recommended
Normal pizza with a good price.
Worst staff always in angry mode

We're on holiday in Padua and discovered this pizza place right across the street – a real find!

Super friendly team, incredibly helpful despite a slight language barrier. And the pizza? Absolutely delicious, plus excellent value for money. They're so fast and great with kids.

We've been there three days in a row now – and we'll definitely be back! 😄

I used to buy falafel panino here as it's quite good. But today I took it takeaway as usual and headed to another district of the city to have lunch. Turned out they put kebab instead of falafel, waste of money, hungry and disappointed

The pizza was without flavour, it tastes nothing at all..
The price was 7.5 for a pizza and mushroom..
Also the kabab was the same (tasteless)!
I didn't like it at all
great place! very friendly staff, good priced food and tastes great. a go-to place when I don't want to make dinner
The pizza is GOOD and it's cheap. The owners are super nice too
Good kebabs and pizzas, deliveries are not the fastest in town. Price is okay.
I’m so happy I finally found a place serving Chicken dumplings aka ravioli . To my surprise, I loved Shrimp(Gamberi) ones even better. Definitely recommended, so Yumm.

This is one of my favorite food places in Portello! The dumplings are delicious and a good price (€5-5.5 for 6 pieces, €6-6.5 for 8). The edamame and red bean bun are also good! It’s a small place with only a couple seats but you can eat there if you’d like. And you can pay with card.

Losing count on how often I buy the ravioli de gamberi from here: bcos they are that TASTY! The taste of ‘chestnuts’ is just perfect, the owners are very nice but better if you take away compared to dine in
The perfect quick bite. Tasty, cheap, fast. It’s literally everything you could ever want. Go here. Now.
The dumplings were delicious and the price is great!! I highly recommend it! (In the picture I poured the soy sauce on top. It comes in a small container incase you want to dip it.)
Fantastic choice for people with intolerance
Top
Super
Top

Fantastic experience! The gluten-free products are top-notch, among the best I've ever tried in Italy. Everything is fresh and carefully prepared. The staff is incredibly friendly, and the coffee is truly excellent, which is not a given. If you're in the area, it's a must-visit. A well-deserved five stars!
Very pleasant stuff and great pizza with reasonable prices. Awesome!
Full of locals. Excellent pastas, good selection of local wines. Reasonable prices. Way to go, a nice place close to Autostrada and major hotels.

The restaurant has nearby parking facilities which is important. The actual restaurant seems quite small from outside but once inside it opens up like a handbag!
I had seppie nere with polenta and a mixed salad. It was excellent. A good sized portion, tender seppie in a very flavoursome inky sauce, fresh crunchy salad, and white sparking local wine.
My friends had  mixed fried fish, which was really tasty,I booking to go again to try for myself.
The staff were very friendly and efficient.
Great pizza, pasta and wine - very nice staff! We enjoyed dinner there a lot.
Fantastic pizzas 🍕, large menu to choose from. Only downside: The draft beer is Danish 😋

Let me paint you the picture. It was dark (9 pm), cold, and rainy. I just finished my workout at the gym, so above all else, I could’ve probably eaten a whole cow and half a horse by that point. I checked where to eat, and fast24 was a beacon of light among all the other restaurants ready to shut down for the night.
I walked through the door and the vibes were immaculate. You’re greeted with a smile right when you enter. During this visit I was seated by one of the employees, I think her name was Jeremy. She complemented me on my style and took my order.
From the atmosphere of the restaurant combined with my growing hunger I had very high expectations. I ordered the medium sized west coast burger combo with fries and a drink.
I have nothing but praise for the service, for I scrolled through three maybe four Instagram reels max in my fyp and suddenly my food appeared right in front of me.
Let me tell you, this meal healed my soul and all my past traumas. Every part of the burger seemed to come together perfectly. The burger patty was juicy and flavorful. The toppings balanced the meatiness, introducing another dimension of taste. Most importantly, I was informed by Jeremy that the buns were made fresh in the kitchen. I’ve never had buns THAT good. The burger was accompanied by the fries. Absolutely nothing bad to say about them. Crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside. All this was paired with a pint of beer.
I completely devoured that meal. I remembered walking home that night with a smile on my face because of it.
Overall I would recommend this place to anybody looking for a good quality burger. I thank Jeremy and the rest of the staff for their friendliness and service, making this experience unforgettable. I will be back soon, maybe even tomorrow

Greatful place and wonderful burgers.
Good choice of beers.

One of the few places open till late night.
The best burgers and fries!! Everything tastes amazing there, prices are not low but the quality is really high !!!
The burgers are amazing, make sure you have a green pass if you plan to eat in.
If you are looking for a place to eat good pizza, search no more. This is the right place to be
The best Tunisian food I’ve had in Padova so far! Highly recommended. The staff was very kind when we asked to change our order last minute, and the food was absolutely delicious.
Top level
Best fast food in Padova.

Delightful food!!
Such a sweet couple and Baba running this cozy little takeaway definitely worth the walk and the wait
Incredible, balanced flavours. If you’re craving comfort home food, this place will SAVE you

I had the escalope baguette 10,000,000/10 the bread 🔥 and that turkey 😍 The tajine was phenomenal too. I ate it on a bench in the dark and it was not exactly the easiest thing to attack 😂 ended up taking it home and absolutely devoured it… no photo survived lol.

Generous portions, lovely people, delicious food. One of my favourite spots in Padua and I’ll definitely be back! 🤍
unreal. the best kebab i’ve ever had. 11/10

Our favourite gelato in Padua! Simply delicious - all the flavours are exceptional. The pistachio is the best we’ve ever had, and the salted caramel is truly delicious too. Super friendly staff, generous portions, and great value. 😊
Great ice cream and Frozen yoghurt. Super friendly staff, she speaks italian, english and french ! If you are in Padova definitely have an ice cream there!
Really good ice cream and very kind service!

I recently tried "La Granita Siciliana" Pistachio at Glatto. While I appreciated the smooth and refreshing texture, I found the taste to be a bit too sweet for my liking. That said, the shop itself is fantastic! It was spotlessly clean, and the staff were incredibly friendly, speaking English fluently, which made the experience even better.

Overall, I had a positive experience, and I give Glatto 5 stars for their excellent service and inviting atmosphere. I’m definitely coming back to try their gelato!
Absolutely wonderful gelato. The pistachio is to die for!  Very friendly staff who spoke English and were very helpful.  Definitely recommend stopping here while in Padova!
We drank blackcherry, it was good. The waitress, Laura, she was super nice with us. We would like to come here again. Thank you for everything
super cozy and nicely furnished cafe, I loved the vibe, the music and my favorite hot chocolate

Beautiful interiors and location, BUT:
1) Booking system is a mess and even thought we arrived on time they overbooked the table to other people who never arrived;
2) Food quality is horrible;
3) Drink super watered.
4) Super slow service even though place was quite empty. 1h to give cold pasta.
Only positive was the cake.
Not recommended at all.
The barista with the mullet hair gave us wonderfull essences after we told him it was my birthday. We love him but he doesn’t now. U rock dude keep doing it.
My always go to spot, best music. This place is like a therapy.

This sushi restaurant in Padova has become a reliable staple for the city. The atmosphere is consistently comfortable with a minimalist Japanese style that feels modern and pleasant. The open kitchen allows you to try to glimpse some interesting secrets of Japanese cuisine. The staff is highly qualified, friendly, and attentive. The menu is varied and frequently updated to satisfy the most discerning palates. The option of sushi with black and pink rice is particularly interesting. At the end of the meal, don't miss a small glass of Nikka Whisky - it will win you over!

Considering that this is a sushi place in Italy, it was still surprisingly good. We ordered a ton of nigiri, rolls, miso soup, gyoza and drinks and it all tasted fresh and was put together really well. My partner's father, who is Japanese, left really happy and full, so that was a great sign. At the end of our meal, one of the staff members treated us to free Japanese liquors, which was super nice and a great way to end our meal.

The service was great but it’s quite expensive and quantities are less. They have very few 3 vegetarian options only. I have eaten there twice and my experience is: they always try to suppress the avocado amount in veg sushi. Last time I ordered cucumber Avocado sushi, in most of them cucumber was missing or barely found!!

Drinks are also very limited, not many options available.
Overall experience with borderline quality!
The price was … so so, but tasty and nice

Temaki that I got was awesome. Love it so much. Others are ummm... I can say that they're good, but I wouldn't say this is my favourite because the sushi rice was a bit bitter, not really bitter but the tone really appears on the tongue. They mentioned that this is because of rice vinegar and sake that they put. I honestly never put sake in my sushi rice when I make it at home so I don't have a good judgement here if this tasted normal or not.
When we paid, they gave us a liquor that they make in house. Yum!

It is small place that only offers take away. It has good quality with respect to what it costs.
And it is delicious.

Review: I think the owner has changed or some other major thing, now it is not any different to any other kebab shop, arguably worse than some. 😩

Today I ordered double hamburger from this place and I waited so long to be served. Just few seconds after I ate the first bite I saw an "insect" in the bread, I just took it and showed it to one of the workers there and he just took it without apologizing and said he will prepare another one (as if it's so normal and nothing happened). I left the place and no one of them apologized for this... not even a small sorry !  Honestly I give a big flop for the service, so disappointed ...
They don't have manner how to serve customer food the behavior is also not good never suggest

I ordered some pizza today but that food was cool and not properly cooked as well…
Overall disappointing 😡
The food taste good,smell well...best kebab in town....
During my three month stay in Padova in 2023, i lived close to this joint. The restaurant serves good local cuisines at affordable prices. The owner was so nice.
Local non expensive food for "workers", very good lunch! Quick service.
Cheap and quick. Ideal for lunch break during work... if you work nearby
only 3 stars can offer for this restaurant
Orromp

Great service and food. Each dish was spicy enough and yet tolerable.
Overall it was a really nice experience, can't wait to visit again and try a different dish.
Definitely recommend.
My family and I were visiting Padova and decided to have lunch here. It was so delicious! And the staff was so so nice with us. I can't recommend it enough.

1st time -Very nice owner and delivery is free within 2 km in Padova.

2nd time _ Baigan bhartha and aloo paratha. Simply superb
Great food. Tasty affordable.  I had naan , tandoori chicken and veg kurma with mango lassi
Ordered takeout from here. The food was delicious, freshly made, and had a generous portion size.

My favourite 3 star of all time 🥹 the whole experience was amazing. It was an honour to be able to experience the youngest 3 star Michelin chef and we were served with warm hospitality.

Food was incredible and unforgettable. My fiance and I celebrated our first engagement dinner here. We also purchased the recipe book and some merchandise glasses

Le Calandre is amazing! We had an exceptional meal prepared by chef Max, and served by GianDomenico, Christian, and Jonathan. They are the best! Chef Max‘s creations are really a balance between food and art, and it was really on another level. The service was exceptional also - Giando and Christian took time to explain each dish in detail, and Jonathan always made sure the food was presented well. My favourite was the cappuccino murrina, which was so beautiful and delicious, and the really special pasta with all parts of the egg; even the egg shell. We also met chef Max, who is super nice and an extremely talented chef! We will really enjoy our gift as well - thank you to the team for an outstanding experience!!!!!

Not the best.

This felt very much like a “style over substance” experience.

For example, they have you put earplugs in during the first few bites of one of their iconic pasta dishes. I thought that was kind of cool, until I realized that the ingredient causing the sensation of “popping” you both “feel” and hear was the thing causing the dish to taste a bit strange. That wasn’t for my palate.

The “fried pizza ball” was very underwhelming and taste-wise (not execution) felt like something I could cook myself.

But I thought I could set that aside for their famous Risotto. It was great, but not exceptional. They also gave you a glass of “scent” to use alongside the tasting of the Risotto which, again, was an interesting idea, but didn’t elevate it much.

Finally we moved onto a few other dishes that while they were good, didn’t meet the expectations of what a 3-star price tag should.

I think there are far better options in Italy than Le Calendre. It’s not bad… but it’s just not great, or even good.

Obviously you can't complain about the food, nor the service, it's a three star Michelin and has been at that level for two decades. However I found that service was very relaxed and warm in the best understanding of those terms. We had the classic menu which apart being excellent, had some jokey items in  it including a surprising little hollow ball made of egg white with a popcorn inside it. There is also a fake mozzarella in the dessert items which is really a wonder on how they manage to produce it.
We talked to the Chef a couple of times, who seemed interested in our reaction to what we had just eaten.

It may be a surprising thing to say, but we had a very good time there.
Italian classics reinvented and reinterpreted by Chef Alajmo, offering a memorable culinary journey elevated by creative dish presentations and attentive service in an elegant atmosphere. Thank you!
Definitely my favourite breakfast spot - cheap and but delicious!
I really love this cafe. The bakeries are so delicious except the pistachio cream which tastes like artificial pistachio and powdered sugar. Also the staff are quite nice.
I really love this place. One of the best pasticcerias in Padova, period. A wide selection of delicious brioches, excellent coffee and incredibly friendly staff!
Cornetto are amazing with 1.6€/p, a little busy but just a bit of waiting till your turn to order. Nice café and they have out door tables as well.

The brioches here are just perfect. The variety and quality are excellent. I recommend this place from the bottom of my heart. The always positive, smiling staff makes the whole place feel just ideal.
Amazing quality, super delicious food, friendly people! Highest recommendations to try! 💜✨✨

Lovely restaurant roughly 10 minutes walk from the train station. The owner was very friendly and helpful in recommending the best pizza. They were delicious and very inexpensive. Would highly recommend!
The owner was super friendly. The pizza was super light and delicious 😋.  It's a 10/10...... I recommend
Excellent Pizza! Friendly staff! Good prices! Highly recommend! Will definitely visit again!
The food was cheep and super delicious. The owner was very hospitable and friendly and even treated us with a free limonchello.
Best meal I had so far this year. Davide explained everything in great detail. The meatballs and desserts in particular were fantastic. Wonderful selection of wines. We will be back!

We stopped by for a drink and dinner, but the experience was completely ruined by the arrogant attitude of the staff. We ordered wine, and the pour was absurdly small. When we politely asked the waitress about it, instead of a professional response, we received a patronizing and hostile answer: "That’s just how much we serve here."
​The bad vibe and snobbish attitude made us decide to cancel our food order immediately and leave. To top it off, we were still charged for the "coperto" (table service) just for sitting down for a few minutes to endure bad service.
​Unwelcoming, pretentious, and definitely not recommended.

This was a wonderful experience! The food which you share was amazing and all vegan/vegetarian! So tasty with regional and seasonal ingredients! The service was excellent and the atmosphere welcoming.

I wish I loved it because I love Leone Rosso and I love the concept. Though the dishes were pretty good, the atmosphere was lacking with the bright lights and moody waitress. Pains me to say but especially the lack of warmth and helpfulness from the waitress is the reason I probably won’t return.
It looks like a trattoria it is a trattoria but the surprise is the food litetally delicious and unexpected! Enjoy your surprise Enjoy good wine

We saw the BOHO restaurant while walking in the old city of Padova, Italy. The beautiful restaurant is nestled by the small river in a magical forest setting that seem not connected to the surrounding world. We were greeted by a wonderful staff and decided to eat outside in the lush garden. Julia and Simone, out waiters were so sweet and knowledgeable. They spoke perfect English too. The menu was very interesting and unique like nothing we had in Italy. From the starters of sweet tartar, yummy salad with fresh pear, gazpacho with baked cheese and puffed pastries with veggies to the main courses of perfectly done steaks, prawns, and tasty special pastas, EVERYTHING was perfect. Julia and Simone engaged in lovely conversation between meals and were very sweet and hospitable. We finished with desserts of pudding cake, fruit creams and, the best mousse I’ve had in a long while. We also had a nice recommended wine with dinner and finished with perfect espressos. The beautiful surrounding and the magnificent food is an experience we will not forget.
On our way out, we were greeted by Daniele, the owner, who invited us for a shot of grappa.
If you find yourself in beautiful Padova, in the old city (and you love exceptionally good food), I wouldn’t miss BOHO RESTAURANT. It’s about 15 minutes of easy walk from the center of town, in almost a secret spot that is more than worth the visit.

We found this restaurant by accident but what a find!
We originally were headed to a casual cicchetti place but saw this lovely restaurant surrounded by a garden.
We went in and fell in love with the outdoor area and the wonderful staff.
The food and service are great!
We noticed they have several South African wines plus Malva Pudding for dessert. So we asked the staff if anyone involved with the restaurant was South African. As it turns out one of the owners is from Johannesburg.
We had the pasta with clams and the pear salad with Gorgonzola, both delicious! For dessert we had the Malva Pudding, also wonderful!
We can’t say enough positives for the food and service!
Thank you to Christian and the entire staff for a beautiful lunch!
Very highly recommended!!!

Very peaceful atmosphere with kind staff and amazing food. Tried the cooked meat tasting, everything was really tasty and pleasantly served. If you’re looking for a unique food experience then that’s the place!
Wonderful to have the diner in the garden. Such a pretty ambiance. And the food was so good.

Excellent meal. The Sirloin Heifer was cooked to perfection. The sautéed artichokes were the perfect touch!

Tempura Prawns were perfect, nice & crunchy with that accompanying sauce.

The staff was excellent & spoke perfect English. The young lady who waited on us was amazing!

Never go there!

Was good not to much Chinese food a lot of seafood,much better then Chinese Buffet in san Francisco bay area also a good brand of gelato sammontana also the price € 19.00
Very good place to have sushi and especially the Chinese food is just yum! If you are a foodie (Chinese and sushi fan) then you should be there. It's a buffet and the dessert are to doe for 🤤

Only problem: they need somebody to check-up on certain customers who overload their portions singularly, without consideration of who is next. Kitchen is open and visible. Clean and comfy

If you're looking for an experience that goes beyond a simple lunch or dinner, this restaurant is a must-visit. The atmosphere is extremely intimate. Limited seating ensures a rare sense of tranquility.
The father-and-son management team is the true beating heart of the restaurant, a perfect blend of traditional expertise and a modern vision. You immediately sense a meticulous focus on the finest ingredients, selected with a care that only those who truly love their craft can possess.
Highly recommended!!!

I haven't eaten such carefully selected and carefully prepared dishes in a long time. Renato and his team were impeccable. They give the right value to the products they prepare, and it shows. You can taste it in the passion they put into it, which is completely reflected in what you eat.
Congratulations, and again, congratulations!

Today I stopped for a square spaghetti with clams. I strongly advise you not to come to this place, because I'm sure I'll find a place there. But above all, I recommend coming to Nautilus only if you love poetry. That way you'll be able to fully savor the free tercets, the rhymes between the lines of the shells, and the delicious clams. Excellent and delicious food in a refined, intimate, and very welcoming atmosphere. The two chefs are super kind and friendly. A must-try! Hoping to return to Padua soon, it will definitely be one of our stops.

The best pizza options are amazing, a lot of toppings choices, but I always choose margherita it's quite greasy but its the best taste I've tasted and also cheap 😋  there's an English speaker there as well

Excellent service, and very fast if you pick it up directly.

The restaurant is located in the very center of the city, but on a side street, so no big crowds. The menu is short and focused on local specialties. The food definitely met my expectations—simple, fresh, and filling. The portions were generous, enough to fill you up with just one dish and a side dish. €3 for a coperto is a bit steep, but the Veneto region is at least fairly consistent here, as lower prices are rare. A big plus for the very competent and friendly service, who spoke fluent English. Nothing to complain, everything to eat.

A great and authentic experience! The food was excellent, accomodating to dietary restrictions (vegeterian), the lady waiting was sweet and lovely, helpful in suggestions. The ambient and vibe are great. Would recommend!

A really nice osteria, small and welcoming.

Lovely wine bar with excellent kitchen and friendly staff. Enjoyed the beef tartare and fettuccine ragu, both excellent. Nice wine selection to match the food.

If I could give this 10 stars I would!  A small wine bar with an open kitchen.  A small but excellently prepared menu.  The cacio pepe with crispy guanciale was out of this world, the pork ribs were beyond delicious, abd the carrot hummus was amazing.  We had a perfect wine to accompany our meal, all served by friendly and helpful staff. We highly recommend!
It's been like ages since i ate pizza... like old days. It's priceless,  thank you....

Found Mama Eat on a late night walk, so we had lunch here the next day. The staff worked as a team, especially the host who actually took the time to recommend several local restaurants in Trastevere for the last week of our Italy adventure.  The pasta carbonara and also the rigatoni Amatricana were both incredible. We will definitely go back and try more. Also had a great bottle of wine which was recommended by the host as well. For a chain restaurant,  we were impressed!

I loved the place! I love the idea of a gluten-free restaurant which has two kitchens and can make foods with gluten also.
I liked the vibe, the whole place looked brand new.
The gluten-free pizza was fresh and delicious.
The staff was nice.

Very good food! Felt very safe as celiac as everything is a separate kitchen . Highly recommend the rice ball appetizer thing was soooo good! Nice area in the midst of the shopping area but not crowded too.
Good food and service! Lots of gluten free options (entire menu can be made gluten free)

Hidden gem restaurant, with a beautiful, classy interior, kind and assisting staff, and some of the best food I have ever had. The uramaki Magnolie is a must-have for sushi lovers. Especially notable is the cleanliness of the restaurant and restrooms, the speed and attention of service, and the easy-to-navigate menu. If you are visiting or living in Padova, you must try Magnolie Mulan.
Very nice relaxing atmosphere for Sunday lunch. All you can eat served at the table is good value and the food is mostly very good.

The food was very good and tasty. The staff were extremely friendly and welcoming. The decoration and overall ambiance were great and created a really positive, cheerful atmosphere. I really enjoyed my visit and would definitely come back!
The food is fresh, delicious and pretty. Perfect if you wanna take cute pictures, too! Personnel is friendly and the interior is nicely decorated. I would definitely recommend to eat here!

Good value for the price, loved the service.
Waiters are super friendly spcially Matteo

This tapas bar is small with 2 tables of 6 and two for 2-3 people.

They have an English menu and communicate well in English.
The regular tapas are €1.5 each and the small pizza starts at €5.
They have beer on tap and a full bar service.
One clean washroom which is even equipped for handicapped people.
4 tapas, a draft beer and a small pizza cost €17.  A nice place with tasty tapas.
Perfect local aperitivo experience. Delicious spritz and sandwiches at great price. Very kind staff and cosy vibes. Locals go there so that’s a good sign as well

Hands down the best cicchetti and wine bar in town! The food was fresh and delicious, the atmosphere was lively, and the whole place had a great vibe. It seemed to be a popular spot with young locals, which added to the fun. Highly recommend if you're looking for a casual yet quality experience!

My friends and I were looking for a place to stop in town near the city center. This spot had had reviews and was a short walk from a local parking lot. We had the meatball board and Processco. It was a great time. Good wine, food amd vibes!
I really like this place. If you want to get a quick bite, cheap and nice, this is a nice place! Plus service is very nice.
Giulia is an excellent waitress. Made my birthday dinner extra special because of her warmth. Thank you Giulia!
Top notch various steak from grill.
