A modern and elegant grill restaurant with an open kitchen and a welcoming atmosphere. A family-friendly atmosphere and courteous service.
Suitable for both dinners with friends and more informal occasions.
Strengths:
Good-quality grilled meats, with generous portions and well-cooked cuts.
Tartare prepared at the table and carefully selected appetizers are among the best dishes.
The menu offers meat dishes, mixed grills, and even more elaborate dishes (e.g., bigoli, appetizers, tartare). The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful.
Service is quick, but on some busy evenings, the experience can be a bit chaotic.
Prices are in line with the quality of the ingredients, especially the meat.
One of the best burgers I've ever had! Fries were delicious! Beer selection was great! Luca was an excellent waiter!
Lovely, completely lovely. 100% recommend, must visit 😃😃😃❤️❤️. Kind service, delicious food, amazing drinks.  Service in Italian and English. Fair price ☺️

Excellent pub with amazing beer options and friendly staff that actually know what they're talking about. Good food too with decent (Italian-sized) portions. I live a few towns away and come here about once a week

Big group for supper. Took a long time for burgers to arrive.
Service haphazard.
Burger ok...had a bit of bone.
Lovely beer place which has even a bitter beer
Stumbled upon by chance, late evening, long trip, tired. The service was excellent, helpful, fast and friendly (Karen), food very good, at reasonable prices.

The staff were incredibly sweet and welcoming. The food was delicious, and we truly enjoyed our meal. Thank you so much for everything. We will definitely come back the next time we're here. Highly recommended!

Conveniently located right next to my hotel. Their kitchen is open late and reservations don't seem to be absolutely necessary, at least not during the week. Both times I went for dinner it was very quiet. The staff were very pleasant, especially the waitress who kindly spoke Italian with me :) I appreciated that she would ask if you wanted to order coffee or dessert or just take a few minutes to consider. Despite the late hours I never felt rushed.

I was between appointments and needed to find a place for a quick lunch with my wife and toddler. I am so glad I found L'ingotto. The staff was wonderful and quickly found us a table and setup a highchair. The food was all excellent, reasonably priced, and delicious. Everyone was extremely friendly and helped my family find a moment of relaxation in an otherwise hectic day. I plan to return as soon as possible.
Very nice place. Some dishes are splendid. Prices are lower than average.

Extremely friendly guys. Food is great ( and I’m picky. I d just love to have a bit more cheeses on my cold cuts platter). Homemade zaetti are sublime.
Jazz band, Cremant. All in all wonderful evening

The meat was tender, juicy, and delicious both my friend and I loved it. The potatoes were good, and the pasta was refreshing and light, not heavy at all. The restaurant is elegant, calm, and comfortable. The restroom is clean, has a bidet, and even provides personal essentials for women. We truly appreciate this place and highly recommend it don’t hesitate for a second if you’re reading this

This was the best dinner of our entire trip—we loved everything! The hospitality of the owner and the waiter was exceptional. The food was amazing, especially the octopus carpaccio and the proccheri with gorgonzola and pear. The restaurant features a fantastic pianist with incredible charm, making the evening even more special. Thank you so much for a wonderful night! It's a shame we have to leave. If we were staying longer, we would definitely come back.

One of the best Restaurants in Padova. The place is beautiful, the service is great and very friendly and the food is outstanding. This place is definitely a recommendation. We had starters and the Tagliata di Angus and the slow cooked pork. Fantastic!

Recently, we had the pleasure of dining at Ristorante Caffè Letterario Treccani in Padova. While the ambiance was lively, it did lean a bit too noisy at times due to the jazz band. However, the food more than made up for the acoustics.

The Bigoli in salsa Veneto was a delightful start—rich and flavorful. The beef fillet wellington that followed was extra yummy, cooked to perfection and bursting with taste. To top it all off, the pistachio tiramisù was quite an interesting twist on a classic dessert, leaving a memorable impression.

Despite the noise, the culinary experience at Ristorante Caffè Letterario Treccani was well worth it, and the delicious food left us more than satisfied.

Foods are great but too oily.
Customer service bad not even say “Grazie” but they always say “non si appoggiare”.
At least give us some chairs to sit or something to lean while waiting order. Some orders can take up to 15 mins like ravioli.
I love the food but i don’t think i would go back anyway.

I had the udon noodles with chicken and soy sauce. Honestly the flavor was nothing exciting, but it was still good. The portion size was good for the price, the vegetables seemed fresh, and it was ready very quickly (other reviews seem to suggest that it gets very crowded but I guess I was lucky - at 19:30 on a Tuesday I was the only person there). I love the customizable structure of the menu, and I think that having more sauce options would really elevate it. But overall, considering the price and location, I think it’s a good, convenient takeaway option.

I'm always interested to try any chinese takeout restaurant in Padova. I found Wok Time and saw they had high rating and a lot of good reviews so I was interested to try and had a high expectation. The first time I tried Wok Time, I came there when it was just opened so there was no customer and I got my food in 5 minutes but the second time, I came there around 2pm and there was a pretty long queue so I had to wait around 15 minutes or more to get my food (I heard that there is always a queue so I suggest to come early).

I've tried their riso con verdure miste and riso con gamberetti🍚🥗🍤 both of them were good but not special (I've tried better chinese takeout food). All of their dishes are inexpensive but the portion size was pretty small for me. I only found a few pieces of gamberetti but it makes sense since it's not expensive. They came in a carton box which is great🥡 overall, I still recommend Wok Time. Worth to try when you're not in a hurry and also could be a great choice for students especially.
The spicy udon is really good, the price is reasonable.
No dine in option. I got egg noodles with picanto sauce. Taste was good for me. But in my opinion oil was too much. For lunch Price was reasonable

We found this place by chance and didn't regret: a spacious hall, cycling-inspired decor, and good food.
We didn't understand why the waiter told us the prosecco we ordered would be for free because it was the bartender's birthday and he treated guests with free drinks. As it turned out, the drinks were included in the bill.
We didn't need freebie, so this odd detail lowered overall rating.
Pork cheek was scrumptious and son really loved his pici ragu. Interior decor is cool too if you enjoy cycling.
The first place in Italy where instead of chips or nachos we got perfectly cooked hard boiled eggs ! For me it was a dream !

My dear friends, let me introduce you to the best crostini I’ve ever had in Italy. In Padua, I experienced a true gastronomic orgasm  crispy bread, fresh ingredients, and a flavor that will stay with me forever.

Such a beautiful place in the heart of Padova. They offer many diverse dishes and most of them traditional dishes from Tuscany.

They organize concerts and vibe is vibrant. Also.. if you are passionated about cycling and bikes, this is your place.

This was my family’s favorite restaurant during our experience in Padua. Drinks, food, service and atmosphere were exceptional for our party of 11 w/ children. Every dish was wonderful. I highly recommended the Balsamic Glazed Ribs and the Truffle Tortellini (very rich). My 4 year old loved the Tortellini Ragu and my 7 year old loved the dried tortellini app as her meal. The location was excellent for and after dinner warm in the park.

Quick and proffesional service, delicious food and good prices. If you are around, you wont make a mistake by stopping by for a dinner. We had 3 items from the menu and all were delicious. And the amous bouche was also really good.

Wow!!! The best food in Padoa with the nicest personnel. I went there twice and ate two dishes and dessert both times. Just absolutely breathtaking each time, with great wine recommendations and great discussions with the head chef. Very kind person with a magnificent eye for both food and service. Amazing experience and highly recommended! Try the lasagna :)
Amazing food - completely something else than regular pizza & pasta - ravioli, pastatelli with trufles and especially ribs… amazing. Big wow!

This delicious restaurant in Padova is a must-visit for anyone craving authentic cuisine from Emilia Romagna. The dishes are a true taste of the region, from the incredible tagliere filled with a fantastic selection of fresh-cut meats and cheeses to the truly amazing tortellini, which were perfectly cooked and filled with flavor. The star of the show was the ragù, a rich and wonderful sauce that tasted like it had been simmering for hours. Every dish was a delicious and unforgettable experience.

Vinet is a cozy and calm restaurant in central Padua. I went here with my partner and we had a two course meal. The staff was super friendly and service-minded and this is were we had the best food during our stay in Padua. Also, vinet (the wine in Swedish) was also good here. We will return.

20251114 - located in padova downtown area that offers italian cuisine. Place is quite crowded. Ordered a variety of food which includes pasta, horse tartare, risotto with chicken liver, wine, tiramisu, wild boar. Food is outstanding and every dish is flavourful. Had an enjoyable dinner.

Just spent the last two evenings at this lovely place. Why twice? Three simple reasons that you'd think every restaurant owner would understand, but so often don't appear to. A short and impeccable menu. Far better to have a short menu of well made choices. A strong understanding of wines (which I'm guessing was the origin of the place?). And the last totally essential ingredient. A warm, welcoming, friendly and human team. This place has it all in a contemporary and easy going environment. I already look forward to returning.

I found this restaurant on google and food looks nice so I gave it a try. The food was really good. We enjoyed every bite! The desserts were delicious as well! Highly recommend! The service was great and helpful too.
A fantastic meal and experience. There are so many options to eat in the city, but we are so happy we chose Vinet. Scallop gnocchi were amazing!
KIND STAFF, GOOD FOOD, FAIR PRICES
Hidden away but worth the journey. Nice ambient and food.
Traditional cousin Veneto
Good food, good location!

Busy with a short wait for a table - had tried to reserve via Google but no reply. The rib eye was tasty and tender and the meat plate was good with a variety of textures. All meat was cooked as requested. Potatoes were average. For desert we had the rum chocolate which was very rummy and thick - so more a dessert than a drink. The Sundae with salted caramel was yummy. Staff all tried to help and were friendly.
The place looks very cool and they name each part of the restaurant like an old American town, it is a fun place and the food is good but it is not super Special.

The best: the variety of food. There are a lot of burgers, tacos, and just 3 options for salads. I took a salad, it was good but not that big. The environment is Western style, so it is kind of nice all in wood.

Nice place with Texas/ American dishes, food is good, especially wraps (Santa Cruz wrap for 6€ is big enough, with chicken and taste good). My personal recommendation is mozzarella sticks - must try!
Staff is very friendly and speaks english.

❗️if you download the app Wild West (scan QR code on menu) you can get a discount for your order (10% for the first one and 5€ for next ones)

Very nice and friendly place.
Among the best burgers I have tried in Padova.

This is your best option if you are in the area and want to grab a drink (hot/cold/alcoholic/non-alcoholic) or want a a quick bite.

The bar is a big open space with plenty of indoor/outdoor sitting. Try to sit outside so you can have a nice view of Prato della Valle.

Service is quick, attentive and friendly.

Prices are good.

Yo, if you’re Interrailing through Italy, you cannot skip this spot in Padua. It’s got that massive, old-school European grandeur but with a totally welcoming, international pulse. Sitting here with a coffee feels like you’re part of some secret history club. The vibe is sophisticated yet surprisingly chill for a backpacker budget if you just grab a quick espresso at the bar. It’s the perfect place to recharge your phone and your soul before catching the next train to Venice. Met travelers from three different continents just while waiting for my brew. Pure aesthetic goals, high energy, and zero pretension. An absolute legendary Paduan staple for the modern nomad. Five stars for the mood alone!

I had a very tasty sandwich and the best coffee in Italy. The service was excellent, we communicated very easily in English. The coffee was so good that I took a couple of packets for my Nespresso machine. The waiter also explained a little about the coffees to me, which I liked even more. 10/10 experience, every recommendation

I came to this café and ordered an Americano. The water they served on the side wasn’t enough, so I politely asked for a bit more because the coffee was too strong for me. The waiter told me they couldn’t give me more water unless I paid again.
Since I couldn’t drink the coffee, I left it on the table, and they took it back without saying anything.

This place is incredible!

There is a huge amount of pastries which are all incredibly tasty!

The coffee is spectacular. They offer a huge range of drinks.

You must try the single origin coffee range. Made through the V60

I visited this recently opened all-you-can-eat restaurant. The atmosphere is pleasant and the staff was friendly. Parking was also convenient.

As for the food, I can't fault the quality, but personally, I wasn't particularly impressed. The dishes are the classics found everywhere in this type of restaurant, with no truly unique offerings or anything that sets it apart from the others.

Overall, it was an average experience. I'm giving it 3 stars because, while everything was fine, it didn't leave me with anything memorable.

Ein echtes Highlight für Sushi-Liebhaber! Das All-you-can-eat-Konzept überzeugt auf ganzer Linie. Alle Gerichte werden frisch zubereitet, sind wunderschön angerichtet und geschmacklich hervorragend. Besonders das Sushi war von bester Qualität – frischer Fisch, perfekter Reis und eine große Auswahl an kreativen sowie klassischen Variationen.

Auch die warmen Speisen waren hervorragend und wurden schnell serviert. Der Service war aufmerksam, freundlich und trotz gut besuchtem Restaurant stets professionell. Das moderne und stilvolle Ambiente macht den Besuch zusätzlich zu einem besonderen Erlebnis.

Für mich eines der besten Sushi-Restaurants der Region. Wer hochwertiges All-you-can-eat-Sushi sucht, ist hier genau richtig. Ich komme auf jeden Fall wieder!

We had lunch on a Saturday. The interior was very well-kept and clean. It wasn't too crowded, so it wasn't noisy.
You can choose between an all-you-can-eat or à la carte menu. The menu offers a wide selection and moderate prices.
Fast service.

I went there for lunch for the first time. They have a nice parking lot with plenty of space. The place is welcoming, clean, and modern, with pleasant background music.
The staff is young, friendly, and helpful, and offers excellent service. Ordering is done via an iPad, which is very easy to use.
The food is really good, and the portions are just right.
It's an all-you-can-eat option.
I'll definitely be back!
A nice, very clean place with a nice atmosphere, fast and friendly staff, excellent food, above average, fantastic raw fish, fair price, we will definitely be back.

Visited THOPE recently and had a great experience. The mix of Indian and Italian dishes is really interesting and everything we tried was tasty. The staff were friendly and service was quick. The ambience is nice and casual, perfect for hanging out with friends. Overall, a great place for affordable and diverse food. Would definitely visit again!
The chilli chicken is the must try dish, it is amazing and the thali is so so good the quantity is so good and a perfect home made meal.
The staff is super accommodating and the thope special pizza taste so good. 💯 recommended ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I was looking for healthy, delicious, vegan food and I found it here! Prakash and Harsha really looked after us and made sure we had everything we needed! The food and the service were just incredible!

This is a new restaurant in town with best quality food and very neat atmosphere..the staff and the owner is very friendly . They have many vegetarian and vegan options...we also tried their pizza it's amazingly delicious

Rooms are fantastic, very nice, modern, classy and super clean. Food is also very good. Fresh sea food cooked the Venetian (Veneto) way. Waiters are gentle. The problem is the owner, he has always a bad mood face and he's always ready to reprimend you or to complain about.
Location...well, depends on what you are looking for. You definitely need a car to move around.
Great stay! The hotel is in a perfect location, modern and very clean. Comfortable bed, excellent shower, delicious breakfast, and secure parking inside the area.

I didn't particularly like this restaurant but it was suggested by friends who think it's great. Obviously everybody has their opinion. We had an entree of fish and a main course. I was disappointed because I was expecting wonderful culinary delights.... didn't get them! On the other hand should you speak to my friends they would be full of praise.
Great place, true Venican sea food... All extra fresh! Great vine selection! Top service! Excelent price to quality ratio... For our family on off favorite places... A must visit place!
Very delicious seafood, the best in my opinion is the tuna tartare
They have the BEST panino Kebab in Padova! Staff is so kind! I already miss their food so much.
Guy was nice, food was top notch. Aura. Real Larpers come here (keep it niche).

KIND STAFF, FAIR PRICES.
BUT one of the KEBAB was ALMOST EMPTY. KEBAB QUALITY BELOW AVERAGE.

Worst pizza i ever ate. Photo says enough

The guys are nice and welcoming... excellent kebab and beers from 0.66 to 2€... find me a place like this... those who leave negative reviews forget about the establishments run by Paduans where the NAS pass by and keep them closed for a month due to hygiene deficiencies... 100 and praise well done guys 💪🏼

Once a month, my colleagues, Angela in particular, and I go to this kebab shop closest to our offices. The staff is super friendly, always takes our phone orders, and always respects the delivery time. The kebab, needless to say, is delicious, well-seasoned, and there have NEVER been any mistakes with the ingredients. My colleagues and I always enjoy going to Gastronomia Kebab Pizza suma Moriom Akther. And we highly recommend it! A ray of light on a rainy day!

It's a shame you can't give a zero! Not only do they barely understand a word, they're even beardless and rude! Cleanliness? It would be more appropriate to say police! They should be put in jail! I hope, for your own health, you avoid touching the doorknob to enter the "shop"!
Simply awful.
Chicken wings are really awful, little meat and lots of bone, too long a wait for just 2 kebabs and a portion of wings

Fantastic lunch, great service, no language barrier. Everyone's food was fantastic. The pesto pasta was some of the best I've had in a long time, the eggplant parmesan was super flavorful and even the smaller smash burger was very big and delicious! Right off a super scenic piazza and market. Highly recommend! If you are nearby, you need to stop in and have a bite! I will anytime I am in the city.

Truly outstanding. Service was attentive but not rushed, pasta was excellent, fresh and delicious. The veal ragu was the best I’ve had, ever. Atmosphere is elegant and romantic. I’d give more stars if I could! Grazie Mille ❤️
Wonderful lunch at a fine gem found near the market.  Really great fresh Italian meat and cheese appetizers. Good wine selections.

Super kind staff, amazing service, beautiful interiors.
Highly recommended.
Only negative was the Tagliatelle with porcini and fonduta. Not tasteful enough.
Overall highly recommend for romantic meal.

I got food poisoning from the lobster rolls and vomited all night. Tbh it arrived suspiciously early. It was tasty though. The other thing was that after 100+ € bill, when someone spilled their 2 € drink without having to chance to drink it, i would have expected them to offer to refill it (since its 2 €!!). Waiters were nice.
Nice little authentic place, got 2 Big Fellas and 2 Select spritzes - I recommend!
Truly the Platonic form of the panineria - mum and daughter duo, so many options it’s overwhelming, all delicious.
I definitely recommend it, a world of flavor with just 3 ingredients (spinach, brie cheese, and ham)

I definitely marked this place even before coming to Italy. It's been two years since I arrived and not even once I tried it, so I made up my mind to visit it and give it a try, finally.
But this place isn't really for me, I guess. After trying a lot of different places, I find it not really on par with its reputation. I've tried better places (yes, not only one) with a better queue system, better service, and most importantly: better value for money!
I came here around 13:00, and it wasn't the best time to come here. Too many people and the queue is just so messy. Not to mention, there was this bunch of new students who took a very long time to decide what they wanted to eat. Then, I had to wait a bit as well because apparently people who ordered before me didn't hear it when the staff was calling their name. If only they had a better way to arrange their customers during the peak time, maybe I'll give it a better rating. Taste wise, their porchetta is good, super good!
I really recommend you to get something with porchetta if you come here, but then... if you're hungry and in a hurry, maybe you don't really want to go here.
Usually the panino will cost you around 4.5 for the simplest one to 6€-ish for the more complicated one. Then if you ask for a maxi size (the bigger one), expect to pay 2-2.5€ more.

Another tip: if you can't find a panini that suits your taste, just order any topping that you want and they'll give it to you. I personally just customize everything.

Come for the experience if you want, and for an affordable lunch. Probably better option for meat eaters.

My friend had the toscana which she loved, I had one of the vegan options and it was very bland and dry. Needed some salt, or some spread to improve the eating experience.

Also, there wss a long wait for just 2 sandwiches and even though they're only 5euro, I think I could have gotten a better option else where.
Wow a very good kebab. Even at 10pm at night was very fresh, already thinking about the next one. Thanks.
Great food and great service. 👍 Best kebabs in Padova!
Very good kebab. Fresh ingredients and meat, and their sauce is really special.
I always come here for the calzone con carne di kevap, it’s soooo good
Food is great, especially meat which is fresh and made well. Restaurant is very clean.
Kind staff, good pizza. Great veneto dishes. Good cakes. Highly recommended.

We have accidentally discovered this lovely restaurant well out of town center.
I have never tasted softer gnocchi, which are undoubtedly home-made. Duck ragù and pizza (from what I have seen, pizza is  most popular choice from menu) was also very tasty.
Tiramisù was light as air and not too sweet.
Special praise to a young waiter, who is excellently well mannered and kind in his recomendations.

A casual pizzeria with very tasty pizzas, and not only. The wine is also good. They are generous with offerings. The sorbetto with lemon is very tasty. Their seven-herb liquor is also good. The prices are reasonable.

Really good pizza, we booked as it's always full. The waiters were kind and professional and we didn't wait a lot to have our fragrant and delicious pizza and we didn't pay much at all! It's worth going back!
Good pizza, pleasant staff
Small but very welcoming place, excellent fish snacks to enjoy standing up with a glass of wine. Padovanity!

This place is the best! :) The wine and seafood are so delicious! I had 4 kinds of stuffed fish, shrimp, small squid, mussels, and wine, and it came to 13 euros. I want to go there every day! Italians are so friendly!

Fresh fish "spunciotti." A historic spot in Padua for street food. You won't find the classic sea bass, but more unusual seafood options like mussels, octopus, fish ragù, shrimp, fried fish (which is delicious), sardines, cod (also delicious), and much more. Anyone who says they didn't like it should go to a seafood restaurant; street food is something else entirely.
Suitable for adults given the range of tastes, except for children and young people, who enjoy, for example, the dishes listed above.

Folpi, like it used to be, is a favorite with Paduans.
This kiosk opens its doors in the evening and is a popular destination for locals.
This remote but popular seafood spot offers the classic boiled Folpetti, along with some absolutely delicious spunciotti (shrimp, cuttlefish roe, mussels...).
The owner is friendly, and the prices are reasonable for the dishes, which must necessarily be accompanied by a good glass of white wine.
It's not a gourmet dinner, but a pleasant and tasty aperitif that can be enjoyed standing up, along with a relaxing chat for a half hour.

If you want a quality product, this is the right place. It's a place to get fish to take away... the best creamed cod I've ever tasted, you can also find Vicenza-style cod, boiled fish, and fried fish... I highly recommend it. Prices in line with the product.

Nice place, well kept, great and courteous staff. The food however, was beyond expectations for a burger joint. Everyone loved their food and my daughter got a hotdog after devouring a hamburger, 2x what she would usually eat! It was a few minutes walk from the train station, very easy to get to. Stop in for some great grub, you wont be sorry, and our first visit will NOT be our last.
Ordered my burger and was waiting for 20 minutes for it (I was the only one client in the restaurant). And I ordered a burger for 10.5 euros expecting it would be big and juicy, but it wasn’t.

Il proprietario è adatto a studiare linguistica😂😂😂
r u serious?????? Look at the full pic. it is 16.5 EURO and i wonder who would spend 16.5 EURO to get this pooooor burger. if only the proprietario would spend 16.5 EURO for a pooor menu, give it to me for free.
tbh, it should be -5 star🥹🥹
Their bun and sauce is really good but if youre selling a expensive hamburger you cannot serve this meat. Zero taste, seems like boiled instead of grilled.
Nice smash burger place in the middle of Padova, good selection and food, can recommend.

It was a lovely lunch spot however the taste of the food was lacking. Many of the dishes were much too salty, and I know salt is a personal preference, however when there is so much salt that it burns the palate, this detracts from the food. For the price, the food was not what it should have been, perhaps it was a bit old or starting to go. The staff were fine, except they kept trying to clear our plates before we were done eating, making us feel unwelcome or rushed. We went near the beginning of lunch service and our full meal (3 courses) was done in less than an hour, so there was no need to hurry.

I passed for luky closer this nice restaurant, waching the -new gestion- table I convinced my self to have a little wine whit sone baccalà crostino, simple, as Padua old stile, but durin my fast breakfast I had start to desire to have an important experience here, soon I hope. I sugget you to try, only for the gently of owners and right feeling inside here. Thans San Michele guy to try to give again the stile that Padua are risking to loose.

A very nice discovery and surprise.
The food was delicious and the service was very curated and kind.

We chose this place as a Venetian place to show for my family. The service and food was very good! We came for dinner on Sunday and everything was delicious and fast! We tried pasta, polenta with baccala and other dishes! House wine and tiramisu – 100/10! Thank you :)

Lovely hidden and non famous place in Padova!

A friendly and quick service. The food was original with authentic and tasty plate.

I highly recommend!

Napoli Centrale in Padova is a vibrant spot where you can dive into authentic Neapolitan cuisine. The atmosphere is lively, making it an engaging place to enjoy your meal. The star of the show is their special Napoli pizza, featuring a traditional, slightly charred crust with fresh toppings. But the menu doesn't stop at pizza; there's a variety of pastas, succulent steaks, and fish dishes to choose from.

The wine selection is impressive, with dozens of local red, white, and sparkling varieties, enhancing your dining experience without breaking the bank. The food here is authentic, the flavors rich, and the prices reasonable, making Napoli Centrale a hidden gem in Padova. It's a must-visit for anyone seeking a true taste of Naples in this northern Italian city.

We arrived just before closing time, but the staff was kind enough to welcome us and still serve food, which we really appreciated. We ordered the pasta with beef, and it was surprisingly delicious with a generous portion and a rich, flavorful sauce. The Milanese cutlet was another highlight—juicy, perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and with a great crunch. Even the bread was outstanding and very tasty. Overall, a wonderful experience with excellent food and kind service.

Magnificent pizza! We had lunch here with a family - four different dishes - dear lord, that’s so tasty! The service is great! There is no cocktail menu, but if you take an aperol or campari spritz, you will get incredible pleasure!

We also got a dessert 🌚 omg, so good!

Delicious! We had grilled branzino fish, seafood pasta, dessert, and Aperol Spritz cocktails. It was very tasty!
The service was excellent, attentive but unobtrusive.
We hope to go back soon.
We were a group of 20 and were seated in 5-10 minutes. Great food with gluten free options. Special honors go to the waiters and staff which were very kind, helpful and fast.
Very good coffee ☕️ and croissant 🥐:)

Dirty glasses (we had to ask for a change twice, once for lipstick stains and once for the person with me).
Poor food and poorly presented. The carbonara was brought to us without pecorino cheese when there were no guests yet, and then brought to the next table with pecorino cheese. Furthermore, it was bland, as were the crepes. The staff wasn't entirely attentive to service. It's a shame because a good job has been done with the restaurant's renovation.

In Padua for the day, we chose this place for lunch. Booked through The Fork.
Pleasant interior decor, somewhere between modern and vintage, with outdoor seating.
The wait was a bit long, with lots of people eating. Service was slow but courteous and friendly...
Very good food, especially the spaghetti with red pesto and stracciatella and the beef carpaccio with buffalo mozzarella (it's a shame the eggplant was sold out...).
Affordable prices, and fortunately the outside was breezy and not in the sun.
Perhaps a few more staff would be helpful to speed things up.
To be considered...

Delicious food at a great price. The toasts in the photo are priced at 5 and 7 euros, and the portions are perfect for a full meal. The place is very nice. Just be careful with the bathroom, as it's not a standard toilet but a squat toilet – just a warning :)
Christmas 2023 and Christmas 2024 Update. We've been buying artisanal panettone for two years. Beautiful and delicious. Made and packaged by Matteo and Marco!
Kind staff, fast service, good food. Highly recommended.
Food are delicious & good price!
A tiny eating whole with very good sushi and Chinese dishes. Excellent take out and home delivery service
Delicious sushi, really nice service, good price :)
Small place, friendly staff, always good food.

Excellent!!! I can’t say enough about this place. We were looking for a locale to eat fish at for our last evening in Italy and the receptionist at our hotel highly recommended this locale. It was absolutely fantastic and the service was A1! I was taken aback how the prices were so affordable for not only a good amount of food, but a fantastic presentation. We will be back and I can’t wait!!! Wether you are looking for a nice date night or an inexpensive delicious meal, you can’t go wrong going here. It’s fantastic. Also the owner took time to speak to my daughter about Italy and her pipe dream of returning one day. She was very moved by his wisdom and often recalls that talk to others when asked about her vacation in Italy. ❤️

The best restaurant in Abano.
Everything ist fantastic!!!!!!!
Grazie 🤗
Food is nice but service is very slow
top top top top top great selection and affordable as well. highly recommendable
Amazing seafood
Cute takeaway sushi. Good sushi. 🍱
Ok
great to go sushi and nice staff. i asked without nuts and sesamo and they did it 👏👏 thank you
Hard rice, poor quality sushi.

It's a vibe. The food is outstanding. Do not expect to be in and out on a week day. It's run by two guys. The we showed up no reservations, don't recommend it. Man behind the bar took pitty on us, a two top. I speak no Italian. But we muddled through in broken English and Spanish. The food was outstanding, the vibe was just right for me. Laid back, listening to eighties rock hits. We started chatting more and more. Don't be surprised if you end up doing shots of grappa at the end of the meal. It's not for everyone. App split, entrees, wine, water ordered at the beginning was mid entrée after I made choking noises at the one service member. We laughed he laughed. 100% go back next time I'm in town!

Such a beautiful place and really delicious food! The waitress was so friendly and attentive and food and drinks high quality. I would like to add very honest too! We accidentally left important documents on our table and did not realise until 2 days later they were missing!  The lovely waitress had kindly put them in safe place and even contacted the number on documents to say they had them. Can’t thank them enough!! We look forward to returning to your beautiful restaurant and to see you all again! Thank you so much.

Authentic Italian restaurant. Pasta’s were both delicious. Prosecco prices very nice. We also tried the golden medal tiramisu; it was very good, but there seemed to be no amaretto nor coffee inside. Overall, really nice!

Horrible, just a horrible experience. I lived in Padova for a year and have travelled extensively in Italy multiple times and I have never eaten as badly as here. Stumbled in here after trying to get a table in several reputable establishment just before, and I wished I had gotten a simple panzerotto instead. 1) The ragu bianco al cortile resembled and smelled like cheap dog food spread on pasta. 2) the pasta with seasonal mushrooms included spongy mushrooms covered in a bog of earthy liquid. 3) when getting to the secondi I thought they were joking when receiving a bland pile of *quality* meat, so finely mashed it looked and tasted like puree. No seasoning and accompanied by dry salad leaves. 4) The only acceptable thing was the tagliata angus that was served overly salted and with the same collection of dry salad leaves. Leaving 0 stars for the food was not possible so Im contenting myself by leaving you all a detailed description of what we got on our plates. Do yourself a favour and walk right past this place.

Great and authentic service. As a tourist coming to Padova for the first time, this place is was recommended by close friends that live in the city. We met with the owner of the restaurant at the door and he explained how their food was prepared and had a pleasant talk with our group. About the history of the restaurant and the city. We left the restaurant as friends with the owner and with an experience to remember.
Fantastic food, amazing service. We loved it, the place was a vibe!!! We were offered delicacies from Sardinia and the smoothest wine ever with chilled out tunes

The worst carbonara I've ever eaten!! Rubbery pasta, no sauce, bits of fat and cold. I sent it back and the cook brought the plate back and got up close to my face in an aggressive way to ask in very bad English what the problem was, he was not Italian and didn't understand English very well making me repeat myself over and over and in the end he just walked off. After spending such a lovely day in Padova it was the last thing I expected to happen.

Very good humburger we arrive late from venezia aitport and we come to the restaurant it was 22:30 about and the Italian man from Sardenia suggested for us a 2 hamburgers it was so gentle from his side with the young lady from Marrocco she speak good Italian and English greetings from Finland & Saudi Arabia & Tunisia

An interesting themed restaurant in Padova PD, Italy. We went here for dinner and were quickly seated. The place wasn’t too packed and serves a wide variety of local dishes and burgers.
Service could’ve been better and faster. I ordered the angus, but never received it. So they gave me the ribeye which wasn’t very good, very chewy and lots of fat.
The spaghetti alla carbonara was a bit better, but on the salty side.
I loved the ambience of this place. Had late lunch here and enjoyed some wine and pasta. It was excellent. Service was quick and good.

Kind staff, good sushi and sashimi.
Only the noodle presentation was horrible. And on a normal day they made us pay as festivity.
Overall recommended for quality.

Fabulous restaurant, booking recommend even during the week as it is always busy. I have eaten here several times with my family, I do not eat sushi but they have selection of Chinese dishes too.
Stylish venue and well presented tasty food.
Excelent food and service.. nice and warm Place...
perfect
Not bad, but it can be better.

My first try of AYCE sushi in Padova and I’d say I like it! It won’t be like the €€€ sushi because they are all you can eat with a super fair price (but the salmon sashimi was very tasty like a premium one!) it’s really worth your money, the staffs are super nice and friendly despite they have many customers to serve. Not a long wait for the food, highly recommended to spend your sushidate here!

I tried others japanese all you can eat in Padova, Attimi still the best in my opinion. The way to order what you want just makes things a lot easier (you just write what you want on a paper). The food is amazing. Worth the price, a lot.

Wow, we went to this restaurant by chance while walking by. We were impressed by the menu, dish plating and speed of service. Everything was great, the waiters were excellent and the food delicious. We will definitely come here again for all you can eat days.
It was really easy to order via QR code, they helped us move to a more convenient place, and overall the staff was really helpful and kind.

We had a wonderful experience at Attimi! The food quality is outstanding – fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service was excellent: very attentive and super friendly. Even without a reservation, we were warmly welcomed and felt comfortable right away. A truly memorable evening – highly recommended! We will definitely be back.

The pasta was cooked properly and was tasty. The dessert was good, but not extraordinary, slightly too sweet. The service was very fast, but the tables were a bit too close to each other. The cacio e pepe pasta was very well cooked and not too spicy. The amatriciana pasta was very good too.

For me perfect place 3 amazing dishes for really good price i had a good time the burger putannescca was amazing ! Served with such a nice potatoes ! 😍 i arrived with the bike and found directly the best restaurant in Padova 🙏

Nice place, great choice of tasty Italian food.
Quiet street, nice experience outside.
Reasonable prices.
Fabulous. Truly enjoyed our roma pasta meal and staff took great care of our son. Would happily return. Thank you.
Delicious and  special burgers. We didn’t have a place inside but there was no problem sitting outside. Recommend!
Fixed-price lunch. Excellent chef. Place to meet the locals. Friendly staff. Tip: add one of the chef's desserts.
Passed by there once, saw lots of people eating so theoretically speaking their food is nice
Traditional place with good traditional food and decent prices. Recommended.
Small, but friendly and clean. Very reasonable.
Decent. Forget the rest.
One of the best sushi I ever had, highly recommended for sushi lovers!!!

Motoi Sushi offers a pleasant dine-in experience with quality sushi and asian food, and their all-you-can-eat menu provides a good variety of dishes. The setting is comfortable, and getting served is generally Smooth.

Very limited selection of plates, with very little variety in fish (mainly just salmon); at least on their lunch menu.
The plates on their own were good and for that I can't go lower than 2 stars, however the rude staff who would stare at me and then turn away while I would raise my hand to call them sort of ticked me off.
We waited for a very long time for our last two plates, which wouldn't have been the end of the world if it wasn't for the fact that many other tables were served the same dishes before us, even if they arrived later. The table behind us even left after complaining about missing dishes.
The robot is a cool touch, might want to invest in more robotic staff.
I used to enjoy going here quite a bit, not sure what has changed.

If you got any intolerance or allergies don't  eat at Motoi Sushi, you gonna be sick.
The food is good but you can't expect to be safe. They aren't trained for this. For my own stupidity for trusting them I got a day in hell full of pain.
This review is for warning others so they don't get sick.
Slightly expensive but great selection for all you can eat and at the higher end for quality
There were 25 of us. We were all completely satisfied. The food was excellent and plentiful. The service was quick and courteous. The owners provided excellent value for money.

We didn't have a good experience in this restaurant. First of all, they took a long time to serve us (around one hour). Then they brought us entries without us asking for it. It was just bread for which we paid €12, but they didn't inform that we would have to pay for this in the end. The plates were served with a small quantity of food. And, in the end, we paid an absurd quantity of money! The food was not bad, but waiting one hour for such little and expensive food I truly do not recommend this place to eat.
In addition, for vegetarians this is definitely not a good place to sit, as they only have one option and it's very expensive.

The service wasn’t good as they wouldn’t let us sit in one of the tables of the place because we “just” ordered 3 ice creams on cone. It seemed like it wasn’t enough even if the place had almost all the tables empty. Also, the other places have the ice cream cheaper and in a bigger quantity
Locely setting to have breakfast in the morning sun with a nice view!

The best: aperitivo with the view of the Basilica. Even though it is quite expensive (spritz 5€) if you are the type of person who loves views, it might worth it. They didn't give me patatine for free with the aperitivo. The gelato I tried was not good, not bad. They have tables inside and outside but definitely choose outside. Everything clean and nice little pastries from where to choose. They also have menu of the day.
Antonio was fantastic! Food extraordinary! Cannot say enough good things about this place.
Nice place to hangout with friends. But a little bit crowded and clumpsy.

Fantastic place, I have been attending it for years and I have always had a great time, fantastic food both for dinner and after dinner, they have a variety of delicious beers, super friendly staff, average prices and orders arrive at the table.
This is a great spot if you're looking for an authentic Irish pub experience 😉

Best Guinness & Clubsandwiches in Town.
A rich Rhum and Whiskies collection.
A really friendly service.
Expensive
A cozy little restaurant serving homemade regional specialties at reasonable prices. The atmosphere is simple and charming, and the service is friendly.

Crossing Da Pippo's door is a bit like entering a time warp. I was welcomed by the typical decor I was used to when going to local restaurants with my parents as a child. Everything seems to be straight out of a flashback.
Including the menu, in a very positive way. You find dishes that have been in the traditional Paduan cuisine for decades. Everything prepared with care, resulting in excellent quality. And all that at more than decent prices, which is an added bonus not found in other restaurants.

We went to Da Pippo twice during our trip, for lunch and for dinner. We had 8 different dishes and they were all very tasty! The desserts are also very good! Great food and great value.
This will definitely be my go-to place if I get to visit Padua again.
I love finding these hole in the wall places, and this restaurant was excellent! Unpretentious, delicious food with generous wine pours served with a smile.

Cooking recipes (for strong bellies) should be revisited. The awful draft wine can be improved.. Euganean hills can offer better quality of wine today even much better on bottle.
I appreciated the woman kindness who welcomed and served us.
I won't do the same mistake twice...
Delicious burger delicious fries. Service is great the person speaks english, very kind environment. You can have desserts as well

food is good and cheap， service is good.But remember not not not not order the Napoli pizza here. It is with
olive and alici, but too too too too salty😱
Pizzas are so delicious and the service is perfect, they are so nice and also helpful.
Professional staff and delicious food! Prosciutto con fungi is my favorite!
Boon

ADRIATICA pescheria con cucina offers many culinary options based on the reviews, but offers very poor quality of customer service based on our experience in Padova at Palazzo Della Regione. We had lunch here recently and waited for about 90 minutes to get the main dish. Arrived at 12:56pm on Tuesday March 31, 2026 get seated upstairs where is table service vs. downstairs self serve, order drinks and appetizer “Gratineted scallops & shrimps €23 plus main dishes for two people; “Calamarata with Sicily tuna ragout” €18 and “Gragnano Spaghettoni with seafood” €23. Appetizer arrived in about 20-25 minutes from initial order and main course after 70 minutes or around 14:24pm. In the meantime 3 other tables of local Italian customers arrived after us and finished their meals before us (total discrimination for tourist). Asked the waiter for our bill around 14:00pm (we couldn’t wait anymore, hungry and frustrated) and he ignored us by saying in 2 minutes your food will arrive, that turned into another 20 minutes. When food arrived pasta was half cooked and you can tell everything was rushed, either forgotten order or didn’t care for properly prepared food for the guests. However, 15-20 minutes before 15:00pm the same waiter came to pick up the plates rushing us “GUSS WHY?” because they are closing at 15:00pm. On the way out  as we were paying the bill downstairs we saw the cook from Nepal that prepared our half cooked pastas. Very poor & unpleasant experience at this pescheria …. Bella Italia, che fine hai fatto??? Un tempo avevi standard tradizionali e dignità nel servizio, soprattutto per quanto riguarda il cibo e l'ospitalità!!! È triste 😔 dover dire e condividere questa bruttissima esperienza….

Really nice spot in the heart of Padova. We stopped for an aperitivo and a quick bite. The place itself is very charming, and the selection of cicchetti is wide. Quality-wise, they’re very good: flavorful, well balanced, and in the right portions. The spritz, though, felt a bit watered down, which was a shame. Staff was overall friendly and the service was fine. Prices are a little on the high side for cicchetti. Honestly, even in Venice (slightly more expensive 😉) you can often find similar ones for less. Still, worth a stop if you want good cicchetti in a great setting.
Best paella full of seafood and most tasty for lunch. Returned for supper and enjoyed the sea bream. Highly recommend.

There are so many culinary options at Palazzo Della Regione. Adriatica has everything for your seafood lunch or dinner if you want to eat-in or take-out home. Enjoy a crisp white Lugana glass of wine while you have warm Paella or better yet an insalata di mare. They have room upstairs and downstairs for table settings to relax and visit with family or friends. The staff are welcoming, friendly, and will help you choose from their favorite dishes. The seafood is very fresh and the quality is apparent. Pricing is low and for a couple the bill was 56 euro, we were too full to finish our plates, and the bill includes 4 glasses of wine. That is a reasonably priced dinner.

Today we ate lunch at the Adriatica Pescheria.  It was wonderful.  The service was perfect.  I ordered pasta with mussels in a spicy sauce off menu.  It was the best I have ever eaten.  The prices were reasonable for such fresh seafood. We are going back next Thursday.

Beautiful chic restaurant on the outskirts of Padua. We loved the vibe and music. Service by the dining staff was also very friendly.

The beef carpaccio was quite good. One of the pastas were good with seafood, but the other one was overly salty. What we were most impressed by was the homemade bread.
The best restaurant in town! Everyone should visit it at least once if they are in the area. The food is great and the owner is very welcoming

This restaurant was a wonderful discovery! It was a magical experience, both in terms of the food, the atmosphere, and the hospitality provided by the staff. We opted for the "contaminations" seafood tasting menu. Each dish was presented and explained to us, and each course left us with the feeling of having discovered a new way to eat a particular fish we'd never even considered.
The evening was accompanied by a duo of singers who further enlivened the atmosphere. Truly a repeat, we felt pampered and left satisfied in every way.
Honorable mentions go to the eggplant tortelli with swordfish, plums, and smoke (an explosion of flavors, truly incredible) and the white chocolate, green tea, and Moroccan lemon dessert (truly the icing on the cake, perfect in both textures and flavor combinations).
A side note: I don't know if it's intentional in the spirit of customer service, but even the water temperature in the bathroom was perfect: just the right amount of lukewarm water, not too hot or too cold!
We'll definitely be back to try the other menus.

A truly excellent experience, with top-quality ingredients, excellent service, and a chef worthy of the name.
Extreme care was taken both in the combination and balance of flavors and in the presentation. The ladies in the dining room are very kind and knowledgeable, and the wine selection is extensive and suitable for all budgets. We chose the tasting menu and it was a delightful discovery. We will definitely be back.

Excellent experience. Ample free parking, a very elegant location dominated by black and marble. Excellent food, a spectacular wine cellar, and Chef Marco was very accommodating because I asked for variations on all the dishes, and he accommodated me. Thank you so much.

The staff were kind, helpful, and friendly.

Prices in line with the quality...
In my opinion, it's worth it!

This may be the best pizza outside of Napoli. Incredibly fresh ingredients and perfect crust on our Marguerita and Diavola pizzas. The house Valpolicella was also fantastic. You have a lovely view of the main piazza, with all its gorgeous statues.  A great deal overall compared to larger cities.
Truly amazing experience. One of our favorite restaurant in a the region. Friendly and fast service. Exceptional food, and a very warm and friendly vibe and tremendous value. Throughly recommend.
Great place for lunch. Fresh food, plenty of variety for both traditional folks and hipster food lovers. The staff are super friendly and laid‑back.

Amazing food!! Octopus was so flavourful and cooked to perfection - crispy on the outside, soft on the inside. Flavours were amazing. I tried my friend’s ravioli and it was the best ravioli I’ve ever tasted.

The staff were exceedingly kind and helpful - helping us get directions to our next place, charging my friend’s phone, being super attentive and welcoming.

Terrific food, cool vibes and wonderful staff - we will visit again!  And we did!  The risotto special (scampi with white asparagus) was so delicious and the sparkling rosé that the waiter suggested matched perfectly.  Since it’s asparagus season, I also tried the asparagus and brie soup which came with a gorgeous puff pastry crust!  Magnificent!

Casual neighborhood pizzeria with friendly service. The prices are reasonable, making it a great spot for an easy meal. The pizza was tasty, with fresh ingredients and good quality overall. A perfect place for a relaxed dinner if you’re looking for a solid local option.

Best Pizza in Padua: light, with quality ingredients. There is both the option to get it delivered in te area or eat in place. I love the quiet area, and the hot pizza directly from the oven, so I eat there ;)
very very good pizza and you can make it exactly how you like it even the prices are very good I highly recommend it

I ordered a takeaway pizza here. When the waiter handed me the box I asked her to cut the pizza for me which she did hesitantly( I understood why when I got home).

It is genuinely inexplicable to us how this restaurant holds 2 Michelin stars.

The space itself is modern and well designed, clearly popular with locals, and surrounded by expensive cars—expectations were high. Unfortunately, the food did not come close to meeting them.

The service felt rushed from start to finish. The entire meal lasted about 2.5 hours, when a 2-star tasting menu should unfold over at least 3 hours. Several dishes suffered from basic execution issues:
•	Three dishes were noticeably too salty
•	Multiple cold dishes were served on hot plates
•	Temperature control throughout was inconsistent

Most importantly, not a single dish was remarkable. None. That is unheard of at this level.

To put this in context:
•	A 2-star restaurant like La Peca delivered six memorable dishes.
•	Venissa (1 star) delivered four.
•	Seafood restaurants we deeply admire—Pepe Vieira, Gueyu Mar, Elkano, Campero—some without stars, deliver far superior flavor and product.
•	Other 2-star references such as The Smoked Room (Madrid), Coquillage, Anne de Bretagne, and Christophe Hay are consistently excellent.

Here, you see good ingredients, attractive sauces, and beautiful presentation—but the taste simply does not match the visuals or the reputation. Expectations shaped by extensive dining across Europe and Asia were repeatedly unmet.

Core issues:
•	Temperature control
•	Salt imbalance (too much or too little)
•	Lack of depth, umami, and creativity
•	Rushed pacing

The wine selection was good, though not a precise pairing—still, it was one of the better aspects of the experience.

Overall, this was a deeply disappointing meal and entirely inconsistent with what one expects from a restaurant holding two Michelin stars.

It would have been a satisfying over all experience if it weren’t for the long waiting time in between every dish.It took us almost 5.5 hours to eat.We felt bad for our driver waiting outside so we decided to skip the dessert(and i have a sweet tooth so imagine my heart ache when we had to make this decision).Food is undeniably good.

Did 1 star last week and here we were trying a 2 star restaurant, and the experience was fantastic.  Definitely there were subtle differences between the two restaurants.

FOOD: We're ordered the lunch special (3 dishes) and two dishes from the ala carte menu. Of course, before the meal, they prepared welcome dishes to jump start our taste buds. Every bite sized snacks were fantastic and then the warm homemade bread showed up. It was fun sampling these dishes. The main course was fantastic. Lunch menu had an appetizer (seafood sampler), pasta, and the main (grilled sea bass). Tasted great and pleasantly presented. We also ordered seafood pasta and raw fish stew from the menu. I was wondering how you could have raw stew, but they pour the stew/sauce over the fish. Great idea and tasted great. We liked the sauce so much that we scrapped the bowl with the bread. And then the meal ended with their desert samples. Not too sweet and a perfect way to finish the meal.
SERVICE: Fantastic. They were quick with the meal and explained each dish. very friendly and definitely two star worthy. Little over two hours and never felt slow or rushed.
LOCATION: Easy to find. On the main street and plenty of parking.  Also,  inside is big and tables are well spaced out.
PRICE: It's two star. So, not cheap but it's for the meal and the experience. I thought it was worth the price. Meal and drinks (one glass of wine and coffee) were about €170.
MISC: not an expert but I noticed that the service and the presentation were slightly more noticeable (to me) than a one star restaurant. I definitely recommend this two star restaurant and you are looking for a two star restaurant in Veneto

The service is also always friendly, professional, and attentive. It's one of those restaurants where you go knowing you'll eat well.

What a wonderful evening! My husband and I decided to try the Medusa restaurant for our 26th wedding anniversary. What a better choice! A very elegant atmosphere, extremely kind and attentive staff, and excellent food, all with attention to detail. The lobster carpaccio was sublime, to say the least! I then asked if they wrote 26 on the dessert, and it was beautiful. Thank you, congratulations, you're the best. We'll definitely be back.

The #MEDUSA restaurant is located on a side street off the SS 16 Adriatica, easily accessible from the ring road that connects to the highways. Parking is easy to find both on the street and within walking distance. The recently renovated space is meticulously maintained and elegant; the walls and ceilings are tastefully decorated, and above all, there's an excellent sound-absorbing false ceiling that allows even a full restaurant to talk peacefully without annoying reverberation and echoes, thereby attenuating all sounds.
The staff, like the Chef-in-Chief, is young and extremely kind. The dishes are presented and served with extreme care, including fantastic appetizers (try the cod and scallops!!). The three types of warm, freshly baked bread are delicious; the risotto is perfectly cooked, the Catalana is exemplary with amazing vegetables; and finally, the desserts, which almost seemed like wedding favors, are beautiful to look at and delicious to taste! A perfect experience, delicious food in a truly cozy and fresh environment. The price is reasonable for the quality of the ingredients and the excellent cuisine: top marks, a highly recommended place for seafood lovers! Remember to book well in advance, especially on weekends.

This beautiful family restaurant exceeded my expectations with its amazing Italian food, welcoming atmosphere, and exceptional service. It is a place where you can relax and enjoy a meal with loved ones, and I am already looking forward to my next visit.

Walked in impromptu as a group of six to what I consider one of the greatest meals of my life. In addition to the frankly astonishingly lovely antipasti, the lamb with mustard and hazelnut is a must-try. However after some Google maps research we gave it a go on our last night in Padua as it was a short walk from the apartment.  What a find. Fortunately, we almost never had to wait and always found a table (though during the lunch rush, it gets chaotic, both in terms of the noise level of people shouting and the waitresses going crazy due to the rush and chaos all in a short space of time).
There's always a daily menu; some dishes are almost fixed, but there's almost always something new and options for everyone: first courses, second courses, salads, toasted sandwiches, piadinas, sandwiches, etc.
The sandwiches, in my opinion, are very good; the dishes weren't always special; they were edible, but not enough to ask for seconds.
I think the dishes are pre-prepared, and when you order them, they microwave them until they reach a burning temperature, which, however, quickly dissipates, and the dish becomes lukewarm/cold (the effect you get when reheating in the microwave: from hot to cold in a flash).
