They are reliable, professional, clean, tidy, with a wide selection, and show the utmost helpfulness, empathy, and courtesy towards their customers. Since the place is in a business center, I find the prices more than fair, and in line with the quality of the ingredients, the quantity, and also the competition in the area.
The entire staff is extremely empathetic, polite, and pleasant. They offer both cold dishes (sandwiches, tramezzini, salads, etc.) and a varied menu for a delicious lunch break; (You can find the daily menu on the blackboard inside the place, as well as on their Instagram stories).
You can also order and reserve by phone, dine in (tables inside and outside), or take out. Payment is also available by card and ticket.
The clientele is predominantly made up of office workers and employees of the many excellent companies and businesses present in this office building; and international visitors (the local police station, which issues passports and residence permits, is located in the square 🤷‍♂️🙈), so it's a diverse "human" crowd.
In conclusion, I can only recommend it, and I'm sure you'll be satisfied and will return when in the area.

Kitchen/bar (craft beer not coffee). Feels like it landed in Padova from Brooklyn (not a bad thing considering you might look for something different once in a while) Industrial rustic, design, Pool table, craft beer...very hipster I suppose. Large outside space and a small rooftop, so this place probably goes off in the summer months. I read someone commenting about the noise; we went in a  February afternoon and it was calm and quiet. Would return

Beer heaven with styles, tastes, and discoveries in all imaginations.
Always a different, excellent selection!

Wonderful service and extremely nice and knowledgeable people - esp. if you find Marco :)

Do yourself a favour and visit when nearby!!
Great craft brewery with top quality beers and food. Plenty of games to keep you occupied too. Fun atmosphere

You can't just get one beer here, they're too good! Real new england zinc Wes[ coast IPA.  Other styles are more light, good if you're getting& >no the real stuff. Pricey, because they have no competition...

Not a place to talk to your friends and family. The music is too loud, blasting out. The food is okay nothing special. Fried mozzarella tricks are tasteless but crunchy, however the burger is ‘okay.’ Honestly padova has better places to try. However, the staff is very kind and friendly. They are a huge positive for the establishment. Une place pour la petite bobo.

We had a wonderful dinner here and thoroughly enjoyed our experience. The seafood was incredibly fresh and delicious, and every dish was prepared perfectly. The service was excellent—friendly, attentive, and very efficient. Everything arrived quickly, and the staff made us feel welcome from the moment we walked in. We will definitely be back and highly recommend this restaurant.

One of the most elegant dining experiences I’ve had in Italy.
Poesia — you surprised me 🤍
I almost didn’t want to share this place…
but this Michelin-level restaurant in Abano Terme truly deserves it .

I absolutely loved the food here. Everything is exceptionally delicious and prepared with great refinement. The ingredients are incredibly fresh, and the dishes are beautifully presented. The interior is stylish and elegant, creating a wonderful atmosphere. It truly has a Michelin-quality feel. I enjoyed every single dish and will definitely be coming back. As of today, this is the best place in town.

A Hidden Gem in Abano Terme: Ristorante Poesia

During a recent spa getaway to Abano Terme, a happy twist of fate led me to one of the culinary highlights of my trip. After arriving too late for my hotel’s dinner service, the staff kindly recommended Ristorante Poesia — and I’m so glad they did.
From the moment I walked in, it was clear this wasn’t just a meal, but an experience. The atmosphere strikes the perfect balance between elegance and warmth, with thoughtful interior design that complements the refined yet welcoming vibe. The menu is thoughtfully curated, with standout seafood and pasta dishes made from super fresh ingredients. You can really taste the care that goes into everything they serve. A special mention must go to Dimitry, the owner, whose hospitality added a personal touch that elevated the evening even further. His passion for making every guest feel valued truly set the tone for the entire restaurant. I loved it so much that I made a point of returning for my final dinner before leaving Abano Terme. Dining at Ristorante Poesia was not only a memorable culinary experience — it became one of the defining highlights of my trip. If you find yourself in Abano Terme, this is a dining experience not to be missed!

Had a fantastic experience at Ristorante Poesia – Racconti di mare.
The atmosphere is elegant and calm, perfect for a relaxed lunch or dinner. Service was outstanding — attentive, professional, and genuinely welcoming without being overbearing.
The food is where this place really shines. The seafood is incredibly fresh, beautifully presented, and cooked to perfection. You can tell there’s real attention to quality and detail in every dish.
Overall, a top-tier dining experience. If you’re in Abano Terme and enjoy great seafood, this place is absolutely worth a visit.
Will definitely be back.
These people are working in a very warm kitchen and are still so friendly!  Also the food was lovely, never had feta sauce in meat before, nice surprise!!
I love this place, by far the best greek place in town. I highly recommend it for the taste, cleanliness and friendly people serving the food

This is an original a Greek Souvlaki place! Owned and worked by Greek people only and you can tell the difference in the products! You can also find Greek beer and amazing desserts like “kataifi” and “ baklava” ! It’s seriously delicious and everyone there is very friendly! They even deliver!!!

We drove all the way from Venice to Padova for this place and it exceeded all our expectations. Delicious authentic greek suvlaki. We tried everything: chicken, pork, pancetta, gyros and all kinds of meat were super fresh and tasty. Super clean place with amazing people who prepare everything with care in very affordable prices for such high quality food. Try it today and thank me later :))

Our first experience with Greek food. Certainly was good. Small outlet but reposnsive and passionate people behind the counter. Wait times are long upto 40mins but that is also because they make everything fresh. They also have a delivery option but with the wait times it is a bit confusing when it would arrive. I chose to go and get food myself. We tried the chicken panini.

Best pizza ever! All the ingredients were fresh, and the dough was perfect. I loved how they combined everything, it was like a perfect melody in your mouth. We were so full, and I even got some to take home. Even though the pizza wasn’t hot and was leftovers when I ate it the next day, it still tasted amazing.

I'm glad our menu was in Italian. It's a local restaurant.
Good pizza. Thin pie (?), I don't like most crusts - this was good. Buffalo mozzarella 😄

Everything about this place is amazing, I had pizza and it was delicious, the waiters bring the food quickly and it's pretty cheap given that the restaurant is right near St. Giorgio's Church. I recommend eating here. Most, if not all tables have a "Reserved" sign on them, but they are not.  Jist wait for a waiter to notice you and they will seat you at a table.

The food was absolutely delicious!! The pizzas we had were incredibly good, especially after a long day of travelling around Padova. The desserts were just as good, definitely recommend the Torta della Nonna!!!

The atmosphere was also quite cosy and nice, and the service was very friendly and super approachable!! Highly, highly recommended

Nice pizzeria with great pizzas, very good tirami su, a good house wine, friendly service and very reasonable prices. We went as a family, and felt very welcomed. The ordering was fast, and the food was at the table in a couple of minutes. The pizzas were crispy and delicious. They have Italian beer - the IPA was very tasty. As a house wine they serve a regional Merlot di Veneto by the glass.  They also have tables outside by the road but with a view on the basilica St. Antonius. We can only recommend this place - best reserve a table ahead.

The best tartare I've ever had!!!

We had the Vecia Padova and went back for it the next day aswell. Such a good combination of flavors, it's a good idea to get the set with a drink and tartar. If you like tartare, than this place is definitely a must-visit!
Very friendly owner that introduced and helped us to choose the best tartare from his long menu! Only take out, no seat. Quite big portion, if you just want a snack, consider to buy the small one.
This is literally the best tartare you can ever try. I’d visit Padova just to eat here!
The food is crazy good, Davide is a gem and I totally recommend it
Absolutely the best beef tartare I’ve ever had.  Super fresh, perfectly seasoned, and served with real passion. A must-visit spot for food lovers.
Only 1 word. Perfect fish restaurant! Higly reccomended
Love it.  Totally amazing food, wine, and staff.
Lovely fish dishes and service.

I ate very well, featuring fresh, light fish. Excellent, discreet service and a welcoming atmosphere.
The fried food was fantastic.

I wouldn't recommend this restaurant.
I went with my boyfriend. The dining room smelled of fish. The kitchen door was probably open, and all the odors were coming out.
If I were to base my judgment on quantity and value, I'd give it one star. They probably weren't prepared for us. The menu doesn't include side dishes, so the only vegetables were a bagged salad with no dressing, accompanied by polenta made at the last minute, which was very runny and had an unpleasant flavor.
We ate bread and oil, which was certainly plentiful.

Best restaurant experience in padova. The owner was super welcoming and nice. I will definitely go there more often.

We got a mixed grilled and as an Iranian i can say that i could feel the premium quality of real kebab!

The design of the place also was telling us the story that owner wanted to tell us with such a good greek music and a welcoming cozy vibe.

All the best!

A real Greek taste in Padova and must try if you love Med and Aegean foods.
Big size portions with good prices
Cozy place.
Love it!

Amazing food, the portions were very good, especially the mixed grill for two (which was for 3 tbh). It has a nice atmosphere, very relaxed and the restaurant is inside a park. I was thoroughly satisfied.

Seated quickly without reservation. Staff were kind and realised we were too hot so closed the blinds and put the ac on. Starter came quickly - we shared halloumi - which was hot and tasty. We had the mixed plate for 2 which had a huge amount of meat - 2 chicken, 2 pork and 2 lamb skewers - all delish. Also 3 kofta - a little soft in texture for me. The beef skewer was tough and the minced skewer ok. There was also some nice roast veg, chips, olives and tzatziki. Overall excellent value. The wine (frizzante) was good and excellent value. Staff tried to engage throughout and were friendly. Toilets clean.

SUPER KIND STAFF, GOOD DISHES, NICE LOCATION, HIGH QUALITY INGREDIENTS. AMAZING PORK SOUVLAKIS, unfortunately GYROS ONLY CHICKEN, FAST SERVICE
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

The restaurant was amazing! Our group had people with gluten and lactose intolerance and the menu here had options for them too. I tried the Parmigiana pizza and it was delicious. Blooming flavours, lightness, and freshness!

I have tried many pizzerias in Italy and this is one of the best ones!

I cannot even begin to state how WONDERFUL our experience was at Pizzeria Al Carmine. Our kid had the first time eating his gluten free pizza in a restaurant here. The staff was so welcoming, the pizza was served so quickly and the taste was absolutely superb to both gluten free and normal pizzas . We will definitely recommend this restaurant to everyone.

Walked across Padua to find this restaurant based on the reviews and my daughter being Celiac. Can't begin to tell you how nice it was to see the extensive menu and happy customers filling each table. The food and service does not disappoint. Highly recommend the pasta with chicory and salsiccia.

This place is famous for the gluten-free pizzeria of Padova.
파도바에 왔다면 반드시 들러야 할 곳!
If you came to Padova, I think you must come here. (Once or more than once)
Because this is “the best pizza” in my life! 😘😋I really love the pizza of “Al Carmine”.

If you prefer a romantic atmosphere,
I recommend an outdoor table for you.
Of course, a cool indoor table is also good🥰

Thank you for the best pizza and nice service👍
I will definitely visit again. See you again🤗

(I visited again and I upload additional pictures😉😋 Grazie mille🥰)

Very buzzy restaurant with an extensive menu including a full page of vegan options  lots of vegetarian choices and all the pizzas available as gluten-free.

We had garganelli pasta with porcini and pumpkin, artichoke pizza and a side salad. Excellent prices. A really good lunch.
Great pizza. One of the top pizza places in Padova!
Amazing pizza 🍕

Great takeout pizzeria, they're punctual, and the pizzas arrive hot.

The problem is that my Margherita was very hard and a little burned.

Better with topped pizzas.
We ordered 7 pizzas, we arrived right on time but they gave them to us 15 minutes late, we got home and found the pizzas very bitter due to too much flour underneath

Very nice place, basic to stop for a meal but still very pleasant, fast and friendly service but above all quality, varied menu, from simple to sophisticated up to seasonal pizzas, really excellent, rather high price but reasonable, good if you want to treat someone from out of town to a good pizza.

A very nice restaurant that is a little more upscale and closer to fine dining in Padova.

The food here while smaller in portion was excellent. I recommend the spaghetti with urchin, it was absolutely delicious. The eggplant tart was also very well made and tasty.

The servers were very good and helpful. One even offered to keep my partners wine on ice and came by regularly to make sure his glass was kept full.

Service 10/10 the waiter name is Antoine. Great service and great manners.
Food 9/10 The beef tartare (battuta cruda di manzo) was fabulous. They helped to divide the portion for me and my husband. The spaghettoni with sea urchin were great too. The Tuna had a nice spice twist to it. The dessert( pazientina padovana) was very nice however, based on my personal opinion, a little too much alcohol for it. Please do note that I don't drink that much and zabaione cream need to have alcohol inside but, for my personal taste as a closings plate, there was a little too much of it. But I repeat, is just my opinion coming from an Asian prospective. My Italian husband loved it.
Atmosphere 10/10 Great music and the happy atmosphere between the service made it awesome!

Please please please if you have the opportunity do visit this restaurant(opened in 1934). It is really worth a visit ❤️😊.

Me and my husband have been here twice and both times the food and service were excellent. We had the bigoli, tris di mare and the risotto, and I highly recommend the risotto. The wine selection is good and the prices are reasonable too. Their pazientina is the best I have ever tried.

My dad and I tried a few dishes and everything was just delicious. I would definitely recommend to try the “frittura mista” - it’s amazing!! The atmosphere is also really lovely and the staff very kind and friendly.

Coperto 4 Euro very expensive.
Very small portions.  Small menu.
Expensive for what they offer.
Restaurant too small.

It´s ok for 1-2 Pers. Not for kids.
super 💜

The environment is great, the food is delicious, and the dishes are exquisite.

—The staff at the door were very welcoming, making the entrance a very pleasant experience.

Dining Environment: I was pleasantly surprised upon entering; it was very clean, and it felt impressive to have it with friends. They also recommended dishes during the ordering process, and the prices were truly reasonable.

Restaurant serving traditional Chinese cuisine and excellent value. The staff was friendly, even recommending dishes we weren't familiar with that might suit our tastes. The place is clean and has parking.

This is a restaurant without table service: they hand you a tray of food, and you carry it to your table yourself, setting it with glasses and silverware. The food is already prepared, displayed in the counter, ready to be reheated. You pay when you order, not at the end of the meal. The staff doesn't understand Italian, so you have to point to the food you choose in the display, without knowing what it is. Rice isn't on display. Confident I'd be understood, I ordered rice with shrimp, but they gave me Cantonese rice. I avoided telling them that wasn't what I'd asked for, because they wouldn't have understood anyway...
The prices are reasonable, and it's self-service. However, hygiene needs improvement. There was no cabbage in the boiled beef, but there were flies 🪰.

solid good Italian food! the fried calamari and seafood were particularly nice, they didn’t taste oily at all and were so light and crispy. very big portion too, 5 of us shared one plate. pizzas are nice with interesting toppings. the desserts are incredibly sweet which is something to watch out for. the tiramisu and the pastiera napoletana were too sweet for me, couldn’t finish the tiramisu even. the panna cotta was perfect though! restaurant is pretty and the staff are kind.

We absolutely loved our experience at Pago Pago Pizzeria con Ristorante. From the moment we arrived, the service was outstanding – attentive, kind, and genuinely welcoming. Everything we ordered was excellent, from the frittino misto napoletano to the focaccina fatta in casa.

However, what truly stole the show was the spaghettoni alla carbonara tartufata. Without a doubt, it was the best pasta we’ve ever had. As frequent travellers throughout Italy with a good knowledge of its cuisine, we can confidently say that this dish was simply exceptional. So good, in fact, that we returned just to enjoy it once more before leaving the city.

We can’t recommend this little gem in the heart of Padua highly enough. Whether you’re a visitor or a local, it’s absolutely worth a visit. A truly memorable lunch. Bravo!

Padova Padova, a beautiful city that is not as touristy as Venice or Florence is but oh mannnn what a pain it was to find a decent place to eat for dinner.

Pago Pago was one of the few places open late and had good food. Their pizzas were very good with a nice fluffy crust. The fried zucchini flowers were good but could have used a little more seasoning in the batter.

Service was quick and our food arrived fairly quickly.
Check it out if you're looking for a good place to eat.

This is a relaxed family-style neighborhood restaurant and is frequented by locals. They have both indoor (with air conditioning, I think? At least it felt cool enough) and outdoor tables. Nowadays they even have English menus and some of the waiters speak English.
The service is very fast and the portions are extremely generous. Pasta dishes are hearty and tasty. They have many classical pasta dishes. They specialize in pizzas and offer a very wide range of pizzas at very good prices.

Me and my friend went for a pizza and we found a secluded spot with very good pizza but mushrooms were a bit too squish for my liking but everything else was perfect, staff act like friends and when you need to charge your phone you can ask and they will allow it. Would come back if i visit Italy and Padova again. Ciao!

Definitely the best burger house in Padua
All freshly prepared with fresh, seasonal ingredients.
So many options to choose from.
Really very nice staff.
The schedule is to be closed at 10:30.We arrived at 10:02 but they said that they are already closed.Not able to order.But anyway we will come again soon.
Bonoooo

Gli hamburger migliori che abbia mai mangiato! Siamo amanti del genere e abbiamo girato tanti posti anche più costosi...ma qui andiamo sempre sul sicuro! Per i vegetariani è consigliatissimo il Biologia! Io non sono vegetariana eppure è uno dei miei preferiti...
Personale sempre gentile e paziente. Anche consegne a domicilio puntuali e precise! Il top!

It's a legend!!!!!!

Now instead of saying I want a burger, I say I want a Storia.

A wide selection of classic ingredients, but also alternative and sophisticated ones (like the BBQ sauce imported from the US or their own honey mustard).

Crispy bun, excellent quality meat, always very succulent. Crispy bacon and very tasty tomatoes.

Storia is incredible. A must-try. I also recommend the Archeologia, with the chicken cutlet. You can choose to have it with one or two cutlets. They make them thin so you can taste the other ingredients.

The selection of fried foods is also excellent; both the nuggets and the stick fries are delicious, extra crispy and just the right amount of salt.

Always very fast and helpful. You can pick them up on-site or have them delivered to your home.

The prices are also very good. If you want a sandwich without spending more than €10, you have a huge selection.

Recommended! Don't call the website number because they'll put you on hold; use Google's.

You can also eat in front of the shop at two high tables with stools.

The whole experience was amazing. Location right in front of the San Antonio church with seats outside, but also inside. Waiter was friendly and was totally fine with us changing seats (because of the cigarette smoke outside). And now to the best part: the pizzas. We ordered two different pizzas, both of them were absolutely delicious. Perfect crust and toppings. But the winner by FAR was the Pizza Mulignana with the eggplants and smoked Provola! Will recommend this pizza for anyone, not just vegetarians!

Worst experience... We order negroni, aperol sprits, coca cola, ravioli and pizza, waiting for someone to take order 20 minutes in empty restoran, then we get food without drink, beside waiter took order wit phone app.
Asked again for drink, and after additional 5 minutes we just wake up and left the place...

After finishing a 50 hour plus journey,  it was nice to be greeted by the manager with smile and friendly spirit. This is a casual place for people to come grab a bite or for people to relax enjoying the view of St Anthony Basilica.  Soft and yummy pizza , try their Spaghetti Alla Nerano and maybe Pizza, you will not regret it.

Terrible service, the worst ever seen in Italy, and that's a quite challenge. 10 minutes waiting to order, then 30 minutes waiting for 2 coffees and 2 croissants. All together after 40 minutes, got one croissant, the wrong one, tried to bill two. Waiters dazed and confused. Do everything to avoid!

Real Neapolitan pizza.  I'm often in Napoli and this pizza is identical.  The family atmosphere, the rest of the food is also excellent.  One small minus, the Neapolitan owner should have a picture of Diego Maradona in the restaurant. ☺️
The best pizza in the town. Don’t miss pizza kebab.
Really generous portions and prizes, amazing taste too.
Nice kebab, value for money
Very good falafel :)
Not bad

We had a wonderful dinner at this cozy Chinese restaurant. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, with tasteful decor and traditional touches like red lanterns hanging from the ceiling. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive throughout our meal.

The food was outstanding – fresh, flavorful, and beautifully served. From the shrimp stir-fry and tender chicken dishes to the fluffy scrambled eggs and stir-fried cabbage, everything was cooked to perfection. We especially appreciated the generous portions and variety of dishes.

Another big plus: the restaurant has a large parking area that's perfect for buses, making it ideal for groups or travelers on the road.

Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic Chinese cuisine in a relaxed, clean, and professional setting. Will definitely be coming back!

There was plenty of parking. Service was fast. The food, however, was quite normal, some dishes were tastless and came in small portion. It was quite hot as our table was facing the West in the late afternoon and the staff did nothing to help us.

I felt like I was in Asia. Food was great and portions were good. Vegetables were nice and crispy. Tofu was soft and delicious. Lots of parking outside also. Staff were speedy and polite. There is an English menu available.

The service was good, and the staff were friendly. However, the communication was not good. It was difficult to communicate with customers from different backgrounds, which led to misunderstandings.

We were also told that we could keep the chopsticks, but later they were taken away from us. This was confusing and felt unprofessional.

Overall, the experience was disappointing because of the poor communication, and I would not recommend this restaurant.

Absolutely amazing fine Chinese restaurant dining experience!!! Great menu selection with desserts and wide wine and beer list. The service is unmatched. The staff truly cares about your experience. The food is delicious and well presented. Absolutely the best Chinese cuisine we have ever had in  Padua!!!

Very nice restaurant with super friendly staff. The meat was sooo good. We unfortunately haven’t made pictures because it locked so good and we just eat it. We asked the waitress about the wine and we had a really good glass of withe wine. We enjoyed the evening and the waitress spoke good english.

This restaurant truly exceeded my expectations. The steak was perfectly cooked — tender, juicy, and full of flavor. The grilled vegetables were fresh and beautifully seasoned, complementing the dish wonderfully. The tomato bruschetta served as a refreshing and flavorful starter that set the tone for an excellent meal. Every detail, from the quality of the ingredients to the attentive service, reflected great care and professionalism. A delightful dining experience that I would highly recommend.
Great food, kind welcoming staff. Definitely will come back!

Stopped at the restaurant while looking for a place for lunch on our way from Bologna to Padua. What a nice surprise! Great food and wonderful service. Went back for a second time, this time for dinner before continuing our trip in Italy and the service, food and atmosphere was even better - a must in the area!
Good place where to go also on the road through .  Excellent meat also the other delicious dishes on the menu .

We visited this restaurant as part of a group tour, and it was easily the best authentic Indian meal we had during our entire trip across Europe. The vegetarian spread was excellent—we were served fresh roti, dal, corn Palak curry, curds, and a fresh salad of onions and cucumbers. The meal was rounded off perfectly with sweet vermicelli Payasam. The service was impressively quick and efficient, and the ambiance made for a very pleasant dining experience. Highly recommended!

Rangoli Indian Restaurant is situated on the main road near the bus stop in Padova. It offers ample indoor seating space. During our visit, we tried their Indian vegetarian dishes, which were flavorful and neither too spicy nor bland. We ordered Dal, rice, corn spinach veggie, roti, potato beans, and salad.

We particularly enjoyed the Dal and Corn spinach veggie. The service was prompt, and the staff was polite. I appreciated their hospitality and the quality of the food.

The ambience could be improved, but they did have clean restrooms. It's a good place to visit with family or a group to enjoy Indian cuisine.

Went here with extended family for dinner on a group tour. Place was easily able to handle our large group with table service.

Food was just OK, and was pretty bland, and very much European version of Indian food.

We went to this Indian restaurant for the first time, and the food was very nice! The spices were good, the price was fair, the quality of the food was very good, It was worth it, we really enjoyed our time.

In the beginning the service was very slow and inattentive. After bringing it to their attention however, they picked up the pace and were very friendly about it. The food was good. The tandoori, palak paneer and naans were amazing. The biryani and the chicken madras were a bit too mild for us. If you like mango lassi, absolutely try it from here, I think it was one of the best ones I've had..ever.
The best meatballs in town! Nice service, yummy food and cozy atmosphere :)
Wonderful place, beautiful people, great food, amazing cocktails.
Food, drinks and people are great. Cozy and arty. I love the place.

The place is beautiful and welcoming, with colors and an atmosphere that make you feel at home. The service is excellent: courteous and helpful. The dishes are tasty and beautifully presented, from the cicchetti to the main courses (the second courses are highly recommended, they're delicious!).
There's also a wide selection of wines, beers, and, above all, fantastic cocktails to try!
The owners are friendly and approachable, always ready to answer your questions.
In short, a place worth stopping by for an aperitivo and even more so for dinner!

We've been waiting a long time for such a lovely place in the heart of the Sacra Famiglia neighborhood, with a wide selection of wines and cocktails. It's the perfect place for an aperitif or dinner. The plain tartare, the focaccia nuvola, and the mozzarella in carrozza are my favorites. Well done guys.
You're also very friendly.

New staff, kind and fast service, cozy atmosphere, beautiful neon signs, AMAZING INGREDIENTS, DELICIOUS PIZZA.
Only small negative (personal) the pizza it’s on the THIN TYPE.
RECOMMENDED.
Everything is great, from the staff to the food. The English-speaking waitress took care of me nicely and made a very good atmosphere to make me comfortable.

I had the best experience at this restaurant.
The service was super fast and the staff very kind. Our pizza was fabulous as well as the rest of our food.
I really recommend it!
Great food. Pizza looked big but was light and delicious. Great wine choices too. Highly recommend. Also has its own car park (bonus)

Have been here 30 years ago when I was living in Padova.  The atmosphere was great, but the pizza was just OK. The atmosphere is still great, but the pizza is now really good. I enjoy very much dining here. If you are looking for something different and good food this is your best choice.

Great and satisfying Chinese culinary experience. The food quality and variety are commendable, making it a correct choice for those seeking authentic Chinese cuisine.
Although the service staff may come across as slightly inexperienced or unsure at times, they compensate with their friendly approach. Our waiter, Matteo, kindly suggested some recommended dishes, which I personally appreciated.
The restaurant offers well-furnished interior, reminiscent of an authentic Asian setting.
The prices are reasonable considering the quality of the food.
Overall, I would consider returning to this restaurant for future Chinese dining experiences with friends or family.
Little ways from padova but worth the trip if you are looking for a good Chinese meal.

Always super good.. I always go there when I want a good chinese food
I try new plate everytime I go there and it tastes really good
I suggest the ravioli al vapore and manzo in salsa agropiccante

The best chinese food I've ever eaten.. I went just because they said was good but after trying I went back the day after
Super suggested!
Excellent cantonese cuisine and the owner is from hongkong. Excellent service and delicious food. Reasonable price.

The food at Mode Sushi is really amazing, and the service is just as good. The atmosphere is chill and nice, with soft lighting that creates a lovely vibe. If you are in the area, I highly recommend trying this place. I’m still dreaming about the veggie gyoza

Beyond amazing service. My gosh they were so kind. We first ordered to go because my blood sugar was low and I needed to eat. Ordering to go was open first. Then once it was done we could sit and dine in the restaurant. The waitress was sooo attentive. Sooo kind. I'm so happy they have eel too. They had my husband favorite fish eggs. 🐟
We can't wait to go back. This is the best sushi 🍣 restaurant in Padua. So close to sushi 🍣 you get in Hawaii or Japan.
My first day in Padova and I was lucky to find this place on Google Maps now the hours have changed so I showed up at 5:30 and they don’t open till 630 but it was worth the wait.
very professional stuff, but also polite. Service is at the level of high-end restaurants. Food is great and prices very decent. I would recommend
A really nice place, food is delicious and nicely served. The staff is extremely friendly, you don’t have to wait for a long time to receive your order. Everything is done the right way!!!!
They are best in Padova. I will miss the poke time when I return my country. Staff are kind and everything is fresh. Price is affordable
After having tried multiple Poke shops in Padova, I can say this is absolutely the one! So much choice, kind staff and the bowl was so good🙂‍↕️ Would definitely recommend going.

Spontaneous stop for dinner; friendly staff, great food, overall a very nice experience.

My daughter and I stayed at the Hotel Europa for two days, and on two evenings we dined at the Zaramella restaurant.
I had called ahead to inform the staff of my food allergies. As soon as we arrived, we were greeted by Mrs. Sara, a delightful and kind person, who gave us all the information we needed to enjoy a delicious dinner, taking into account my numerous allergies. Mrs. Sara went out of her way and, in consultation with the chef, prepared special dishes for me. I had delicious pasta and excellent fried food on the first night, and on the second, a chicken with a side of homemade French fries, truly delicious!
Thank you again for your hospitality, your kindness, and your ability to understand and accommodate the needs of even the most particular guests like me, given my dietary restrictions. We will definitely be back!
A special thanks to Mrs. Sara and the blonde waitress, whose name we don't know, who was very kind and very friendly!
Paola

Foods are amazing, combination of Asian and Italian tastes together. Very welcoming environment!
Foods are very delicious specially kebab !!

If you're in the Portello area of ​​Padua and want to eat well without spending too much, Gausia is a real guarantee. 🌯🍕🔥

Food was great, really!

We discovered this place by chance and absolutely loved being there. It is a state of art Cantonese restaurant run by a  sympathetic family (I guess). A truly elegant Cantonese restaurant offering an impressive variety of dishes, each prepared with care and using exceptionally fresh, high-quality ingredients. A great experience! The food arrived really quickly and was absolutely delicious. The wonderful tiramisu was a real highlight.

The restaurant came recommended by our airbnb host in Padova and we were very happy we went. We had a delicious dinner… pizza, pasta, salad and desert were excellent. The service was prompt and very friendly. We enjoyed sitting outside under the portico. Prices are also really fair. :)

We had a wonderful experience; you can listen to records continuously throughout the night. The sound system is high-quality, but thoughtfully designed so as not to interrupt your conversations. We tried Spritz and the shared snacks; the fact that all options were vegan was an added bonus. Everything was delicious, and the atmosphere was amazing.
Amazing vibes, great music and really welcoming staff who are clearly passionate about their job and products. Cannot recommend this place enough if you want to enjoy a jazz night with friends!

Had a really disappointing experience here after I was really excited to try this osteria.

I arrived and asked in Italian for a table for 3. The waitress (dark hair in a ponytail, large black glasses) asked me if I meant 6? I repeated “no 3” and held up 3 fingers (I have a strong english accent when speaking Italian). She turned towards her colleague and mocked my pronunciation repeating “3”. It felt cruel and a strange way to behave towards three people asking for a table in a near empty restaurant. We were really shocked so didn’t say anything.

Her colleague brought us to a table with 2 chairs. We repeated again we were 3 people (understand clearly at this point by everyone) and he told us to add a stool to the table or take one from another table.

When our wine arrived (delicious) 2 of the 3 pours were visibly underneath the pour line on the glass which was especially ridiculous for wine that cost us 6.5 and 7.5€ per glass.

We had planned to try the menu but left because of our experience. I wouldn’t return after the service.
10/10 place!

The dishes were truly balanced in flavor, and it was a wonderful experience to be able to taste traditional, yet plant-based dishes! They allow everyone who makes this kind of choice to sample tradition while remaining true to their values.
What can I say... thank you!

Pizzeria Al Vecio Cason offers a solid selection of pizza options at affordable prices, making it a great spot for locals. Located outside the city center, it provides a more authentic, local experience.

A Wonderful Dining Experience

We had a fantastic time at this restaurant. From the moment we arrived, everything was perfectly arranged. We didn’t have to wait for a table as it was already booked and it was beautifully presented with a clean, neat tablecloth.

Service was quick and professional. We were approached promptly by a friendly waitress who brought us the menu and we didn’t have to wait long for our food after ordering. We chose pizzas and drinks — and they did not disappoint. The food was absolutely delicious. I ordered the house speciality pizza, which was a delightful combination of different flavours. It was expertly prepared and very satisfying.

As we dined, the restaurant gradually filled up, yet it remained spacious and comfortable. Despite more people coming in, it was easy to hold a conversation without being disturbed by the surrounding noise — a real bonus.

One of the highlights was being able to watch the chefs preparing pizzas right in front of us. It’s always nice to see your food being made fresh with such skill and care.

The atmosphere was very pleasant overall. When we first arrived, the restaurant played charming Neapolitan music, which really added a unique and cozy touch. However, later on, the playlist switched to more commercial American music, which slightly took away from that special Italian vibe. If I could make one suggestion, it would be to keep the traditional Neapolitan music going — it truly made the experience feel authentic and memorable.

All in all, this was a very enjoyable visit. Great food, warm atmosphere, attentive service — I fully recommend this place and would definitely come back!

We ordered 1 Quesadillas and 2 Burritos (one ham and one chicken)

absolutely terribile experience, the food isnt worth the price at all and we were very surprised with the low quality of the material, we got the nachos and a burrito which cost 14 euros each. the Nacho Bowl was cold and smelled very questionabile and the only saving factor about the burrito was the fact that It was some what warm... the cheese had not completely melted either. overall very dissappointing.

the nachos were cold (the cheese was cold and not melted aswell), the burrito was lukewarm.

Yesterday, we went to Lola la Loca and were immediately greeted by Valentina, who warmly welcomed us and took our order. We decided on a pulled beef bowl with rice, sour cream, diced tomatoes, onions, red beans, and guacamole, as well as a pulled chicken burrito with the same fillings, finished with a delicious grilled cheese crust on the tortilla.
We chose the combo meal, which included drinks and a bucket of freshly made churros sprinkled with sugar. The food was excellent, the portions were generous, and the meal offered great value for money.
Valentina was always smiling and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. Our food was ready in less than five minutes, and the background music created a pleasant atmosphere.
The only downside was the seating. The stools are a little too low, which makes eating slightly uncomfortable. Other than that, I wholeheartedly recommend this place if you're looking for a delicious meal and want to try something different from the local Italian cuisine.

Here is really a restaurant for local (elderly) people.
You can immediately get that nostalgia feeling by stopping in. People sitting cozily, drinking coffee and enjoying the time together really make me feel very peaceful.
The food is nothing special, just simple homemade foods like cooked by your grandparents ( for this reason you can really not complain about it.....Will you complain about grandparents food? You just eat it 🤣)
And the price is just way more than fair -- 5€ for a pasta and 1.5€ for cappuccino? A price of a restaurant in the 20th century.
You don't get the best/most delicious foods here but everything is so soothing here, the atmosphere, the interior and the locals...a lunch on a free afternoon here would be just perfect:)
PS: some servers speak English, they also have menus in English/Deutsch
A small restaurant with very good food cooked like my granny.

The experience was an excellent example of a bar / trattoria serving local patrons, making it a great way for tourists from Australia to witness Italian life. Hearty meals and very welcoming staff. We also had our morning macchiato here each day.

Food was really delicious and the staff were very respectful and nice. We were served food very quickly even though it was a very busy day. Definitely going back again to try more asian food!

Such a wonderful restaurant! I fell in love with the duck pasta!!!!! And the lovely waiter Matias. I hope I am writing his name correctly ;)
100% recommend!!!!

We had our first tour group meal here and it was a wonderful introduction to what we would be experiencing while visiting Italy.  Because it was a group set meal I didn't write down the antipasto and it might be off menu, but it was fantastic.  The risotto was perfect.

About one of the best meals I have had in Italy. If you like seafood this is the place. If you are new to seafood you are in for a treat. And don’t worry if all the outdoor tables are busy, Mateo will deftly lift one from the dining hall (glasses and all) and set you up outside. The staff are super nice, especially Mateo who helped us with our food and wine selections. I can recommend the seafood platter (boiled fish) and the seafood risotto and the spaghetti with sardines, which is not salty at all. In fact, it’s surprisingly light and has lovely subtle flavors. Oh yum yum yum.

We try to visit Isola di Caprera when in Padova. Last time we had lunch. We were assisted by Matteo, very experienced person, who runs the dining area smoothly.
I recommend Bigoli al ragu d'anatra, Filetto al pepe verde (exploding in your mouth and precisely prepared), seppie ala veneziana. The Baccala was geared for those who love it - we found that we're not crazy about it.

Recommend.

Excellent service; the young, polite, and professional staff serve the food. The burgers are really good, and the fries are excellent. The price is reasonable for the times: around €13-14 per sandwich. Vegetarian sandwiches are also available. Non-alcoholic beer is not available. There are several tables outside for dining and a small relaxation area with sofas and table football. The bathrooms are super clean and well-kept.

Nice place, attentive and friendly staff. Excellent food, both the burgers, which are truly delicious, and the fried foods, which are not at all greasy and nice and crispy. The dessert selection isn't great, but that's acceptable considering the type of place. I recommend it.

We visited Ai Porteghi Bistrot when we were in Padua two years ago. We enjoyed it so much we wanted to eat there when we visited again.

There were two tasting menus (Garden and Sea) plus à la carte. We chose the Sea Tasting menu. Each of the five courses was creative, delicious and beautifully presented. I also chose the wine pairings (three wines).
At the end of our wonderful meal we got to meet the chef, Matteo Merrazo.
Thank you for another wonderful evening!

I have been to this restaurant twice and can say that it's hands down one of my new favorites in the city, especially for their amazingly affordable lunch specials!! The quality of the dishes for both visits was so good and the staff are very kind and knowledgeable. The menu changes often, usually seasonal and local ingredients. I look forward to when I can return!

As mentioned by nearly all other commentators very good and creative! The friendly and competent service recommended us excellent wines by the glass and the bill really did not hurt. Recommended  by Guide Michelin, could develop even further.Try it!

Let's start from the end: totally worth it!
The place is very cute and service is really well looked after. We had 3 courses and everything was good and peculiar. The Locara, if you like the idea, is great.
Also, fairly inexpensive: we had two starters, two main, one shared dessert, two glasses of prosecco, one glass of red and one of white and water and we barely spent 60€ each.
Will definitely go back if I happen to be in Padova again
A real find in Padua! Creative cooking beautifully presented-- excellent service, thoughtful wine list and lovely dining room made for a wonderful evening! We will be back for sure.

Decisamente imbattibile. Le porzioni sono abbondanti e i prezzi rimangono onestissimi, ideali per studenti o per un take-away dell'ultimo minuto.
Il mio consiglio: Non perderti i loro ravioli al vapore e il pollo alle mandorle, sono tra i migliori della zona! Una certezza per chiunque si trovi a passare in via Giordano Bruno.
Ordered home delivery. Super generous portions and very fair prices. Good food and very friendly staff! I recommend getting the Bis.

I ordered delivery last night, prompt service, and a very kind delivery guy.
I ordered soy noodles with seafood and a trio menu: Cantonese rice, spring rolls, and almond chicken. The dishes were delicious and plentiful! Highly recommended ❤️😊

I ordered the China trio for takeout: spring rolls (lightly stuffed but good and large), Cantonese rice (very good and plentiful), and sweet and sour beef.
I had a great time; the lady was kind, the service was quick, and the food was good and plentiful!
Price: €10.50
We had an excellent fried cuttlefish dish. It's a shame you can't eat it on site; I would have definitely ordered other dishes that looked delicious and inviting.
The best seafood paella! The fried food is delicious, fresh, and cooked to order, and you can even choose just calamari. In my years of frequenting, I've always found everything delicious!

When I don't feel like cooking, this delicatessen becomes my Mecca.
It must be said that their specialty is fish in all its forms. The freshly fried fish is delicious, with the option to choose what goes into it. The fish sauces, the sardines in saor, and the boiled octopus are excellent. The white fish salad is very delicate and well prepared. The mussels are delicious, both plain and with tomato.
The side dishes are also excellent, light and well prepared... I can't say anything about the meat dishes because I'm always drawn to fish.
But the appearance of the meat dishes is also excellent... and they must be delicious.
The prices are in line with the quality, the products, and their freshness.
The fried fish is exceptional, light and crispy, and made to order. The fish and meat main courses are also delicious. Everything is superb, and the owner is very friendly.
Excellent fishmonger and rotisserie. I go especially for the fried fish, which is excellent. They make it to your liking, and the price-quality ratio is among the best in the northwest Padua area.

Very nice place and food, I try their food every time I go to Padova.
Best Chinese food ever.

In Europe, it's ordinary Chinese restaurant level. If you come from a place Chinese abroad lives a lot, you wouldn't be satisfied. But taste is acceptable.
What ruins this restaurant is the Chinese lady. She brought what customers didn't ordered. Not only us. When I asked soy sauce, she said "Si! Si!" but never bring it.
And you have to wait long time. We waited for 40 min.
Good point is all dishes are hot.
Great value for money. Food is delicious. The staff is friendly.
The food is good, but they did not give me what I ordered

Very nice staff, food always good here!
Thank you!

We had the most delicious lunch at Caffe V. The strawberry salad was amazing which we ate outside whilst people watching. The service was excellent and the caffe inside looks very smart but the food is delicious.

I don’t agree with other reviews regarding tiramisu. By far it’s the worst tiramisu I ever had. Its almost entirely a whipping cream, no taste of mascarpone at all. It might be even just cream and eggs… lady fingers were dry and hard too. And just a very little cacao 🤦‍♂️ I would expect at least an average tiramisu for €7

Stopped by to grab a few small sweet bites to go. She did not even have the courtesy to apologise for having kept us waiting. I understand Italian customary, but this was unacceptable. The tarts and apple pie we bought were passable, nothing spectacular. The tartlets were dropped into a paper bag with little respect.

My wife and I stopped at this cozy bar while walking through the streets of Padua and ordered an Aperol. It was a pleasant stop, but we both realized that, even though we rarely drink alcohol and get addicted quickly, we didn't really get hooked. Interesting. Otherwise, a cozy bar.

Attentive good service. Amazing food quality. Clean restaurant with many table selections for all group sizes dining.

They even let us take some of the good home. I'm so glad they offered that ❤️ 💙 💜 now I can enjoy it 2 days in a row.
Can't wait to bring friends here too.

Very nice place in Padua. The restaurant looks like a real Chinese place; it is very big with a lot of tables.
The food is really good and tasty: you can choose up to 3 broths and cook various ingredients in them. There are 2 vegan broths (tomato and mushroom) and they are really tasty with a lot of spices.
They also have a great variety of noodles, Chinese vegetables and tofu. There are also different gluten-free options.
You can also create your own sauce from a big stand with a lot of spices, herbs and oils.
The staff is friendly and polite.

Fast service, beautiful seating, and amazing food! I love everything about this place!
Bonus points: wheel chair accessible and they speak English.
As a Chinese came from Chongqing , one of origin city where Hotpot came from, I would said this Da Long Yì Hotpot is the most authentic hot pot restaurant in Padua!

Let me tell you, i have been living in Europe for 3 years now. This has to be my best Indian restaurant till now. I really like to come here once a month and explore different flavours. I really like how each dosh is well combined with the three chutney/dip they serve which itself makes each thing wholesome. Everytime I go, in sometime the restaurant get full slowly by so many Italians. I tried their Prawns tandoori, veg mix antipasti, biryani (only I did not find upto the mark), Paneer kadhai, masala chai, non veg platter for 2 people with chicken and lamb, cheese paratha, alu paratha, garlic and butter naan.

This is one of the best Indian restaurants, and it truly reflects the culture and atmosphere of authentic India. The service was excellent, and the staff was very friendly. The food was also delicious. My only suggestion would be that the portions are a so small for the price. Otherwise, everything was very good.

Ordered Tandoori prawn, shell were still there and was not cleaned. Called restaurant manager, showed him all the discussing things. He took it back to the kitchen and still added to my bill. Asked for complaint register, but said he don’t have it. Called owner, still no use.
If you care for your health, don’t step inside. Oh and the mosquitoes!
Incredible food and atmosphere ! Good portion size and really welcoming staff ! I totally recommend this restaurant! Would definitely come back!

The food was reasonable and the restaurant is smart. However I was not expecting to be given a hand written receipt because the till was apparently out of order. Nor was I expecting to be asked to pay in cash because the card machine wifi wasn't working. Yet I could see delivery orders coming through without a problem.

Fantastic K-Burger with Green bun (homemade), planted meat, Kimchi,  Spicy vegan mayonnaise. Very recommended colourful place, happy vibes guaranteed. And very friendly staff! My poodle also likes the place.

Truly splendid! Even before you walk into the store, you feel the colourful and heartwarming experience that awaits you. The staff is very friendly and welcoming. I tried the Spicy Cecio menu and some of their sauces - it was spectacular. I only wish they would expand their menu!

If you would like to have some vegan food in Padua, you should definitely check out Flower Burger!

Had to try this fully vegan burger joint in Padua. Group of us had a variety of burgers, all truly delicious. The Parmigiana burger and the Funny Crispy were our favourites. Special mentions for the fried stuffed olives (olive ascolame) which we had as an apertiser and the baconnaise.
The staff were friendly and chatty and they gave us an extra portion of the salami al cioccolato.
Worth a visit for Vegans and Non Vegans!
Food tasty and colourful :) Minus for the very long waiting time for a table. Noisy restaurant, but nicely decorated. It is a pity that there is no menu in English.

Excellent vegan burger place.
Friendly staff, not too expensive, very good food.

These young guys make great pizzas. Much bettter than in neighborhood restaurants. The only problem is that it is a take-away/delivery place. There are only two chairs inside and two outsode and a small ledge where people like us, who didn't read the description, can eat.
The quality of the food and genuine helpfulness of the staff made up for the lack of seating. It's not their problem that we were superficial readers, yet they made am effort to make us as comfortable as possible in the given circumstances.
We were a family of 5, with two teenagers and a toddler. They had fun regardless.
Highly recommended for takeout pizza. Don't make a mistake like us and think that it's a restaurant.

Owner is SO kind and helpful -- very patient with my slow Italian. Nice variety of tasty treats available. Enjoyed a really lovely cappuccino on the patio.

The best part? The owner's adorable (and very sweet) dachshund, Bruno! Wish I'd gotten a photo of him. Such a good boy

The place is well-stocked with top-quality products, some of which are clearly displayed, which tantalize and make your mouth water, as well as Mauro's exemplary kindness.
If I may add a pleasant note: the added value of this place is the total calm and serenity of Mister Bruno.

A beautiful and welcoming place, space is a bit tight when there are a few people, but so far I've always seen it empty or with one or two patrons. I visited the café for a quick snack instead of lunch (the place also offers a "tasty and quick lunch" option). Excellent selection of sandwiches, toasted sandwiches, and piadinas: I chose a piadina and a cappuccino. The service was prompt, and the piadina cost much more than at any other café, but the price was displayed, and I was happy to try it. I don't use cutlery or cover service, and the piadina and cappuccino were good. One surprise, which I found to be a bit of a letdown, came when I got the bill: the cover charge is a generic total on the receipt. I asked for information and was told this was the reason for the difference. Personally, I think they could consult with other businesses and decide on a less aggressive pricing approach, but that's just my opinion. The café's prices are more in line with other places. I hope this suggestion helps you decide; the choice is yours! Thanks for your time.
Hats off to LUCA the owner, excellent service, kind, helpful and attentive in everything even the smallest things. ""COMPLIMENT""I
Great morning break with my nephew who loves bread. Excellent service and courtesy.
Wonderful meal in this tiny out of the way spot. Superb execution, frankly shames a bunch of 1*s in London. Lovely service from the owner. Adored our lunch here.

I recently had an amazing fine dining experience in a restaurant located in the middle of nowhere. We opted for the 10 course menu, and I must say, it was a truly creative and delicious experience with a perfect balance of flavors.

One of the dishes included raw shrimps, which we usually don't prefer, but surprisingly it tasted great. However, the risotto was a bit too al dente and a bit sour for our liking, and it lacked salt.

The wine list was truly impressive, and we were able to find the perfect pairings. We particularly live the sweetbread, but donkey sweetbread was a first time for us. Although we didn't like the taste, it was a great experience to try something new.

We also stayed at the same building hotel Trieste, which was cozy, clean, and nice. It was convenient to have the restaurant and hotel located in the same building.

To top it off, we also had breakfast at the Michelin-starred restaurant, and it was just the two of us. It was a truly memorable experience.

Overall, I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a unique fine dining experience with impeccable service and an amazing wine list. Good luck to the team, and we look forward to returning someday.

A hidden gem in the province of Padua.  An explosion of flavours in every dish but at the same time perfectly balanced and harmonious with each elements.  A lot of research and process in each plate. Superb service and a very great wine selection.  It is really worth a detour and a visit.
Great Restaurant, they‘ve provided us an exclusive lunch! Only guests during our booked timeslot. The food and service is lovely!

Great place to have dinner AND a GREAT breakfast too.
If you need a treat for yourself to start your day that's the place to visit.
Well done!!!
The sandwiches were simple and lovely. Really tasty food, great place to stop for a quick bite! The staff was also really nice. Reccomended!

Nice sandwich place! I had the Tito Livio one for 7,50€. The ingredients are good quality and tasty, come in quantity and the overall sandwich size is correct for 1 person. You may order at the machine inside, then they serve you at your table very fast. They have tables inside and also outside.
Superb sandwich, and great service. Approx 8 euros for a decent size sandwich - too big for my companions to finish.

I got a nice focaccia, extremely tasteful and crunchy.
All the flavours were properly balanced. Perhaps a bit expensive to be Italy, but it is definitely worth the price!

Cosy dining room upstairs (sala interna)

It's a place that you can have sandwiches and sometimes maybe focaccia.
The sandwiches with somehow panini bread and very tasteful.
Maybe its not a surprise in Italy to serving good bread within good dough that it's really a must try.
Good options though.

Really good pizza for very fair price, good selection of wines, friendly staff. What was really extraordinary was homemade dessert (similar to mille feuille) with a glass of sweet wine. Couldn’t wish better ending of our lunch. Would recommend to visit.

We fell on this place by accident.  It was late in the lunchtime period but we were welcomed and ushered through to an 'old style' dining area, elegant and very relaxed.. We had starters (chunky veg soup/ scallops) and main course of pizzas.  It was by far our best experience in the four days in Padua.  The food and the service were exemplary.

Such cozy and warm atmosphere. The food was AMAZING. From starters, thought the main course, and then the star of the show, PIZZA. It had the most delish dough ever. So fine and thine, but yet with the perfect crust.

Top environment from the indoor to the garden. I will choose it for a date.  Nice staff always willing to help. The first and second dishes are just a few but there are like 30 types of pizzas 🍕 you can choose from. One pizza is more than enough for oneself. Their dessert also looked great. Be careful of the time of your arrival because the kitchen closes at 3pm.
Nice ambience, good food, service was fast & efficient. If you want to be serve fast, this is the place. Waiters are professional especially the senior one.

A good local restaurant with ample indoor seating. The pizza was tasty, with a choice of different doughs, including traditional Neapolitan-style and Kamut dough. The ingredients were fresh, and the pizzas were generously topped.

The millefoglie was a delicious dessert and exceptionally generous in portion size. Layers of flaky puff pastry were filled with fresh strawberries and thick pastry cream. The only minor criticism is that the pastry cream could have been a little lighter and creamier.

The service was friendly and welcoming. A couple of small items were forgotten during the meal, likely due to how busy the restaurant was at the time.

Overall, a solid choice for pizza with a very good dessert menu and generous portions.
I luv this restaurant absolutely.Food quality comparing price is really unbeatable.

VERY Lovely Pizzeria. Food was Amazing, bringing some of the classics on a Romana Style base. Massive shoutout for the DESSERTS, they were to die for. Atmosphere and Service made it feel Truly Italian, although it didn't bring anything fresh to the dining experience. All in all, great place.
The service was phenomenal, very friendly and attentive. The food was also great. Will definitely come back!
Their gluten free pizza is a bit thick (has a cake-like texture) but I enjoyed it. They were very generous with the toppings.
Yummy pizza. Felt so authentic and so connection to the Italian aroma. Happy thanks for the entire for giving us good memories!!

Unexpectedly 5 stars ⭐
We received a warm welcome in a highly restyled location where the quality of the food was outperformed only by the wonderful service of the employees.
Special thanks to Alessandra that served is with great personality. 👍🏻

We had a good pizza and a nice beer with several friends. Everyone was satisfied. The place is very big and there are a lot of tables, we had not to book (about 14 people and 2 days before Christmas).

The food is good... soon i will come back again to take a photo. This time i don't  have a photo because im shy to take a shot😥😥😥 only i have this photo. While waiting  the order.. to prove ive been here this restaurant

Every time I come back here, I always eat something different from the last time.
And it never disappointed me, pizza, meat, fish ecc was always delicious. Big compliments for the chefs, waiters and to the director, who was really kind and available for our needs.
Truly recommend this place.

Such a nice relaxed atmosphere and vibe. Came with a large group of family and they accommodated us outside easily. Our server Giulia was very friendly and attentive. The food  that we had was delicious. Very nice first dining experience in Padua.

Good place, good experience. Food was delightful. Expected though even a bit better for the price. We took the biggest menu, probably would have been even more happier with the menu with just meats. Well Tuna dish and pain fried fish dishes were awesome. Crab dish would have been probably even better without the muddy crab 😅. But we had a really nice night, service was awesome. Probably with the 75euro meat menu would have been 5 out of 5.

Maybe we have to go and try that one some other day.

We arrived at the bar. They told us to wait a minute however no one came to seat us somewhere. We saw that most tables were empty so we assumed that we could probably seat anywhere we wanted. However we asked the waitress with bangs and clubmaster prescriptions glasses where we could seat and she turned on us and told us rudely. “ WAIT A MINUTE” and she turned around even tho she wasn’t doing anything. We responded kindly that most of the tables are empty so what are we waiting for exactly? She told us rudely again. “ I HAVE TO FIND WHERE TO SEAT YOU”. We told her that theres alot of tables empty and she told us rudely again that “THEY ARE ALL RESERVED”. However she showed us that we could seat at probably one of the worst tables of the bar. We didn’t say anything and we sat. However that was a lie since only one table came after we did. We didn’t have a problem with the table we got but with the attitude of the waitress. If you dont want to be kind with your customers then change job. Its like saying hello and getting a response back “bye”. Wouldn’t say a good first impression for a place. However the view is nice.

This place was recommended to me by a local as one of their favorite restaurants in Padova.
Exforo is located just next to Prato della Valle and Abbazia di Santa Giustina, and you get to see the most beautiful sunset during dinnertime.
The staff is very warm and welcoming.
I ordered from the tasting menu, and the food was very delicious incorporating local produce.
You can consider having aperitivo at the outside area when the weather is good. Definitely recommend and will return!

This was the perfect experience. Beautiful outside terrace with a view. Nice interior of the restaurant. Very friendly staff. And the food with wine pairing was amazing. I highly recommend this place!

I truly regret going to this place. The guy did not wash his hands and/or put gloves on to start preparing the food. And I saw him handling cash.
I regret eating it after seeing that. The meat was already sitting there and you could tell it’s been there for a while. The place itself looks very dirty. I almost throw up.

I went there this evening for a kebab and chips. It was quite cheap, but the meat had been there for a while and you could tell. The chips were too salty! The kebab itself was good, but there are much better options.
It arrived barely warm, and not the kebab sandwich I'd ordered, but a kebab piadina. Never again. Highly inadvisable, not very serious.

One of the worst kebabs you can eat.
I don't recommend it; the meat is third-rate.

After the first bite, my stomach hurts.
The staff isn't friendly.

Had an amazing meal here today. Every dish was cooked to perfection with great flavors. The staff were welcoming and efficient without being intrusive. Clean, cozy, and great value for money. One of the best restaurants around, will come back often and recommend to friends.
Sushi City restaurant is huge! The decor is beautiful, with various design elements. The owner is warm and friendly, and the food is plentiful and fresh, with many choices. Highly recommended!
highly recommend to the people living near Legnaro for their lunch and dinner time.🙏😍

The food is great but their sushi menu is limited compared to other sushi places in the town. They have very limited options and their sashimi cuts are very huge and not thin. We loved the sweets there
A wonderful place! Remarkably fast service and very tasty food, i’ll make sure to return here!

The pizza is good the workers are rude. You can not bring a water bottle with you to drink. Why you might ask? You need to buy their stuff because they are trying to get every penny you have. The pizza is delicious, but the woman who works there is extremely rude and unpleasant. I will never go back to that place!
Very delicious and friendly.

Keep going well!

Very nice experience, beautiful clean restaurant, beautiful lighting creates a very nice atmosphere. Very spacious and cool vibes. Ordering with an ipad was fun and the food was above board all the way! If you are in Padova or near I strongly recommend you try this place.

Considering the level of service, the pace with which they bring the orders, the atmosphere, the freshness and the deliciousness of the food, it is the best sushi I have tried in Padova so far. The Bigne's are especially recommended! Can't wait to go there another time.

We are on a vacation here in Italy at our friends, I made an early order around 16:30 for a delivery at ~19:00 (opens at 18:30) for mine and their kids because I stayed at home with all of them, I also knew that our friends usually go to this restaurant, the food came overall not bad. But the fact that it was missing a position from the order made my nanny experience very bad and the kids also got upset…

Overall, a very good experience. We chose the all-you-can-eat dinner menu and found it to be excellent value. The food selection was well balanced and sufficient, without being excessive. Orders were served very quickly, and the staff were kind, attentive, and proactive throughout the meal. The restaurant was not crowded, and the spacious layout, tasteful interior design, and pleasant background music created a comfortable and relaxing atmosphere.

The best: big place good for people with kids. There are books for kids, sometimes there is also a babysitter that takes care of them.  There is also kids menu. It is divided in 2, the coffee place and the restaurant place. The coffee place can be also for a quick coffee with normal prices. The restaurant, has 4 or 5 options for each type of dish (antipasto, primo, secondo, dessert). The food is good, nothing special. I would recommend the carbonara di gamberi. There are a lot of sockets for charging cellphones. Attention is kind, we arrived without reservation and even though they were full they offered us a small little angle to eat.

Really more for families. Sort of a shop that also does meals. The share plate and appetiser were very large - we had chicken and prawns - both came with mayo. They were fine but not exciting. For mains hubby really loved the mixed meat pasta - I had the pork Schnitzel which again had the mayo and was a little oily for my tastes. Bread for copertta was below average for Italy. Staff were friendly.

Kids don’t lie, my daughters said this place is “Bellissimo”, the parents say that the service is first class, the food and drinks are outstanding. Highly recommend for families but also for a business lunch or chill evening with friends.
HIGH QUALITY BISTROT, TASTEFUL DISHES, NICE FORNITURE and TOILET, NICE KIDS SPACE. Good the idea of using MENU QR CODE, but lacks of pictures of the dishes. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
Modern place with curated dish selection. Price a little on the higher side. They have a dedicated kids area, great for family gatherings. A business area is available as well.
Great bar with super tasty food. Prices are super nice. Good service and nice cocktails. Important, that they are open till late. Recommend. Will come back again 👍👍👍
Very nice but very noisy place, I've been there many times. The food was good and the cocktails were amazing. Perfect place for a midnight aperitif with friends.
6666 is not open 24 hours at all... The opening hours on Google Maps are a complete lie 🙄

The Google information was inconsistent with reality; it showed the place as open 24 hours, but when I arrived at around 2 AM, it was already closed. I came all the way from a distance and wasted my time.

Unfortunately, my experience wasn't positive. The atmosphere wasn't suitable, as smoking was common in the enclosed space, making the atmosphere very stuffy and uncomfortable. Furthermore, a particularly noisy table, with constant shouting, compromised the tranquility of the place.
I reported the situation to a staff member, but no action was taken. Overall, the experience was disappointing.

The pizzas are absolutely delicious! We have eaten here many times and have always been satisfied. The atmosphere is warm and family-friendly, the service is always very kind and welcoming, and the prices are very reasonable. We highly recommend this place to everyone who loves authentic Italian pizza. Thank you for the great experiences!

The best pizza i ever had. Amazing dough, delicious ingredients. I couldn't believe how good it was. I'd give my hair away for one more slice

My favourite pizza in Padua. The debate it's on which kind of pizza you like, but the taste and the variety of choices aren't arguable! You can even comose the pizza you like more!
The people inside are fun and helpful.
If you don't find "Gricia" in the menù, ask for it, you'll be happy about it ;)
Service is nice and in cassa they speak very good English

The food was great, and had decent vegan options. The waiters were so kind, they offered us free dessert at the end of the meal (probably because it was Christmas). It was the best Christmas dinner I've had in a while!

One of the best Chinese restaurants I have ever been to.

The food was excellent value and excellent quality.  All fresh and tasty.

The restaurant was packed at lunchtime with a very nice atmosphere.

Visited here for the second time and it was just as yummy as the first.

Shanghai Restaurant in Padua is an absolute gem …!!

Stepping into this place felt superb, greeted by friendly, happy staff and it’s no wonder—being the first Chinese restaurant in the city; the food was absolutely amazing.

It has an unique feature: a glass floor with a koi pond beneath, enjoying our meal while watching colorful fish swim below. ￼

The atmosphere is cozy yet lively, making it the perfect spot for an adventurous night out or day for that matter.

For anyone craving a taste of China in Padua, Shanghai Restaurant is a must-visit.

One of the best authentic Chinese food we ever had. A very good variety on the menu both vegetables and non vegetarian food. We enjoyed so much that decided to visit again during our short holiday break.

Fast, even though it was Sunday evening and we hadn't booked: just 10 minutes to get three takeout pizzas.
You can sit outside, and I assume you'll even reserve some seats, because I saw a "reserved" sign on a table. Inside, I noticed a small open area where perhaps they'll add indoor seating this winter (I hope so!).
Good prices (a little lower than other takeout pizzerias in the area) and adequate quantities.
Excellent pizza quality: light, easy to digest, not thirsty, cooked to perfection.
Expertly managed electric oven.
Wide selection of pizzas, as well as other delicacies: baguettes, calzones, pizza sandwiches, panzerotti, and fried foods.
Whole wheat dough, Napoli dough, and Roman-style pizza by the slice are available (reservation required).
Family and mini pizza sizes are also available.
Home delivery is available.
The only drawback: parking in the area. Either you take the nearby streets or it's better to walk or take a motorbike/bike.

I'd say this was a very positive first experience! We'll definitely be back soon.

2x 4-cheese pizzas (€8 x 2)
1x ham, mushroom + spicy salami pizza (€7 + €1 additional salami + €1 Napoli dough = €9)
Total €25

From the menu, excluding any special additions or dough, the maximum price for a pizza is €9.50.

I confirm that you can eat in and reserve both inside and outside. The fried zeppole are excellent! The staff is always courteous and very kind. We're now regulars 😋

Excellent takeout pizzeria! The pizzas are always tasty, well-topped, and made with quality ingredients. The family-size pizzas are also very convenient, perfect for sharing with a large group: large, flavorful, and always cooked to perfection. Friendly and helpful staff, quick preparation times, and on-time delivery. Definitely one of the best options in the area for those who want pizza as good as a pizzeria, but to enjoy at home.

Sharing the same roof as the legendary Le Calandre (3 Michelin stars), Il Calandrino offers a wonderful opportunity to experience the Alajmo philosophy at a far more accessible price point.

From the chef’s welcome snack to the beautiful millefoglie dessert, every course was executed with precision and elegance. Highlights included the delicate cuttlefish ink tagliolini with seafood and pistachio sauce, the seasonal asparagus dish with artichoke strudel, and the surprisingly tender donkey picanha with grilled friggitelli peppers.

The wine list is thoughtfully curated, and we particularly enjoyed a mature white from Tenuta San Leonardo alongside a glass of Speri Sant’Urbano Valpolicella Classico Superiore.

Service is warm, professional and relaxed, creating an atmosphere that feels refined without being intimidating. While Il Calandrino naturally stands in the shadow of its famous big sister, it shines brightly on its own merits.

An excellent destination near Padua for anyone looking to experience Michelin-level hospitality, cooking and attention to detail without the Michelin-level bill.

The best croissants ever! Fragrant and fluffy, made with real butter! Yummy filling, I lost my mind over the hazelnut coating!
If you haven't already been there, then you must go!

The best place to eat Lebanese food, they have amazing sandwiches and menu offers. Guys who are working here are very friendly. There are vegetarian/vegan options. I frequently come here to eat lunch and I have never been disappointed. Recommendations!

A great Kebab place in Padova, which is made better by the warmth of the brothers that run it. Though they have vegetarian options, their chicken teriyaki and fajita rolls are out of this world. Highly recommended.

I have visited Alì Baba e i 40 Panini place several times and I must say the food is absolutely delicious and flavorful. The owners are very warm and friendly, creating a welcoming atmosphere. I highly recommend trying their best Lebanese fast food dishes and Lebanese sweets. Everything was excellent. Highly recommended!

Big portions and fair price, the food is spiced mildly, so if you need an additional kick to you food you can ask the staff.
