Being Lebanese I can recommend this place. The food is made Lebanese style and it's absolutely delicious. The guys are Lebanese, very kind and fast working. The place is simple. The menu has enough choice. The price is fair and the foods quality is very high. If you're Lebanese or you like middle eastern cuisine you must try it!
All you can eat. Kind staff. Good food. Fair prices.
All you can eat during the week. Service was quickly and efficiently, but I didn't find beef or duck meat. Anyway all well and fresh!
The best Japanese all-you-can-eat I had up to now. Fair price. Good food. Fast orders. Top organization.
The quality, texture, and taste of the sashimi here are decent (not exceptionally fresh and delicious). considering the price, it’s quite worth it.

Our order came very quickly it was the best. The meals were so good and we ordered a vanilla mochi it was so amazing that we asked for a second round!!! Overall it was my most enjoyable dinner in Padova🩷🩷🩷

We had a wonderful experience at Pizzeria Casa Della Pizza. The pizza was fresh, delicious, and full of flavor. The crust was perfectly baked, the ingredients were high quality, and the portions were generous. The staff were friendly, and the service was excellent. I highly recommend this pizzeria to anyone looking for authentic and tasty pizza. We will definitely come back!
The pizzas dough are amazing and the staff is very welcoming and friendly. Regards from the Portuguese Professor to the best Engineer Pizzaiolo (the staff will understand the joke)

The pizza was delicious and customer service was even better!😋🥰

Stopped in with my mum for a quick bite before leaving Padova and was really impressed. The food was fantastic, service was speedy, and the menu has a great variety at very affordable prices. Would definitely recommend!

Great spot for delicious Tex-Mex tacos and Italian pasta. The tacos de fuego, pulled pork, pollo asado, pollo e avocado were amazing! Very friendly staff, reasonable prices, good atmosphere, delicious food, and interesting sauces. Recommend the jalapeño poppers as well. This is my new go to spot!

I found this wonderful place on my way from the Basilica to the station. Great tasting and great value pasta, and how sensible to give the customer a choice of portion sizes. Friendly staff too. If I didn’t live 1600km away I would go there regularly!

Very good and affordable place, during lunch there is no cover charge, which was pretty good for me. Yes, they will serve dish in disposable plate, but why not.
I also liked the pasta - you can create your own combibation, which is pretty cool and it was tasty. They have a lot of coffee types and it was good as well.
Staff was very friendly.
Very nice place. Pasta and aperol was good. Stuff was very nice 🙂 we got wind that aperol is local here in Padova. Also bread as snack was very good. I recommend this place 👌

If you are looking for real brisket, this is the place. The best brisket in the area. You will not regret it. My goal is to try everything on the menu 😅 We have been here twice already and will most definitely be our go-to spot even if we have to travel almost 40 minutes.  It's worth it!

We wanted to go to this place since forever....and finally I must say it was worth the wait. The choice of pizza is very interesting and we let the staff (super Calogero expecially) guide us bringing several rounds of tastings :)

On the top floor (entered from the pizzeria) is this very unique place, with wall projections and meticulously crafted furnishings and finishes. The tables next to the tall windows overlooking the city walls are lovely. The service is very friendly, and the sushi is a quality mix of different types of fish, including tuna in two different grades of fattiness, just like in Japan. A definitely more authentic experience than your average all-you-can-eat restaurant.

One of the best places to eat in Padova. The service, the staff, and the chef were fantastic. They cook wonderful food and also know its origin. Their vegetable dishes are amazing. Chef 10/10 ⭐️. One of the best places I have eaten at.

One of the best restaurants in Padova!
Really delicious food with consistent quality of every single course, very lovely staff with a very cute atmosphere that's very suitable for a date night or a hangout with friends.
Very good dishes, fantastic meat, nice location. Price adequate to meat quality. Parking is a little complicated, but there's a car dealership parking 5 minutes far from the restaurant
Lovely atmosphere in the outdoor garden. Both the tartare classica and the tagliata were delicious. Great service, the staff was very helpful and kind. Will be back!

There is no fantasy in their kitchen, but the quality is very high and the staff is super kind.

If the concept of "chaotic evil" were a physical place, it would undoubtedly be the Summer Bar. Just stepping inside is enough to understand that this is a place where common rules of thumb count for nothing. The menu is classic Chinese restaurant fare (special mention: their fried tofu is the bomb), but it's the experience that makes the difference: personally, I've witnessed meetings of what seemed like some Eastern European Communist Party, an Iranian New Year's Eve, arguments between boomers dancing the bubble on PokerStarz, and the comings and goings of characters who seem to have stepped out of a noir film from times gone by.

The bagigi (aka peanuts) come with unlimited free refills. The icing on the cake.
Exquisite, everything ordered several times, really delicious

In all fairness, I have to give a super positive review. It's run by Chinese people, but I ate like I've eaten at the best Italian trattorias. I'm referring to the lunch of the day, and in particular the spaghetti aglio olio e peperoncino. I want to emphasize: THE BEST!!!
Well done, well done!
Highly recommended!
One of the most delicious meals I’ve ever had in my life!! I ate a carbonara and it was like in the books!! I can’t say one bad word about this place!! Fully loved it 😍

Interestingly, the tiramisu was one of the best I’ve ever had in my life. I’m sure there are places with better pasta, but overall I enjoyed the experience, and I would definitely come back if I’m in the area again.🍷

Here’s a tip, come as early as they open ! And believe me that the restaurant gets packed during lunch hour, we came before the crowds starts. Ordering thru QR codes. They have today specials which are not in the menu (waiter/ess will introduce). The sauce is really rich and flavourful.
Definitely will be back !

We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful from the moment we arrived. Even though it was our first time there, one of the girls went out of her way to assist us—we are very grateful to her for making us feel so welcome.

The food was absolutely delicious, and the interior design of the restaurant is also beautiful and inviting. We truly enjoyed our visit and would happily come back again.

This restaurant exists in several cities in Italy. It is a very safe option bacause the menu and way of making the food is the same across restaurants and we had a meal with them more than one time. The food is great, ingredients are fresh. Quick service. You can order from your phone and even pay there if you want. I don't think you need a reservation. The price is also pretty good for Italy!
Wonderful service. But the food wasn't meeting the hyper. Over all not bad. Loved the cats they take care of here.
Our family had hamburgers, which were excellent. The patties were juicy and the buns nice and crispy. The service was polite and fast.
wonderful location and great food. Staff was very helpful as well!

We had a great time at Aquolina restaurant. A group of 9 people arrived 40 minutes before closing and they prepared everything for us quickly. The restaurant has great options for vegetarians and service was exceptional. Highly recommended!

Great dinner with my wife. We walked from another hotel and really enjoyed Sofia, our server, and all of the staff. Enjoyed great aperitifs, bottle of wine. The Burger Guerriero and the potatoes (patabush) were exceptional along with some onion rings and gelato. Thank you!

I visited this pâtisserie and I’m absolutely delighted! The cakes and croissants are incredibly tasty, every bite is a real treat. The coffee is excellent and perfectly complements the sweet delights. I especially want to highlight the friendly and welcoming staff. Definitely a place I recommend!
Italian typical and high quality pastries: 10/10 super gourmet, vegan friendly and the staff is fantastic!!

Pasticceria Breda is one of my favorite spots in Padova for a relaxing coffee break. The coffee is always excellent, the pastries are fresh with a great variety to choose from, and the staff are genuinely kind and welcoming. Whether you’re stopping by for breakfast or an afternoon treat, it’s the perfect place to enjoy a sweet moment in Padova!
Great coffee and tasty croissants. A perfect spot to enjoy a slow, authentic Italian morning. The prices are fair, too.

Perfect place for a delicious breakfast or coffe break. There’s a very good selection of pastries and cakes and the coffee is good. Seats and toilet are available inside. The staff was not very welcoming but the service was fine.
Prices were average.
This is a good place for eating chicken. According to their claims they provide halal chicken.
I dont hate this place
was good

Ordered through JustEat.
Aside from the service itself (they arrived significantly late; when I pointed this out, the eloquent response was "yes"), the quality of the food is terrible. I felt sick, I had indigestion, and I don't think the cold was the problem. My boyfriend has a very strong stomach and he also had problems. Highly not recommended.

Excellent fried chicken and fries. Too bad it was empty when I went, and I had to wait 20 minutes for a sandwich and a drink. It's ridiculously slow for a place that feels like a fast food joint. Plus, parking is impossible. Only go if you're really hungry and can't find anything better.

We had one of the best dinner here. We came all the way from Vicenza, and it was absolutely worth it. Everyone was very kind, and I can honestly say the food was truly delicious and authentic Lebanese. Thank you so much — see you very soon!

A hidden gem! The food was amazing! I had the hummus, filled grapevine leaves and the shawarma. Everything is very fresh and so flavourful. Just the right amount of spicyness. Finished my visit with one of the best teas I've ever had. I will be coming back here more often.

This place has a really great atmosphere and beautiful interior design. The waiter was very friendly and spoke English fluently, so ordering was very easy for us. I especially loved the baklava, it was fresh and perfectly crispy.

The place is absolutely amazing! We visited with a large group, and everything was perfect. The food quality was outstanding, the portions were generous, and the service was fantastic. The baklava is truly one of a kind. Galal and the team were incredibly friendly and welcoming hosts. I would 100% recommend this place!

We got the labneh, hummus, fatteh, falafel, tabouleh - with the side of pita and the food was absolutely delicious. A safe haven for vegetarians!
I’d highly recommend a detour as this may be one of the best Lebanese food I’ve had in these parts.
If you enjoy heat, ask for the side of hot sauce - the flavors and heat are on point

I was brought to this place by locals, so I think that speaks for itself. I had the seafood carbonara, which was incredibly delicious. We spent a long time sitting and chatting, and we never felt rushed. The prices are very reasonable too - first course, wine, and coffee costed me around 20 Eur. Highly recommended!

Nice place with a small but solid menu of regional classics, all well-prepared. The atmosphere is the best the location can offer. Service is quick and efficient, though a bit rushed. Good for a straightforward, quality meal.

We waited at the table for about 15 minutes without being greeted or having our order taken. We called out several times, but no one responded. The service was very slow, and other tables who arrived after us were served and received their orders before us.
The food portions were also very small compared to expectations.
Overall, the service experience was disappointing and felt unfair, especially as we were not properly attended to during our visit.

The best: environment and food. The service is friendly but can be a bit slow though. I tried the risotto that was really good for me, it has a strong cheese. The cesar salad seemed good too. The deco is good, there is a entire wall decorated with bottles of wine. There is a small but clean bathroom inside.
Fabulous food. Good wine selection. Friendly service. Good price

Amazing portions for an amazing price.

I was able to get this combo for only €9.90 and it filled me up completely.
The toast is cooked fresh and prepared on the spot ensuring that the food is served hot.
When I visited the store there was only one worker at the time who was operating the cashier and cooking at the same time; however, the service was still incredibly quick. Within 5 minutes, me and 7 other guests got our toasts freshly made!

Would definitely come again if I have the chance!
The sandwiches are delicious, the staff very helpful and friendly and the wait time very short.

We were so happy to discover Capatoast. It's not only fast, but also open during siesta, which was incredibly convenient. They offer fantastic gluten-free and vegan options, making it easy for everyone to find something delicious. And the best part? The taste was excellent! Definitely a go-to spot for a quick and satisfying meal.
Delicious and the person at the till was very kind and helpful.  Grazie!
Loved the sandwiches, we ordered, The Capatoast people were so friendly and also suggested the best gelato to have in padova too

Great pizza! I've ordered over ten times and it never disappoints. I can also recommend the pizza "pala" (comes in a rectangle, the dough is much thicker) and the dessert with pistacchio creme. The app also works well, and you get some discounts if you order often.
Excellent pizza. Very light dough, crunchy crust and excellent ingredients. We tried Margherita, Siciliana and Ham/Mushrooms.
Great pizzeria, pizza is easy to digest. They are kind and offer take away or deliver.
It's the best low-carb pizza ever tasted. So light and easy to digest. I genuinely love it. I would recommend it with no hesitation.
Best pizza in Padova, everyone should try it!

We chose this place because it's close to our hotel. The restaurant is designed very stylish. The main problem is an absence of English menu. We ordered different dishes and everything was very good, also we got a compliment. The service was very good

We ordered different things in two menus to try. Dishes containing raw fish were all close to excellent, we specially like the shortly grilled tuna (can't remember the exact name any more), it was both delicious and beautifully presented; the trio fish carpaccio was more than enough for one person. The only thing that were a bit disappointing were the ramen soups. So I would recommend to order fish dishes or sushi rather than noodles.
Best sushi ever. Very nice place. Need to reserve for dinner.
Great salmon, good service, nice atmosphere.
Very modern and cosy atmosphere. Long list of sea food alternatives. Very delicious and reasonably priced food. But no English menu. The only thing to criticize. You have to decide based on photo.

If you are looking for a place in Padova that combines warm hospitality, beautifully prepared dishes, and a relaxed but elegant atmosphere, BA Her T Pot is an absolute gem. From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed — the staff are friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do.

The food is exceptional. Every dish is thoughtfully presented, full of fresh ingredients, and balanced in flavour. You can taste the quality and the care put into each plate. Whether you choose something traditional or a more creative option, everything arrives perfectly cooked and beautifully arranged.

The ambiance is another highlight. The restaurant has a cosy, stylish interior that makes it ideal for both casual meals and special evenings. Despite its refined atmosphere, it never feels pretentious — just comfortable, warm, and inviting.

Service is professional but personal. The staff are quick to recommend dishes, explain ingredients, or help with wine pairings, and they consistently check that everything is perfect without being intrusive.

Prices are fair for the quality offered, and the entire experience feels absolutely worth it.

We loved this hot pot experince. The food was really good quality, lots of selections (some very authentic choices if you want to explore outside of your normal cuisine), lots of sauce ingredients to choose from, and the decor was so cute. We loved it. Even though we live almost 2 hours away we are looking forward to returning again!

The food was amazing. The spices are fresh and it was a great experience for me and my friend!

The store was clean and the employees were so nice to us. They helped make us a delicious spice bowl with peanut sauce as the base.

Authentic Chongqing hotpot in padova! Fresh ingredients and the tomato broth we ordered was delicious. I enjoyed a lot my family dinner there. So many choices for the dipping sauces. Will definitely invite more friends next time to share this wonderful dining experience.

I’m not sure the man’s name who helped us but he was so helpful and he explained everything to us as we don’t speak Italian. the food was very good and they explained how long to cook each item. i will be back to this place as i just ate this a day ago and i already want more.

nice kebab, the flavors are much better than others in the area! the sauce is actually a little spicy, how nice! the staff is very kind :) slight bit of a wait, but we weren’t in a rush so not much of a problem
Absolute gem of a find. I recommend everyone to this spot - best kebab in Padova! The people working there are so friendly and very dedicated to making the best food.
This restaurant is very affordable. The prices are really low for the quality they offer, and the staff is very friendly and welcoming.
I’m visiting Italy and I found this keyboard and pizza and when I saw the prices I was told because in Germany it’s more expensive and the food was very very tasty and I will recommend it.
I was searching for Halal food. And amazingly I found a tasty halal food here. Keep it up

As a student, this place offers the best price-to-portion-to-taste and it's halal! I'm surprised I can be full after merely spending 5 euros! (Without drink, of course)

The place is kinda small, though. It feels awkward when I eat outside. Nonetheless, best place for my student bank balance! 😁

The restaurant is small with acceptable number of tables. The foods are different from Indian and international foods as shown in the photos. The foods are good with excellent price for each dish. The staff is very nice and they bring for you fresh bread.
Delicious and authentic food and friendly service. Simple place, but great quality.
They provide halal menu. The chicken briyani is soooo tastyyyy
Friendly and polite service, the kebab was delicious and really satisfying after walking the whole day in Padova. Close to the train station and to the tram. Great flavour!

we went to All You Can chick.
At first, we waited for about an hour to receive our first box.
The food wasn’t fresh at all, the chicken was tough.
We asked for the second box, which was brought an hour and a half later!!! It was extremely salty and soaked in oil, to the point that we couldn’t eat it.
However, the hamburger was really good.

I went for the Chicago style Pizza, it did not disappoint but everything was a bit salty, including the fries. And this is a pizza to eat on a sharing basis, you can’t finish this alone. You should not haha
3.5/5
Food was averagely big, I ordered the rib plates, it was somewhat dry, but it was painstakingly okay. My friend ordered a Canadian burger, which was alright. They missed two bottles of water.

Excellent experience at this hamburger restaurant! We had a small 212 burger lunch offer and a Canadian burger, both tasty and satisfying. We went on Monday so beer was 50% off which was a plus. The atmosphere is very cozy, large space with nice tables, chairs and interior. Waiter was lovely as well.

We tried the smash burger with blue cheese and it was really great. We also ordered ribs, but they were terrible,  the worst thing I have ever put in my mouth. I couldn’t even swallow them. However, the girls who work there are really kind.
This is a nice sport for dinner as the seating indoors was good. They also had an English menu. Although the food was average, the nice atmosphere and great service made up for it

Lovely small restaurant with a big menu set across from the church, on a busy Main Street.

⭐️ friendly and welcoming staff albeit slow service.
🍝 pasta was good
🌱 vegetarian options available
🍸 good selection of cocktails and wine available.
🍺 good selection of beer.
🐶 dog friendly (no water bowl provided)
🪑 outdoor covered seating

Excellent restaurant.
We came here for lunch.
Inside is very spacious.
We ordered pizza and piadina.
Everything was very delicious.
The piadina had a lot of filling, which made it especially tasty.
Highly recommended!

Amazing food and a strong Aperol! Exactly what we needed.
Highly recommend! 🤗
The Chicken Burger and Fries are very delicious!! The vegetarian Lasagna was a little small but all of the other orders were soooo good! Huge Portion and great quality!
Surprisingly authentic place. Highly recommended.
Super nice food and service
the drinks here are better than all the bubble tea shop in Padova, highly recommended even just for the drinks. The rice noodle here is also very nice. 5/5 for the tea, 4.5 for the rice noodle.

My experience at Guoqiaomixian was excellent. As soon as I walked in, the calm atmosphere and relaxing background music immediately made me feel comfortable. It was the kind of place where you could truly unwind after a long day.

The food was delicious, especially the nourishing soup, which was rich in flavor and very satisfying. The service was outstanding—the staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and made the entire dining experience even more enjoyable. The only dishes I wouldn't particularly recommend are the grilled items, as they were not as impressive as the rest of the menu.

I left feeling relaxed, full, and already looking forward to my next visit. If you're looking for comforting food, a peaceful atmosphere, and excellent service, Guoqiaomixian is a fantastic choice.

This recently opened restaurant offers Asian cuisine, especially Chinese. The staff is extremely friendly and helpful. Service is fast, and you can order from the menu using a QR code. Highly recommended!

The food is excellent! The lasagna melts in your mouth. The boar is tender and falls about easily and has excellent flavor. The salad had a unique and amazing flavor.

The kitchen is only open for lunch, so make sure you get there on time.

Lovely little spot hidden away from the busy streets. The staff was very friendly and accommodating as I don’t speak a lock of Italian. Had a sandwich that was delicious and two refreshing glasses of white wine. Able to pay with credit card. Recommend for a nice lunch away from the busier streets.
They have a really good "latte di avena" option with the coffees which is the best combo and cold coffee I had in Padova. You need to ask for a latte macchiato freddo con giacchio.

6.29.18 - stopped here for a drink while waiting for dinner to open. The staff us super nice and they let us sit inside in the back with the A/C with our family. We ordered the Campari and Arone spritz,  other of which are very good.

The food looks pretty good too and their main seating area is outside in the piazza.

If you are not Italian, please keep in mind the kitchen closes after lunch and they only serve drinks. We got there at 15:00 and there was no food being served anymore. The coffee was very good, the service friendly, it is located in a beautiful small square.

The only strange thing is that when you are in the toilet, you can see a camera placed outside but there is glass so it really feels uncomfortable. I am sure the camera is looking towards the restaurant’s entrance and not inside the toilet, but they should block that.
Exceptional food for the most part with friendly and helpful service. However extremely unprofessional at resolving complaints.

Everything was perfect! We have diner for San Valentin's day and was one of best diner ever had. The food was delicious, the atmosphere with flowers and 💕.  Krisilda with her suggestion and smile make the night more beautiful. We will turn again.

A Meat Lover's Paradise – Unforgettable Dining Experience

Our recent dinner at El Parillero Steakhouse & Restaurant in Selvazzano Dentro was nothing short of exceptional. As a group of four adults and three children, we were warmly welcomed into a modern and inviting atmosphere that set the stage for a memorable evening.​

Ambiance: The restaurant boasts a contemporary design with a cozy and elegant ambiance, making it suitable for both intimate dinners and family gatherings. The staff's professionalism and attentiveness further enhanced the dining experience.​

Cuisine: El Parillero specializes in a diverse selection of meats sourced from around the world. Each dish was expertly prepared, showcasing the restaurant's commitment to quality. The menu offers a variety of options, including tender steaks, flavorful ribs, and succulent cuts like the Tomahawk and Fiorentina. The meat is sold by weight, ensuring transparency and fairness. Additionally, the wine list features an excellent selection, complementing the rich flavors of the dishes.​
Gastroranking

Service: The staff at El Parillero are knowledgeable and passionate about their offerings. They provided insightful recommendations and ensured that our dining experience was seamless from start to finish.​

Family-Friendly: Despite being a steakhouse, El Parillero caters to families with children, offering a welcoming environment and menu options that appeal to younger diners.​

Final Thoughts: El Parillero Steakhouse & Restaurant offers an unparalleled dining experience for meat enthusiasts. The combination of exceptional food, attentive service, and inviting ambiance makes it a standout choice in Selvazzano Dentro. Whether you're a local or a visitor, this establishment is a must-visit for those seeking top-quality meat dishes in a refined setting.

Excellent food and service quality! Best place to eat e very good lunch or dinner.  We taste and enjoy everything from food to atmosphere and a very special attention from staff to the clients. The list of wines was also very good, with a large kind of Italian wine. It's a place to return again. I'm planning another trip in Italy and another dinner @ parillero!

A very pleasant experience with great service!

Although I don't eat meat, my three friends were really happy with theirs. I had a vegetarian pasta, which was also very well made. We were advised on wine and got to try a couple before deciding. After paying for our meals, we were treated to a shot of our choosing (they have a great Limoncello).

As we don't speak much Italian, we were happily surprised that all of the staff spoke English with us. Furthermore, they were all lovely and made the vibe very enjoyable.

Easily a place I'd recommend to anyone going to the outskirts of Padova.

Ravioli and Sapori are truly the best in everything
They prepare the food incredibly fast usually within 10 minutes — and everything is always fresh and delicious.
The flavors are authentic, the quality is excellent, and every dish tastes amazing.
Highly recommended for anyone who wants great food, quick service, and a fantastic overall experience.

I must say, I wouldn’t have thought of giving it a try if I hadn’t been there, nearby, starving and craving something other than the usual kebab or fast food. I saw a bit of a queue, and together with my friends, we approached the front, which was straightforward. We ordered some bao and ravioli 🥟 that I have to say were tasty and delicious. The girl at the till was friendly and always available to meet our requests. Unfortunately, there are not many places to just put our plates down, no seats or chairs available, so we had to stay standing and the surrounding was a bit dirty and not ideal. Prices are in line with what you find nearby.

This fast food shop specializes in ravioli, offering both meat and vegetarian options. You can watch them being prepared fresh right after you order. Grab your ravioli and enjoy them in the piazza – it’s a delightful experience that I highly recommend.
Enjoyed the mo sandwich a lot. Bread was warm and crispy and the meat was soft and juicy
Nice Chinese dumplings and gyozas with a variety of options, good for a cold weather. Take-out only. The ladies there were very friendly.

I was really looking forward to this meal, but it turned out to be very disappointing. The wait was far too long! Even though the restaurant wasn't full, it took an hour and a half for all the food to arrive. The first two hot dogs were okay, and I even praised them a few times, but the more I ate, the more disappointed I became. On the first day of opening, raw marinated meats were available, but they were out of stock, and many other items were also unavailable. The scallops with vermicelli had hard edges. The foil-baked enoki mushrooms were essentially enoki mushroom soup—very watery, the taste was okay, but the presentation was terrible. The potatoes also looked awful. The lamb skewers were a bit bitter and gamey, and the tips were burnt. The sweet and sour pork ribs were stale, smelled bad, and lacked flavor; I couldn't stand it after one piece and returned them. The older server couldn't remember the table number and kept bringing the wrong dishes. The only redeeming quality was that the oysters were larger than those at other restaurants and weren't too fishy. This is the first time I've ever eaten at a restaurant and felt angry. When I went to pay, there was no receipt, and I saw someone smoking in the kitchen. A very disappointing meal. I will never come back.
You can sing karaoke, the food is good, and the price is normal.
The taste was alright, just a little salty, but otherwise it was fine.

Seeing is believing. The food tastes good, the ingredients are quite fresh, and the portions are generous. I heard that this barbecue chef used to run several successful restaurants in Italy, and now he's his own boss. This meal was definitely worth the long journey. buonissimo.
I never knew barbecue could be so delicious until I went to this barbecue restaurant, which also had a great atmosphere.

Amazing place/bar/antipasti/music
The menu changes often for the antipasti, this is the best place for cheap wine and prosecco, good actual music and the ambiance. Really recommend!! The location is awesome even if it's a bit outside of the city's historical centre 😊
Not enjoyable at all. Some random girl stuck her dirty fingers in my dreadlocks in line. Avoid if over 21 years old.
Security is very very rude. They insulted my race.
It's a nice place to enjoy after exams. However it's a bit small but if you go with nice friends you'll enjoy
Beautiful place! But you need to be or member of a club, or pay 5 € for that. But it worth it! Recommend!

Really good gluten-free cannolo.

I had tried the arancini here before and came back to try the cannolo definitely a good choice. It was assembled on the spot, so the shell stayed nice and crisp (which is not always easy with gluten-free), and the filling was creamy, well-balanced, and very flavorful without being too sweet.

You can tell there’s care in the preparation. Simple, but very well done. I’d happily order it again.

Another good vegan friendly spot in Padua. They had a nice selection of Vegan Ice Cream which the kids enjoyed. My partner and I enjoyed Granitas. Coffee flavour and the Chocolate Flavour. I've never had Granita Siciliana before and it's by far the best type of Granita out there.

I got the Nutella croissant and it was delicious. The lady even heated it up for me. Friendly staff, not too busy, a great selection of things to choose from. A lot of arancini as well, if you're in the mood for something salty.

Asked for something, got something different and once I pointed it out I got told they can't do anything about it (didn't eat the items they gave me at all had them in a bag).
Since I didn't make a mistake and the girl at the attendance didn't make the slightest effort to clarify what she was serving I felt like they should have at least did something to make it up to me when they absolutely didn't.
If you can't deal with people don't work front desk.
Amazing place with amazing food! Desserts or arancini. Many options if you want to try italian’s goodies! I also want to mention about the staff, lady was very nice and patient ❤️😃

Tiny charming trattoria in Padova with very authentic Venetian cuisine. I tried the sarde in saor and bigoli in salsa — both clearly traditional dishes prepared with care and authenticity. Not necessarily my sort of comfort food, and probably not for everyone, especially if you are not used to these older regional flavours, but I appreciated the experience and what the dishes represent culturally. Calm atmosphere, welcoming service, and exactly the kind of place that makes wandering through Padova rewarding.
We got a table with no reservations and food was delicious, for me personally portions were a bit small but i like big plates of pasta other than that it was great a bit expensive but good.

Highlights: I really enjoyed the liver with polenta. This was one of the best meals I’ve had in Italy in a while. Overall this place had the potential for a 5 star, but there were a few things that could have been better:
- service: it felt like we needed to call the waiters multiple times
- service: strangely we were told there is no balsamic vinegar
- fish: the fish tasted a bit funny - did not get the impression that it was fresh.

We stopped in randomly one day for lunch - it was one of the best meals we had in Italy! Felt really nice and old school. We lucked out on not needing a reservation, but on the busier days it’d be a good idea to make one.

Authentic little osteria down a side alley. Food was fresh and well prepared. Very busy with quick table turnover. Walk in possible but reservation would be wise. Spent 69 euros for two appetizers, one pasta, and a main, 3 glasses of house wine and water. Very reasonably priced for quality. Lasagna with asparagus and guanicale main were both amazing. What a way to end last night of two weeks in Italy!
Taste is fine. But the portion is small. You can see from the picture that there are not a lot of vegetables and meat. Not enough for one meal.

Donner kebab was great - asked for spicy sauce and it was perfect. Good bread too!

Basic place and modest prices - just what I was looking for.

Took a break from street-hiking Padua for a bite to eat here.  Ordered up a #11, the Piatto Doner Kebab for 5 Euro.  Tasty!  Also, beverages here are sold in a 1.5L size for 3 Euro which is a good buy on a warm day.
One of the best kebabs I've eaten in my life, they work like crazy in there! Well oiled machine!

Very slaty meat. Maybe for selling more soft drink.
Friendly service and good price.
Better than the other kebab of Prato dell valle.
Amazing local cafe. Delicious wines and food.
Bar garden city wasa very good experience. The owner  is very helpful  and polite. And so is the staff. It waspleasant sitting outside and having a cold coffee. . Do try other drinks as well
Fantastic food and great wine. Limonochelli was the icing on the cake
Excellent food and great wine!

Was getting annoyed by all the pasta and pizza nearby, this was really a refreshing restaurant which tastes like high quality burgers. I really liked the soft and fluffy bun. In my opinion the price is very fair and you get a very big portion of fries for 3 Euro. I never saw the water they are selling but it was very good, perfect amount of fizz.
Can recommend if you are looking for a burger nearby.

I travel a lot and I love Burghers …
This is a good one ..tasty ..
Good service and kool location …what can I say .. try it !
We liked the vibe, but the burger was just okay and not worth the price.
Best burgers in Padova (and I’ve tried them all). Andrea deserves a raise, great customer service. Pet friendly, the French fries were freshly made and everything super fast. 5/5

Safe to say this is the best burger in town! Comparable to the best burgers in Toronto and that's saying something! The fries are killer as well, closest thing to McDonald's fries I've tried. The crashit boys are doing an amazing job!

Was there for a conference dinner, so luckily I didn’t need to pay anything.

First experience with Bigoli, and started to fall in love with it — truly amazing! The steak was also great.

As a racing fan, I really love the things presented in the photos, making the experience even better.

Went there for a scientific Conference social dinner. We were a lot (more than 100) and the service was sometimes a bit slow, but overall totally comprehensible. In particular, the service was slower for people with special dietary requirements. The food was good, with a lot of typical local dishes. Nice atmosphere, elegant but not too formal.
The food is good, but the plates are small. I asked the waiter if the pasta was enough and he said that it was, so I didn’t order the meat, but when it was served for my surprise it was very small.

All of the food was great. I had the bigoli. I am sure it was excellent but it is not my favorite pasta. I had to try it though. The sauce was great I am just not a fan of the large pasta. The grilled octopus appetizer was fantastic. The best octo I have ever had. The tortelloni was also fantastic.

If your looking for a great place to dine in Padua this is the place.  We had lunch after visiting the Scovegni Chapel. About 15 minute walk . Food was amazing service was outstanding we loved it  we tried the fall dish of homemade tortellini filled with pumpkin wow, Also had the eggplant Parmigiano amazing. One of the best lunches ever. You can email or call for a reservation, real Italian family vibe

The pizza is good (averagely good) but the service is such a turn off. I know that it’s hard to smile all the time to your customers, but come on, don’t be rude….
When I came, there wasn’t any lines so I just asked what pizza did they have on that day? I asked them in italian and the staff was just like, “You can see it for yourself.”
Umm… yes I can see them very well, I have two perfectly working eyes? But what I want is some explanations on the pizza they have because some of them looked similar. I need to ask again and point the pizze out one by one so they will explain them to me.
Then she didn’t even ask me and was going to put my pizza on the tray. I stopped them because I wanted to take them home, but wouldn’t it be nicer if they at least ask first?
When I came home, I reheated it but I was also pretty disappointed since they didn’t cut mine. I thought at least they will cut it so it will be easier for me to eat, especially because their name is “pizza on cube” and amongst the university students, they are quite famous for selling pizza, cut in cubes. Honestly I bought the pizza since I was too lazy to cook and I prefer them to cut my pizza for me….
Overall my so-so pizza cost 6,5€ and I think, it’s better for me to just go to a real pizzeria and buy margherita + funghi with 1€ more. The pizza here is tiny compared to the normal pizza and the taste is average. So, nope 🙅🏻‍♀️

Very nice Pizza.. it is a casual place which seemed to be a take away and dine in for local people. And school kids. Believe me, they know what is best. I had to order fast and even take my pizza cold cause I had to rush towards airport, but believe me that was amazing even in that state. I regret I did not find the place a few minutes earlier for some indulging. Will be a visit next time for sure.

Perfect location and delicious pizza for a quick lunch/dinner in the centre of Padua. There is a wide selection of pizzas already prepared (or they will make it for you). Choose your favourite one and they will warm it up and cut in cubic bites.
The service is very fast. The prices are average. Limited seating inside.

Very nice place for a relatively quick bite with very good price to value ratio. "Slices" (large rectangles) and calzones from 3.5 to 5 euros that are filling on their own. Nice airy dough and generous, tasty toppings.

I've eaten there many times, the pizzas are delicious and the blonde lady is always kind but today the other lady was serving and she's too rude with customers, she got too nervous because she wasn't understanding me in English and I was just simply asking her to clean the tables because all of them were too dirty!! I've seen many complaints about this lady so please be careful about the staff choice because we want to be  treated respectfully so that we enjoy our meal :)

We stopped in for coffee while walking around Padua. It's a great place: good coffee, excellent pastries (sweet), and friendly service. We sat outside, and even though there was a sidewalk nearby, the place had a great atmosphere.
The aperitivo and the pizzette (pieces of pizza) you get with it are just incredible here!

It’s a cafe a lot of students frequent, but I don’t think the prices reflect that. Especially the food I think is too expensive for the target group and quality. Outside is really nice but inside lacks atmosphere (and space).

The place is very nice, food is good, service is on top. We took 2 aperotivo and they gave us a pizzata on the house
We also got canoli and maritozzo, and it was good

If there were more star available to rate, I wouldn't doubt about put all of them for this place. Cheap, comfortable, exquisite and delightful. It's a bit hidden, and we found it just this afternoon by casuality, and it seemed so quite that we went inside. At first it looks so tiny, but if you go deeper, there's more space with tables. At first we ordered cioccolato fondente and macchiato, and then we decided to order something to eat, because there is a huge variety of handmade products that looked so tasty. Hopefully we could decide thanks to the advices of the barista. My friend ordered another cioccolato with a kind of macaron typical from Italy and ordered an slice of salami a cioccolato. But the best part was when the waitress gave us two huge pieces of cake for free 😍. The total price was 8,80€. Totally recommended ❤️ I will return for sure if I return to Padova. You've conquered the heart (and the stomach 😂) of two Spanish visitors ❤️❤️❤️

Unique place to have aperitivo. It is located prácticamente by the church tower and faces the church itself. There are tables inside and outside. In winter they put some heaters outside tk stay warm so it's even nice to stay outside. Attention is kind. Had a good cichetto col baccalà mantecato and arancino al pomodoro also good. Prosecco was good.

Aperitivo in the chilled-out atmosphere, a beautiful, sheltered location, and a place run by young people. Inside, they offer a variety of very tempting cicchetti and appetizers. Definitely worth a visit if you're in the area.

A super welcoming wine bar with a great atmosphere, perfect for an evening with friends. A carefully curated wine selection, with interesting options for those who want to try something different. The staff is young and knowledgeable, and can offer advice without being intrusive. The atmosphere is casual, with great music and fair prices. A place you'll want to return to, whether for an aperitif or a longer evening.

Friday night DJ set.
I came back with a sore throat because I had to shout to talk to friends. 10 square meters and music like we were in a park. Definitely not convivial.
Good food, but the drinks don't even come with chips.

The service is very welcoming, with a young staff made up of very friendly, kind, and skilled young people. The bartender who makes the drinks is very skilled, especially when it comes to American drinks. The food is excellent, with a variety of interesting and tasty pizzas and cicchetti; perfect for a quick lunch or a tasty aperitif. The wine selection is excellent and extensive, and the spritzes and drinks like the espresso martini or vodka sour are also perfect for a more sophisticated evening drink. The place smells wonderful, and the interior is truly beautiful and well-kept. The location is perfect for both young and old, located behind the bell tower of Sant'Antonino, offering a corner sheltered from the chaos of the street yet very dynamic and lively!

If you are a meat lover, this place is for you. The best steak house in Padova. Start your meal with ribs’ bucket and go for a great steak afterwards. Do not miss beer pitchers. The price range is a little above average but it worths paying. The only problem is some of amateur staff. But the cook and manager are great. Enjoy.

A great, authentic Grill place. Meat is excellent, portions are quite big and the staff are friendly and attentive.
When seated you get a free appetizer in a form of unpeeled peanuts in a little bucket and tortilla chips with guacamole.

I had such an amazing experience on their Sunday 10€ all you want ribs offer. Although I always order food home but one time I ordered ribs and loved so decided to go on a Sunday.
The service and staff was really good so I wanted to test their behavior when ordering to the point when they start losing. When I ordered my 4th ribs plate, they made me wait double the usual time with the ones before, and had to ask 3 waiters/waitresses until by luck the cashier employee over heard my complaint and she asked the waiter to give me double the ribs plate. Although I only needed one more but she made me put an extra star here. Good job but not everyone would be lucky.

My suggestion js if someone orders fries, put more so we get fuller.
And add fries with every plate it will make people full already when they eat it while waiting the next plat.. but you know better.

Thanks again

Kind staff, but quality of went down. Soggy onion rings, gold burger with gummy meat, uncooked fries and OVERPRICED.
Not recommended.
Fantastic restaurant, tasty food, friendly staff. Loved the new "New York Strip". Located well for lunch and then some shopping.

Best coffee I’ve had in Italy so far. Cappuccino with soya milk was outstanding. Coconut milk version was OK. Foam was incredible, and lasted until the last sip. Recommend the Ethiopian blend.

Some of coffee blends are expensive, and didn’t love extra €1 for plant-based milk.

The environment is good and also I love the coffee here.
But today was not a good experience because the waitress was a bit weird.
Firstly we asked where we can sit down? she told us that we can sit anywhere we want, then my friends put down their bags and sit down, but then a waitress asked us not to sit here and led us to another seats, tbh I can totally accept changing the seats but why you said we can sit anywhere we want,also there are so many empty spaces in here so it wasn’t the busy time.
Secondly, The girl with blunt bang has a very strange way of speaking, it was mean. I have been to many coffee shops in Padova and have met so many friendly people who working in these bars so I can sense that obviously she really isn't friendly towards us. And it's not just me who feels this way, all of my friends can also sense that her attitude is strange, and the way she looked at us is not friendly and polite either.
Tbh I’ve never had amazing experiences in this coffe house though the coffee is good. Girls working in here are always very beautiful but one or two they act always arrogant and weird.
If you don't like this job, why are you still working here? If your job makes you feel annoyed, I don't think it's our fault, is it?
English speaking staff. Take card. Very very good food. We had the bacon egg and cheese pancakes. And a shrimp couscous dish. I am not a couscous guy but this was awesome!

We had breakfast here — the coffee and food were pretty good. We ordered an avocado toast and a full scrambled egg breakfast. Note that you have to pay in advance before eating, as they’ve had issues with people leaving without paying.
One downside: the waitress misunderstood our order and brought four coffees instead of two. We were charged for the extras and had to take them away, which we weren’t happy about. So make sure that you pay attention when he/she repeats your order.

Warm and cozy ambience. Service was prompt and attentive. Great location and good coffee. Looks out on the fruit market at piazza delle Erbe and beautiful market building.
We ordered
Pancakes - Good fresh pancakes with Oreo chunks.
Yogurt bowl - with granola, honey and fresh fruits, very fresh and tasty.
Avocado egg toast - not so great, though the smoked salmon on the side was great and eggs were nice and fluffy.

A Symphony of Spices and Soul in Padova
—> This restaurant is a radiant masterpiece of ethnic fusion that honors the very best of our shared humanity. From the first aromatic breath of spices, you realize this is more than just a meal—it is a profound dialogue between cultures. Each dish is a vibrant bridge connecting the traditions of the East with the heart of Italy, seasoned with deep mutual respect and a genuine love for global heritage. The atmosphere is an embrace of diversity, where every guest is treated like a cherished traveler from a distant land. To see such harmony on a plate is a gift; to taste it is a revelation. The staff radiate a kindness that transcends language, proving that food is the ultimate universal tongue. A five-star sanctuary for the curious palate and the open heart. Truly, a beacon of cultural unity in Padua!"l

An absolute gem in Padova! Food is amazing and they have a diverse menu from where to choose, you can do your own plate by choosing different dishes but there is also fixed menu.

We tried sweets & some special traditional drinks and they were so yummy!

The space is beautiful and there is also space in case you want to visit it with a big group of people!

We ordered the tapas menu. Plenty of choices for vegetarians. The staff are very friendly and professional.  The portions are decent and lovely quality. Enjoyed our meal and would like to return to try other dishes. You can sit outside too.
One of the best restaurants in Padova . Services are perfect and staff are very friendly and food is soooooo goood. I will come back always

Found this place by accident, and glad we did. WOW! The food was fabulous and tasty. The meat just fell apart and the curry was perfect. The service we received was first class and very friendly - especially when explaining all the dishes. Oh, and the prices were amazing!
All you can eat very good. Tasty, fresh. Easy to order over tablet on table.  The seafood salad and grilled prawns lacked a little flavour, but otherwise good.

Was pretty good. So far the best sushi restaurant we've tried in the area. So will go back for that.
1 of the female waiters was a bit rude to us while another was very wonderful and kind.
Nothing to say about it, the food is great and the staff is welcoming:i'd recommend to try the black rice nigiri, it delicious and also my favourite dish!
Amazing. Food quality is very good, people are welcoming and they have a smart technique to place orders. Suggested!
This restaurant is really nice! And the sushi’s are amazing! Also good price

A British themed restaurant, away from the hustle and bustles of the city. I don't speak or understand Italian, but they made every possible effort to make me feel welcomed. Very pleased with the service and so with the steak I ordered. Definitely worth a visit if you like burgers and meat 🍔 🍖

The staff was warm and welcoming. They spoke English and the food was well represented here. Everyone enjoyed their meal and their Burgers were absolutely wonderful. Definitely coming back here again!!!
Nice place for a brunch in Padova. The food is really good, specially the meat, and the staff is really helpful and nice

Really good place!
I ate the fish and chips and it was like to eat a very good fish and chips in England.
The stuff is kind and there is a good service.
Really recommend this place for a good experience of English meal!
An amazing restaurant specialized in meat dishes. Had such a nice experiences over here and all those meat dishes never failed!!! Highly recommend to try smoked pork ribs.
Very good Chinese food! I'll be back again!

We've been customers for many years, and we've always turned a blind eye to the inaccurate wait times, the incorrect dishes, and their reluctance to issue receipts and ask for cash. But when you find insects in your ravioli and they sell you spoiled meat, that's it. It's a real shame.

Great place, great food.
I had the rice and it was plentiful.
I highly recommend it.
Very fast and friendly.
We ordered for three people and they were very quick.
The only downside is that there's no parking.

I was quite disappointed. I've ordered several times, but this is the second time I've been served a small portion of gnocchi covered in oil. Plus, the soy sauce tastes strange, as if it were mixed with vinegar.

A simple Chinese deli, just like the ones they used to be. It's cheap and the food is plentiful (all takeout only). The quality is excellent: you can tell everything is freshly cooked and the ingredients are top-quality. The place is very clean. They've also been offering sushi for a while now. See you next time!
Vegetable dumplings are excellent! Everything is thoughtfully prepared, and the staff are kind, friendly, and welcoming!
Absolutely amazing!! The food was so good, we will definitely come back again. As well as the staff was super nice and helpful!! Would recommend 100%.
best Chinese restaurant in Padova! great food, fresh ingredients, nice friendly staff
Amazing Chinese food, and amazing service. I would recommend to come and try their food.
Kind staff, good food.
The food is fine most of the time. And the staffs are very nice and friendly.
Needs air conditioning, pizza is quite good.
Amazing good pizza's! Strongly recommended!
Service very satisfying
Tooppee😎

My favorite place to eat steak! It’s a hidden local gem that should be discovered by anyone looking for a way to avoid the more common commercial spots. The staff are the loveliest and most accommodating people ever and the food is made to absolute perfection. Highly recommend!
I stayed in Padova for five nights, three out of which I came here to eat! Once discovered couldn’t let go! Perfection

The food was good, not perfect meat quality but very well prepared. The guys were friendly and professional. Just too expensive for my taste, regarding the quality and location. And everything was extra, you order just the meat...
Fresh food and excellent service!
Small restaurant excellent pizza staff very friendly.

Mediocre food, expensive (for being just wheat flour)  and very slow service. Takes 40 minutes from sitting to food arriving, because  you sit there waiting 20 minutes for them to take order from the table even when the place is half empty... and you cannot order at tilt/cassa because 'is table service'

What arrives is pitiful. There was barely any Ragu in the capelleti Al Ragu and this is the "big" padella. Additionally they will charge coperto even at 3:20 PM

Very good food (lasagna, tortellini & Apple cake) for fair price. Service was good (could be a little bit more friendly or engaging but it was all fine over all). Food arrived quickly. Place is nicely done and in a very convenient location.
The food was great the staff was very Nice. I lost my AirPods case there, and they kept it safe👌🏽. A place to comeback

It's nice place to have breakfast, lunch .
Services is very good. There is young lady who she is handling everything like an atomic ant.
Food was really really surprised to me.
Ragu was really ragu which most of the places servicing actually bolognese sauce instead of ragu.
I really liked and add to favorites.

We ordered hamburger with buratta and some kind of tortellini with cheese inside and tomato sause outside - both dishes were a great experience. Very tasty. Prices are average. Service is kind. Restaurant is places in good calm location near to the old town.
I ordered takeaway and it was really good. The pizza was fresh and high quality. Service was quick and well organized. I’ll definitely order again.

Yesterday I had the pleasure of dining at this charming pizzeria, and it was a delightful experience. The atmosphere is a perfect blend of rustic and modern, with exposed walls that add character and a minimalist design that feels cozy yet contemporary. The soft lighting and touches of greenery create a welcoming ambiance.

The pizza was exceptional! The crust was perfectly baked—light and airy with just the right amount of crispiness. The toppings, especially the spicy salami, were of excellent quality, bursting with flavor and paired beautifully with the melted mozzarella. It was evident that fresh ingredients were used.

Service was friendly and efficient, contributing to the relaxed vibe of the place. The attention to detail, from the table settings to the decor, made the experience even more enjoyable. If you’re looking for a stylish yet unpretentious spot for great pizza, this pizzeria is a must-visit. Highly recommended!
We haven't eaten better pizza! The staff is very nice!The cheesecake is very nice.

Great Neapolitan pizza, easily digestible. The place is modern and full of plants which gives it a cool vibe. The beer is also very good! As soon as you get in, you can see the professional pizza oven on the right. Would go back and recommend too!

One of the best pizza in Padova, the atmosphere is very modern and nice and the pizza is napoli style (so if you don't like the high pizza it's not the place for you). Also the desserts are very original and tasty

I’ve been many times to this bistro.
The food is  amazing.
The staff is very kind and professional especially the owner Mr. Basilio.
I totally recommend the place while you wait for your train, to enjoy nice focaccia, pasta or an amazing cappuccino.

As anyone else, I looked at reviews before having lunch there. It was very divided, but by the pictures of the food I decided to give it a try!
Best decision even. Good meal, very good service.
Of course it is clear they are working in their image in Google, and they are doing a good job!
I ordered a tartare and it was delicious. I was surprised by white asparagus decorating the dish, simply amazing.
The restaurant is excellent! It offers the best sandwiches, made with fresh ingredients and prepared to order. Everything is made on the spot, and you can really taste the quality. We loved it!”

Me and my wife just had the breakfast here.
Friendly service and fresh meal!
One Of The best schiaccita we have in Italy!
It was good before but now not good at all specially with one of the staff

This is a street car , but open at odd time of the night and you get high quality fresh ingredients. I always like the sausage and mushrooms.
Classic place , very good value for money .

Nothing to say, this is the best fast food ever. The sausage sandwich is excellent. It's the only one I get because ever since I discovered it, I can't live without it. I recommend the sandwich with sausage, onion, ketchup and mayo, lettuce, and provolone. They make a large sandwich and the price is €8, depending on what you add.
Excellent quality sandwiches and piadinas with a wide selection of fresh, quality products, and a wide selection of soft drinks and beers. Fast service and excellent value.

I ordered a MAXI HOT DOG. I was expecting salad, sauces, and everything. I ordered takeout. I get home with sausage and bread, but it's possible the sausage is very salty. Same order, fried mozzarella balls, still raw, the girl at the counter, give her a wake-up call, slower than a sloth. Anyway, €10 wasted.

We discovered this little place by chance. The staff was super friendly and polite.
The prices were in line with the market, and the products were really good.
We had two kebab wraps (one with spicy sauce and the other with ketchup and mayo), both very good. The spicy one was medium, not too strong. The flavors were very unique, a little sweeter than other kebab wraps we've tried. We also tried the Revani, a sweet dessert, but less so than the Baklava. That was delicious too!
The place was decorated in a casual but well-kept style.
It was a wonderful discovery, too bad we live far away. We'll definitely be back.
Delicious kebab made with fresh ingredients. Welcoming place and friendly staff.

This place is an excellent example of all kebab establishments. It's impeccably clean, and the staff is incredibly friendly. The kebab is delicious, featuring fresh vegetables and top-quality meat. The aesthetics of the place are also outstanding, elevating it above average. Well done!

I just went, it was my first time there, and I had a kebab. I have to say, it was really good... given the late hour, we shared one, but honestly, I would have eaten one alone! It was delicious, and then I tried some puff pastry, walnut, and honey sweets, which were truly delicious.
I'll definitely be back.
Very good kebab, fresh vegetables. Everything was good. Very friendly staff.

We ordered kebbe, falafel and hummus as starters and all three were very good, especially the kebbe and the hummus. The portions were generous. I can say the hummus was enough for four people.

After that, we planned to order just one mixed shawarma to share, but the when we asked the waiter he suggested it wouldn’t be enough and recommended adding something else. We decided to order kofte as well, but in the end it was too much and we had to ask for takeaway.

For dessert we tried the kunefe. It was different from the traditional Turkish kunefe; in my opinion it was average. Someone who has never tried the original might find it very good, but for those familiar with authentic Turkish kunefe, it’s just okay.

The staff were very attentive, kind and professional. The food overall was good. We also had one glass of Lebanese red wine and one white, both nice, plus water.

The restaurant itself is beautiful, well designed, and parking is convenient.

The only negative point was the coperto. Because it was Valentine’s Day, we were charged €8 per person, so €16 for two people, which felt excessive, especially since the prices are already above average. They also added €1 extra for the takeaway.

Overall, the food and service were good, but the coperto charge was absurd.

Am so glad we decided to drive 40 minutes to try this restaurant! The food was authentic Lebanese, delicious and fresh. The service was great and the staff are very nice. Service is also fast but not rushing and they make sure they bring you the dishes in stages so that they don't get cold. We tried must of the appetizers and they were all delicious. We also tried the shawerma and the mixed grill which both were great too. Everything about dinner in this restaurant was great and the waiter was happy to share his recommendations with us and they were all great.
I highly recommend this restaurant for a change from the typical Italian cusine to something different.

Beautiful small restaurant - a little bit hidden in the industrial zone. We've been there an had fattoush salad, kafta sandwich an taouk plate. Everything was very good, well spiced and freshly made. Service was friendly and prices fair.

Terrible Food and Awful Customer Service: This cafe in Padova was an absolute disappointment. We  had a terrible experience there. The staff were RUDE and the place felt UNFRIENDLY. They served us BURNED FOOD, and when we pointed it out, they responded disrespectfully. On top of that, they charge €3 per person for service, which was far from acceptable

The meats and all three dishes we tried were nothing close to authentic Lebanese cuisine—everything was extremely dry and poorly prepared. Would not recommend!
Nice place, the food is pretty good. We all ordered meat and it came at different times which made it difficult for everyone to eat at the same time. Aside from that, I would come back!

Delicious!! I absolutely recommend this place. First of all, I like the interior and cleanliness, also for a bathroom and tables. Also the owner is a super friendly person. Finally food was cooked so fast and tasty! I’ll return back definitely

Everything was perfect, the owner was super kind and the hospitality was super good.

The food was really nice as well, for sure the best Turkish restaurant in Padova and we will come back again for sure

NEVERTHELESS is ALWAYS TASTE GOOD.

Great food. The staff put a lot of quantity of ingredients. First time to order pizza kebab and I liked it. We also ordered this hamburger looking kebab. Price worth the amount of food 👍 Nice staff too. I already ate a slice on the photo.
I ate falafel without sauces. It's only 4€ with fries 5.5€. Cheap and big vegan delicious falafel.

Great prices and tasty food! Thank you 😋

This is a great place to have lunch: the best deal and delicious variable food every single time you come. The portions are good sized, the food is delicious whatever you order and having the first dish, the second dish, water and coffee for 10-12 euros is a bargain. They also serve an amazing crema di tiramisu: heavenly! Highly recommended. The servers (maybe owners) are really nice and welcoming.

The best: good prices and good food. I was totally surprised by this place. Seems that they even offer healthy food which is very difficult to find. I dont know about the portions but Prices are great for students. I got some brioche for breakfast that were all good and delicious.

I've been frequenting P&G28 for a while now, and it's always a confirmation!
It's the perfect place for a well-deserved lunch break, with tasty, carefully prepared dishes, or for spending a pleasant evening with friends, sipping excellent drinks and a wide selection of delicious treats. The staff is always extremely kind, courteous, and helpful, making you feel welcome and at ease at all times. The atmosphere is truly welcoming and cozy, perfect for relaxing and enjoying yourself. Definitely try their Friday night burger night, too: highly recommended! Highly recommended!

Since the change of ownership, P&G has been our favorite bar for happy hour! The staff is super friendly and helpful, the place is cute and clean, and all the happy hour and lunch options are excellent. The cacio e pepe meatballs and cicchetti are delicious, always made with the freshest ingredients and prepared by the chef. I highly recommend trying their Blanc beer!

I was truly impressed. The atmosphere is welcoming, and the staff is friendly and helpful. The restaurant's strong point is undoubtedly the food. The food is truly delicious, and the selection is top-quality.
The dishes we tried were an explosion of flavors, and they were plentiful.
I highly recommend this place to anyone who loves good food!
